sources.citation: Arsalidou M, Taylor MJ. NeuroImage. 2011;54(3):2382-2393.
sources.useFor: Number comparison, arithmetic, and calculation network evidence.
sources.supports: 计算与数量加工 fMRI 定量元分析入口；PubMed 摘要支持数字/计算任务共同包含下顶叶活动，并提示不同算术操作在前额叶区域上有分化。
sources.safeUse: 可作为心算和数字比较的计算能力优先核验来源，重点检查 IPS/SPL、下顶叶、视觉符号输入和前额叶步骤控制的分工。
sources.boundary: 当前只完成元数据、PubMed 摘要和任务适配确认；数量大小、符号识别、事实提取、多步骤运算和工作记忆负荷要拆开讲，不能用一个顶叶点代表全部计算，也不能把前额叶候选点讲成所有数字比较都固定参与。

sources.title: Origins of the brain networks for advanced mathematics in expert mathematicians
sources.citation: Amalric M, Dehaene S. Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences. 2016;113(18):4909-4917.
sources.useFor: Advanced mathematical reasoning across algebra, analysis, geometry, and topology; use cautiously because participants were expert mathematicians.
sources.supports: 专家数学家 fMRI 研究显示代数、分析、几何、拓扑等高级数学条件动员一组双侧额叶、顶叶和下颞区域，并与经典语言区相对分离。
sources.safeUse: 可作为代数、几何和高级数学演示的候选来源，强调高级数学并非只是语言阅读，而会动员空间/数量和额顶推理系统。
sources.boundary: 研究对象是专家数学家，不等同于儿童或普通学生解题；不能把专家高级数学网络直接当作训练产品已验证靶点。

sources.title: Can cognitive models explain brain activation during word and pseudoword reading? A meta-analysis of 36 neuroimaging studies
sources.citation: Taylor JS, Rastle K, Davis MH. Psychological Bulletin. 2013;139(4):766-791.
sources.useFor: Lexical decision, word reading, and reading task evidence.
sources.supports: 候选用于词读、伪词读和词汇判断相关阅读任务的元分析证据。
sources.safeUse: 优先用于词汇判断和基础字词识别讲解。
sources.boundary: 不能把它直接扩展成所有阅读理解、篇章理解或训练效果证据。

sources.title: Where Is the Semantic System? A Critical Review and Meta-Analysis of 120 Functional Neuroimaging Studies
sources.citation: Binder JR, Desai RH, Graves WW, Conant LL. Cerebral Cortex. 2009;19(12):2767-2796.
sources.useFor: Semantic task, reading comprehension, temporal semantic cortex, angular/inferior parietal, and semantic-control boundaries.
sources.supports: 支持语义系统为分布式网络，涉及颞叶、下顶叶和前额叶语义控制等候选区域。
sources.safeUse: 可用于阅读理解和长时语义记忆中的语义系统层级讲解。
sources.boundary: 元分析支持分布式系统，不支持把语义压缩为单个点位。

sources.title: The anterior cingulate cortex mediates processing selection in the Stroop attentional conflict paradigm
sources.citation: Pardo JV, Pardo PJ, Janer KW, Raichle ME. Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences. 1990;87(1):256-259.
sources.useFor: Stroop conflict, anterior cingulate conflict monitoring, and distributed task-execution network caution.
sources.supports: PET Stroop 色词冲突研究报告 incongruent 相比 congruent 条件下以前扣带皮层反应最突出，并伴随前运动、SMA、视觉等分布式区域。
sources.safeUse: 可用于说明 Stroop 的冲突监控/反应选择不能只画成视觉和注意，还应显式放入前扣带/内侧额叶监控节点。
sources.boundary: 这是一项早期 PET 研究，不等同于 Schaefer200 点位级精确坐标；不能说这些点就是训练靶点。

sources.title: Dissociating the Role of the Dorsolateral Prefrontal and Anterior Cingulate Cortex in Cognitive Control
sources.citation: MacDonald AW, Cohen JD, Stenger VA, Carter CS. Science. 2000;288(5472):1835-1838.
sources.useFor: Stroop task preparation, DLPFC implementation of control, and ACC performance monitoring.
sources.supports: 事件相关 fMRI Stroop 任务显示左 DLPFC 更偏任务准备/控制实施，ACC 更偏不一致刺激下的表现监控。
sources.safeUse: 可用于把 Stroop 拆成前额叶规则保持和前扣带冲突监控两层，而不是只讲一个笼统注意网络。
sources.boundary: 该文支持控制实施与监控分工，不支持把所有额叶 parcel 解释为同一种抑制机制。

sources.title: Working memory training does not improve performance on measures of intelligence or other measures of far transfer
sources.citation: Melby-Lervag M, Redick TS, Hulme C. Perspectives on Psychological Science. 2016;11(4):512-534.
sources.useFor: Meta-analytic boundary source covering 87 publications and 145 experimental comparisons of working-memory training and transfer.
sources.supports: 元分析发现工作记忆训练对相似的言语和视空间工作记忆任务存在较稳定的近迁移，但与处理过的控制组相比，对智力、阅读和算术等远迁移结果没有令人信服的稳定证据。
sources.safeUse: 可用于解释为什么训练设计应锁定具体瓶颈、把练习接到真实任务，并分别验证近迁移和远迁移。
sources.boundary: 这篇综述反对把简单重复练习宣传为一般智力或现实能力提升，但不等于任何针对性教育干预都无效。

sources.title: The academic outcomes of working memory and metacognitive strategy training in children: A double-blind randomized controlled trial
sources.citation: Jones JS, Milton F, Mostazir M, Adlam AR. Developmental Science. 2020;23(4):e12870.
sources.useFor: Typical-child randomized trial that measures the full transfer chain from trained working-memory tasks to untrained working memory, mathematical reasoning, reading comprehension, and three-month maintenance.
sources.supports: 95名9至14岁普通儿童被随机分到Cogmed、Cogmed加元认知策略或自适应视觉搜索主动对照组。训练持续6至7周，共20至25次，每次约45分钟；研究在训练前、训练后和三个月后测量四项工作记忆任务、数学推理和阅读理解。工作记忆近迁移保持到三个月；数学推理只在训练后立即出现改善，三个月后不再显著；阅读理解没有可靠改善。
sources.safeUse: 可作为儿童工作记忆训练中较完整的训练、近迁移、学业远迁移和保持时间证据，也能说明主动对照和延迟测量为何重要。
sources.boundary: 训练是包含11类言语与视空间任务的Cogmed，不是N-back直接训练。数学效应短暂且未保持，阅读没有改善；元认知策略增加了部分近迁移，但没有额外带来数学或阅读收益。不能把结果写成工作记忆训练稳定提高学业成绩。

sources.title: Academic Outcomes 2 Years After Working Memory Training for Children With Low Working Memory: A Randomized Clinical Trial
sources.citation: Roberts G, Quach J, Spencer-Smith M, et al. JAMA Pediatrics. 2016;170(5):e154568.
sources.useFor: Large school-based randomized trial that follows low-working-memory children for two years and measures working memory, reading, mathematics, spelling, behavior, quality of life, and intervention cost.
sources.supports: 研究先筛查44所学校的1723名一年级儿童，再将452名低工作记忆儿童随机分组。训练组在学校完成20至25次、每次45分钟的Cogmed训练；研究在6、12和24个月追踪工作记忆，并在12和24个月直接测量阅读、数学和拼写，同时收集行为、社会情绪、生活质量与成本。视空间短时记忆在6和12个月出现改善，但24个月消失；其他结局没有获益，学业成绩没有持续提高。
sources.safeUse: 可作为训练迁移链和长期随访做得较完整的大样本边界研究，尤其适合说明为什么不能用短期任务进步代替长期学业结果。
sources.boundary: 对照条件是常规课堂教学，而不是等时主动认知训练；样本是筛查出的低工作记忆儿童，且训练占用了课堂时间。当前只核验官方摘要和大学元数据，尚未获得可合法归档的开放全文，因此只能使用摘要明确报告的结果。

paradigms.label: 简单反应时
paradigms.upgradeQuestion: 简单反应时是否值得做脑网络演示，还是应保留为行为基线？
paradigms.riskNote: 简单反应时现在可作为基础刺激-反应速度范式展示，但仍不能代表 choice RT、符号搜索、知觉辨别或训练因果。Kansaku 坐标来自 Talairach-to-MNI 本地转换，最近 Schaefer200 parcel 只作 review 级候选。

sources.title: Reaction time and movement time as measures of stimulus evaluation and response processes
sources.citation: Houlihan M, Campbell K, Stelmack RM. Intelligence. 1994;18(3):289-307.
sources.useFor: Simple and choice reaction-time decomposition into stimulus evaluation, response selection, and movement/output timing.
sources.supports: 候选用于把反应时和运动时分解为刺激评价、反应选择和动作输出过程的行为来源。
sources.safeUse: 可用于把简单反应时作为行为基线，讲刺激评估和动作输出速度。
sources.boundary: 这是行为过程来源，不支持具体脑区激活或复杂网络声称。

sources.title: Control of goal-directed and stimulus-driven attention in the brain
sources.citation: Corbetta M, Shulman GL. Nature Reviews Neuroscience. 2002;3(3):201-215.
sources.useFor: Attention orienting, dorsal attention, ventral attention, cueing, and reorienting language.
sources.supports: 注意定向和重定向的综述级网络框架，尤其适合解释背侧目标导向注意与腹侧刺激驱动重定向。
sources.safeUse: 可用于 Posner 线索任务和注意定向类范式的网络级讲解。
sources.boundary: 不能直接推出 Schaefer200 某个点位在某个任务中激活，也不能用于个体诊断。

sources.title: A shared neural network for simple reaction time
sources.citation: Kansaku K, Hanakawa T, Wu T, Hallett M. NeuroImage. 2004;22(2):904-911.
sources.useFor: Simple reaction-time source separating sensory cue detection, SMA/premotor response preparation, opercular/parietal and cerebellar response-output candidates.
sources.supports: Simple reaction-time coordinates support sensory cue detection, medial frontal/SMA preparation, premotor response preparation, opercular salience/integration and cerebellar boundary evidence.
sources.safeUse: 可用于把 simple RT 讲成从线索输入到反应准备和输出的快速通路。
sources.boundary: 不等同 choice RT、符号搜索或复杂决策速度；小脑只作专门图谱边界。

sources.title: Differential effects of reasoning and speed training in children
sources.citation: Mackey AP, Hill SS, Stone SI, Bunge SA. Developmental Science. 2011;14(3):582-590.
sources.useFor: Eight-week randomized comparison of reasoning games versus processing-speed games in 28 children aged 7-9 from low socioeconomic backgrounds.
sources.supports: 28名7至9岁儿童分别接受8周推理训练或加工速度训练；推理组主要改善非言语推理测验，速度组主要改善编码速度，显示训练收益与所练任务成分有选择性。
sources.safeUse: 可用于说明儿童的推理和加工速度表现具有可训练性，而且训练效果更可能先出现在与训练内容接近的任务上。
sources.boundary: 样本小、没有无训练控制组、部分评估未完全盲法，也没有MRI终点；论文中的大效应不能当作一般儿童、智商或学业提升的稳定估计。

paradigms.label: 视觉表象任务
paradigms.upgradeQuestion: 视觉表象是否应与心理旋转分开，还是作为辅助例子保留？
paradigms.riskNote: 视觉表象可以讲成视觉再激活、顶叶组织和前额控制的候选网络；不能讲成 imagery-only 精确脑区或个人诊断靶点。

sources.title: Neural foundations of imagery
sources.citation: Kosslyn SM, Ganis G, Thompson WL. Nature Reviews Neuroscience. 2001;2(9):635-642.
sources.useFor: Visual imagery task identity, perception-imagery overlap, and caution around internal imagery claims.
sources.supports: 候选用于视觉表象的综述级神经基础，尤其是视觉表象与视觉感知的部分重叠和差异。
sources.safeUse: 可用于说明视觉表象不是单纯看见外界，而是在没有外部图像时调用视觉和控制系统生成内部图像。
sources.boundary: 不能说大脑里真的出现可被观看的图像，也不能把视觉表象等同于心理旋转或训练效果证据。

sources.title: Brain areas underlying visual mental imagery and visual perception: an fMRI study
sources.citation: Ganis G, Thompson WL, Kosslyn SM. Cognitive Brain Research. 2004;20(2):226-241.
sources.useFor: Visual mental imagery and visual perception overlap/difference evidence.
sources.supports: fMRI 研究用于比较视觉心理表象和视觉感知涉及的脑区重叠与差异；用户补入 PDF 后，Tables 3-4 已抽取并转为 MNI/Schaefer200 坐标候选。
sources.safeUse: 可作为视觉表象任务的神经影像入口，帮助解释内部图像生成会牵动视觉、顶叶和额叶控制支架；当前适合做 70% 坐标候选展示。
sources.boundary: 坐标已完成候选映射，但尚未人工裁剪 production overlay；common imagery-perception 与 perception-only ventral temporal 边界要分开讲，不能声称 imagery-only 精确点位已终审。

sources.title: Neuroimaging studies of mental rotation: A meta-analysis and review
sources.citation: Zacks JM. Journal of Cognitive Neuroscience. 2008;20(1):1-19.
sources.useFor: Mental rotation and spatial imagery operation evidence.
sources.supports: 心理旋转元分析与综述证据，支持顶内沟及邻近顶叶区域作为心理旋转/空间变换的高优先级主线，并提示部分任务条件下可见前运动/运动模拟相关参与。
sources.safeUse: 优先用于心理旋转，把表象操作讲成视觉形态输入后进入顶叶空间变换，再由额顶系统完成比较判断。
sources.boundary: 视觉表象、空间注意、动作模拟和心理旋转不能混讲；前运动参与要按任务材料和策略单独核验，不能把它做成所有心理旋转范式的固定核心。

sources.title: Effects of memory training on cortical thickness in the elderly
sources.citation: Engvig A, Fjell AM, Westlye LT, et al. NeuroImage. 2010;52(4):1667-1676.
sources.useFor: Eight-week Method-of-Loci training in middle-aged and older adults with pre/post memory testing and structural MRI cortical-thickness analysis.
sources.supports: 42名完成者中，训练组接受8周地点法记忆训练；来源记忆表现提高，并相较被动控制组出现局部皮层厚度增加，厚度变化与记忆改善相关。
sources.safeUse: 可用于说明在中老年样本中，结构化记忆策略训练可能同时伴随来源记忆改善和局部结构MRI变化。
sources.boundary: 样本为42至77岁的健康中老年人，控制组是被动控制；不能外推到儿童、一般学习成绩或所有长期记忆训练。MRI形态变化也不是个体诊断指标。

sources.title: Playing Super Mario induces structural brain plasticity: gray matter changes resulting from training with a commercial video game
sources.citation: Kuhn S, Gleich T, Lorenz RC, Lindenberger U, Gallinat J. Molecular Psychiatry. 2014;19(2):265-271.
sources.useFor: Training/neuroplasticity background for explaining why complex 3D spatial-action tasks may engage spatial navigation, strategic planning, working memory, and motor coordination systems. Local PDF is archived; keep out of coordinate overlays, diagnosis, and product-efficacy promises.
sources.supports: 2个月、每天至少30分钟的商业3D平台游戏训练组，在结构MRI中观察到右海马结构、右背外侧前额叶和双侧小脑灰质增加；论文把这些区域解释为与空间导航、策略规划、工作记忆和动作表现相关。
sources.safeUse: 可用于资料库、训练设计和家长讲解中的“复杂任务练习可能打到多个脑功能系统，并且大脑具有可塑性”的背景说明。适合连接表象/空间操作、执行功能、短时/工作记忆和动作协调，不作为某个具体范式的点位来源。
sources.boundary: 样本是成人纵向训练研究，任务是 Super Mario 类3D平台游戏；不能据此承诺本项目训练会让儿童脑区灰质增长，不能作为疗效、诊断、个体预测或生产3D点位证据。

sources.title: Activation and effective connectivity changes following explicit-memory training for face-name pairs in patients with mild cognitive impairment: a pilot study
sources.citation: Hampstead BM, Stringer AY, Stilla RF, et al. Neurorehabilitation and Neural Repair. 2011;25(3):210-222.
sources.useFor: Pilot explicit-memory training study with three face-name mnemonic sessions and pre/post fMRI in six patients with amnestic multidomain MCI.
sources.supports: 训练项目在行为上改善，并伴随训练项目特异的分布式激活和连接增加；助记策略将面部特征、语言线索与心理表象结合。
sources.safeUse: 可用于面孔-姓名联结和联想记忆训练的策略机制：把难记的配对转成显著视觉特征、语言钩子和可回想图像。
sources.boundary: 只有6名MCI患者、无独立对照组，属于先导研究；不能外推到健康儿童、所有情景记忆或海马结构变化。

sources.title: The malleability of spatial skills: a meta-analysis of training studies
sources.citation: Uttal DH, Meadow NG, Tipton E, et al. Psychological Bulletin. 2013;139(2):352-402.
sources.useFor: Meta-analysis of 217 spatial-training studies addressing effect magnitude, durability, transfer, age, and training type.
sources.supports: 空间训练总体呈中等幅度改善，效果在延迟测量中较稳定，并可迁移到未训练的空间任务；不同训练方式和年龄均可见收益。
sources.safeUse: 可用于说明空间能力不是完全固定的，训练应把练习、表征方式和真实空间任务连接起来，并分别检验近迁移与远迁移。
sources.boundary: 元分析汇总的是多种空间任务，不能据此声称每个具体范式、学业结果或个体都会得到同等改善，也没有提供统一的脑影像结论。

paradigms.label: 类比推理
paradigms.upgradeQuestion: 销售演示是否需要类比推理，还是瑞文矩阵足以覆盖推理 v0？
paradigms.riskNote: 当前 100% 只针对 verbal propositional analogy 的前额叶机制；不能说成瑞文矩阵、所有类比推理或完整推理网络的精确定位，也不能把顶叶/语义背景当作 Bunge 坐标已坐实。

sources.title: Analogical Reasoning and Prefrontal Cortex: Evidence for Separable Retrieval and Integration Mechanisms
sources.citation: Bunge SA. Cerebral Cortex. 2005;15(3):239-249.
sources.useFor: Analogical reasoning, relation retrieval, integration, and prefrontal control evidence.
sources.supports: 候选用于类比推理中关系检索和关系整合的前额叶机制证据。
sources.safeUse: 可用于把类比推理拆成已知关系提取、关系映射和前额控制整合。
sources.boundary: 不能外推为智力诊断或训练效果证明；语言材料、图形材料和关系复杂度差异需要单独说明。

sources.title: The Parieto-Frontal Integration Theory (P-FIT) of intelligence: converging neuroimaging evidence
sources.citation: Jung RE, Haier RJ. Behavioral and Brain Sciences. 2007;30(2):135-154.
sources.useFor: Reasoning, Raven-like tasks, and parieto-frontal explanatory caution.
sources.supports: 候选用于 P-FIT 视角下的推理和智力相关宽网络框架。
sources.safeUse: 可作为瑞文矩阵和类比推理的宽网络讲法边界。
sources.boundary: 不能用于诊断性 IQ 声称，也不能把训练效果说成智力提升证明。

sources.title: Fractionating human intelligence
sources.citation: Hampshire A, Highfield RR, Parkin BL, Owen AM. Neuron. 2012;76(6):1225-1237.
sources.useFor: Reasoning, short-term memory, verbal reasoning, and task-family decomposition.
sources.supports: 候选用于把推理、短时记忆和语言推理等成分拆分的任务研究。
sources.safeUse: 可用于推理和短时记忆演示中的任务成分拆分。
sources.boundary: 它不是九项脑功能训练系统本身的验证研究，不能直接替代产品效果证据。

sources.title: Differential effects of reasoning and speed training in children
sources.citation: Mackey AP, Hill SS, Stone SI, Bunge SA. Developmental Science. 2011;14(3):582-590.
sources.useFor: Eight-week randomized comparison of reasoning games versus processing-speed games in 28 children aged 7-9 from low socioeconomic backgrounds.
sources.supports: 28名7至9岁儿童分别接受8周推理训练或加工速度训练；推理组主要改善非言语推理测验，速度组主要改善编码速度，显示训练收益与所练任务成分有选择性。
sources.safeUse: 可用于说明儿童的推理和加工速度表现具有可训练性，而且训练效果更可能先出现在与训练内容接近的任务上。
sources.boundary: 样本小、没有无训练控制组、部分评估未完全盲法，也没有MRI终点；论文中的大效应不能当作一般儿童、智商或学业提升的稳定估计。

paradigms.label: 再认记忆
paradigms.upgradeQuestion: 再认记忆能否解释提取，同时不过度声称海马覆盖？
paradigms.riskNote: 再认记忆生产级只覆盖皮层提取与判断支路；不要把它说成完整 MTL 记忆系统，也不要和来源记忆画成完全相同网络。

sources.title: Event-related fMRI studies of episodic encoding and retrieval: Meta-analyses using activation likelihood estimation
sources.citation: Spaniol J, Davidson PSR, Kim ASN, Han H, Moscovitch M, Grady CL. Neuropsychologia. 2009;47(8-9):1765-1779.
sources.useFor: Recognition memory, episodic retrieval, and memory-system caution.
sources.supports: 候选用于情景记忆编码和提取的 ALE 元分析。
sources.safeUse: 可作为再认记忆和词表学习提取环节的核验入口。
sources.boundary: 熟悉性、回忆性和内侧颞叶贡献需要进一步细分。

sources.title: A sensory signature that distinguishes true from false memories
sources.citation: Slotnick SD, Schacter DL. Nature Neuroscience. 2004;7(6):664-672.
sources.useFor: True versus false recognition evidence for sensory-perceptual reactivation and false-memory boundaries. Tables 1-3 have been extracted into Talairach and MNI-converted coordinate intake with 73 cortical review candidates and caudate/thalamus/hippocampus boundary rows.
sources.supports: True versus false recognition coordinates support sensory reactivation and caudate/thalamus/hippocampus boundary evidence for false-memory refinement.
sources.safeUse: 可用于 DRM/假记忆精修中说明 true-vs-false recognition 的感觉再激活差异。
sources.boundary: 不是 DRM primary-task 坐标；海马、丘脑和尾状核需要专门图谱，不能直接塞入 Schaefer200 主图。

sources.title: Differential Contributions of Prefrontal, Medial Temporal, and Sensory-Perceptual Regions to True and False Memory Formation
sources.citation: Kim H, Cabeza R. Cerebral Cortex. 2007;17(9):2143-2150.
sources.useFor: True/false memory formation source separating PFC, MTL and sensory-perceptual contributions.
sources.supports: True/false memory formation coordinates support PFC, MTL and sensory-perceptual boundary refinement for false-memory formation.
sources.safeUse: 可用于 DRM/假记忆形成阶段解释 PFC、感觉再激活和 MTL 边界。
sources.boundary: 不是单一 DRM primary task；MTL、丘脑和小脑仍需专门图谱。

sources.title: Effects of memory training on cortical thickness in the elderly
sources.citation: Engvig A, Fjell AM, Westlye LT, et al. NeuroImage. 2010;52(4):1667-1676.
sources.useFor: Eight-week Method-of-Loci training in middle-aged and older adults with pre/post memory testing and structural MRI cortical-thickness analysis.
sources.supports: 42名完成者中，训练组接受8周地点法记忆训练；来源记忆表现提高，并相较被动控制组出现局部皮层厚度增加，厚度变化与记忆改善相关。
sources.safeUse: 可用于说明在中老年样本中，结构化记忆策略训练可能同时伴随来源记忆改善和局部结构MRI变化。
sources.boundary: 样本为42至77岁的健康中老年人，控制组是被动控制；不能外推到儿童、一般学习成绩或所有长期记忆训练。MRI形态变化也不是个体诊断指标。

sources.title: Activation and effective connectivity changes following explicit-memory training for face-name pairs in patients with mild cognitive impairment: a pilot study
sources.citation: Hampstead BM, Stringer AY, Stilla RF, et al. Neurorehabilitation and Neural Repair. 2011;25(3):210-222.
sources.useFor: Pilot explicit-memory training study with three face-name mnemonic sessions and pre/post fMRI in six patients with amnestic multidomain MCI.
sources.supports: 训练项目在行为上改善，并伴随训练项目特异的分布式激活和连接增加；助记策略将面部特征、语言线索与心理表象结合。
sources.safeUse: 可用于面孔-姓名联结和联想记忆训练的策略机制：把难记的配对转成显著视觉特征、语言钩子和可回想图像。
sources.boundary: 只有6名MCI患者、无独立对照组，属于先导研究；不能外推到健康儿童、所有情景记忆或海马结构变化。

paradigms.label: 来源记忆
paradigms.upgradeQuestion: 来源记忆能否作为长时记忆中情景细节和来源监控的核心演示？
paradigms.riskNote: 来源记忆容易把 MTL、下顶叶、前额叶监控和丘脑边界混成单一回路；当前生产级只代表可讲候选网络，必须继续区分项目/来源编码、情景背景、细节提取、来源监控和皮层外边界，且 MTL/丘脑仍是专门图谱边界。

sources.title: Multiple routes to memory: Distinct medial temporal lobe processes build item and source memories
sources.citation: Davachi L, Mitchell JP, Wagner AD. Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences. 2003;100(4):2157-2162.
sources.useFor: Task fMRI source separating item recognition from source recollection during encoding. Use for associative-memory and source-memory atlas-boundary language; MTL peaks remain outside the current cortical Schaefer200 display.
sources.supports: PNAS task fMRI 来源，区分 item recognition 与 source recollection 的编码机制，并指出海马/后海马旁等 MTL 对来源回忆更关键。
sources.safeUse: 可用于联想记忆和来源记忆的任务身份、MTL 边界和海马不能硬塞进 Schaefer200 的说明。
sources.boundary: PDF 已入库，但主要关键结构在内侧颞叶；当前皮层模型只能显示语义线索、下顶叶提取和前额叶监控代理层。

sources.title: Executive control during episodic retrieval: multiple prefrontal processes subserve source memory
sources.citation: Dobbins IG, Foley H, Schacter DL, Wagner AD. Neuron. 2002;35(5):989-996.
sources.useFor: Task fMRI source for prefrontal control during episodic/source retrieval. Use for source-monitoring and retrieval-control claims; full text still needs institution access.
sources.supports: 候选用于来源记忆中前额叶控制、提取策略和来源监控的任务 fMRI 证据。
sources.safeUse: 可用于说明 source-memory 不只是再认，还需要前额叶参与来源判断和控制检索。
sources.boundary: 当前只完成元数据核验，Neuron 全文仍需机构权限；不能把 DLPFC 点位讲成已由该文坐标复核。

sources.title: Parietal lobe contributions to episodic memory retrieval
sources.citation: Wagner AD, Shannon BJ, Kahn I, Buckner RL. Trends in Cognitive Sciences. 2005;9(9):445-453.
sources.useFor: Review source for inferior/lateral parietal contributions to episodic retrieval. Use for angular/IPL retrieval-support language before coordinate-level mapping.
sources.supports: 候选用于下顶叶/外侧顶叶在情景记忆提取中的作用，尤其是角回/IPL 记忆线索和提取细节的网络级框架。
sources.safeUse: 可用于长时记忆的下顶叶提取层讲解，并作为联想记忆、来源记忆、再认记忆的顶叶支架。
sources.boundary: 当前只完成元数据核验；没有 PDF/全文坐标表前，不能声称已完成 Schaefer200 点位级复核。

sources.title: The parietal cortex and episodic memory: an attentional account
sources.citation: Cabeza R, Ciaramelli E, Olson IR, Moscovitch M. Nature Reviews Neuroscience. 2008;9(8):613-625.
sources.useFor: Review source for parietal attention-to-memory framing. Use as a network-level guardrail for episodic retrieval and source-memory displays.
sources.supports: 候选用于顶叶注意-记忆框架，尤其适合约束情景提取、来源记忆和下顶叶/角回代理点的讲法。
sources.safeUse: 可作为 source-memory、recognition-memory 和 associative-memory 的网络级边界来源，说明顶叶参与提取和注意到记忆。
sources.boundary: Europe PMC 标记有 PDF 但接口下载失败；未取得全文坐标前，不能把它升级成坐标级证据。

sources.title: Effects of memory training on cortical thickness in the elderly
sources.citation: Engvig A, Fjell AM, Westlye LT, et al. NeuroImage. 2010;52(4):1667-1676.
sources.useFor: Eight-week Method-of-Loci training in middle-aged and older adults with pre/post memory testing and structural MRI cortical-thickness analysis.
sources.supports: 42名完成者中，训练组接受8周地点法记忆训练；来源记忆表现提高，并相较被动控制组出现局部皮层厚度增加，厚度变化与记忆改善相关。
sources.safeUse: 可用于说明在中老年样本中，结构化记忆策略训练可能同时伴随来源记忆改善和局部结构MRI变化。
sources.boundary: 样本为42至77岁的健康中老年人，控制组是被动控制；不能外推到儿童、一般学习成绩或所有长期记忆训练。MRI形态变化也不是个体诊断指标。

paradigms.label: 多目标追踪
paradigms.upgradeQuestion: 多目标追踪能否作为分配注意和空间更新的核心演示？
paradigms.riskNote: Jovicich 支持 MOT/追踪负荷的点位级演示，但视觉输入、追踪负荷、FEF/PMA 和 ACC/内侧额叶需求必须分层讲；Merkel 是 ROI/MVPA 策略分型源，不是 ordinary whole-brain peak table；小脑/基底节仍是图谱边界，不进入当前 Schaefer200 皮层 overlay。

sources.title: Brain Areas Specific for Attentional Load in a Motion-Tracking Task
sources.citation: Jovicich J, Peters RJ, Koch C, Braun J, Chang L, Ernst T. Journal of Cognitive Neuroscience. 2001;13(8):1048-1058.
sources.useFor: Multiple-object tracking and attentional-load fMRI coordinates, especially IPS/SPL, FEF/PMA, SEF/SMA, visual-motion regions, plus cerebellum/basal-ganglia atlas-boundary evidence.
sources.supports: 多目标追踪负荷研究提供动态视觉输入、SPL/IPS 追踪负荷、FEF/PMA 注意集合和 ACC/内侧额叶需求坐标，可用于 MOT 的生产级分层演示。
sources.safeUse: 可用于把 MOT 讲成运动视觉输入进入顶叶追踪负荷系统，并由 FEF/前运动准备和内侧额叶任务需求辅助。
sources.boundary: Jovicich 表格支持当前 MOT 演示，但视觉输入、追踪负荷、FEF/PMA 和 ACC/内侧额叶必须分层；小脑和基底节仍留在图谱边界，Merkel 2015 只作为未来策略分型精修。

sources.title: Attention Response Functions
sources.citation: Culham JC, Cavanagh P, Kanwisher NG. Neuron. 2001;32(4):737-745.
sources.useFor: Multiple object tracking, attentional load, and parietal/frontal attention response language.
sources.supports: 候选用于多目标追踪中注意负荷、视觉空间注意和额顶/顶叶注意反应的任务证据。
sources.safeUse: 可作为多目标追踪的优先区域级证据入口，用于解释动态目标追踪会牵动顶叶和额叶注意系统，并区分 task-only 与 load-dependent 反应。
sources.boundary: PDF 已入库，但未发现显式峰值坐标表；尚未逐坐标映射到 Schaefer200，当前只能作为区域级候选点位依据。

sources.title: Control of goal-directed and stimulus-driven attention in the brain
sources.citation: Corbetta M, Shulman GL. Nature Reviews Neuroscience. 2002;3(3):201-215.
sources.useFor: Attention orienting, dorsal attention, ventral attention, cueing, and reorienting language.
sources.supports: 注意定向和重定向的综述级网络框架，尤其适合解释背侧目标导向注意与腹侧刺激驱动重定向。
sources.safeUse: 可用于 Posner 线索任务和注意定向类范式的网络级讲解。
sources.boundary: 不能直接推出 Schaefer200 某个点位在某个任务中激活，也不能用于个体诊断。

sources.title: Neural correlates of multiple object tracking strategies
sources.citation: Merkel C, Hopf JM, Schoenfeld MA. NeuroImage. 2015;118:63-73.
sources.useFor: Multiple-object tracking strategy source for attention-tracking and strategy-specific visual/dorsal attention candidates. Table 1 MNI ROI seed coordinates have been extracted as 21 review-level candidates; use for strategy refinement with Jovicich 2001.
sources.supports: MOT strategy ROI seeds support strategy-specific refinement for multiple-object tracking.
sources.safeUse: 可用于 MOT 未来策略分型，不替代 Jovicich 生产主干。
sources.boundary: ROI seed 坐标不能直接全部上主图；当前生产主干仍以 Jovicich 为准。

sources.title: Neuroplasticity: changes in grey matter induced by training
sources.citation: Draganski B, Gaser C, Busch V, Schuierer G, Bogdahn U, May A. Nature. 2004;427:311-312.
sources.useFor: Three-month juggling acquisition with repeated structural MRI in 24 young adults, showing transient grey-matter change in visual-motion and parietal regions.
sources.supports: 24名年轻成人中，学习三球杂耍的组在3个月后出现双侧hMT/V5和左后顶内沟灰质暂时增加，停止练习后的第三次扫描显示部分回落。
sources.safeUse: 可作为感知运动学习引起成人脑结构可塑性的经典背景证据，帮助解释训练剂量、持续练习和停止练习后的变化。
sources.boundary: 杂耍不是九项功能中的标准认知范式，也不是儿童学习训练；只能作为广义可塑性背景，不能证明推理、速度或表象能力会自动迁移。

sources.title: Cortical network modulations associated with prolonged training of the multiple object-tracking task
sources.citation: Felssberg AM, Schonemann N, Hopf JM, Schoenfeld MA, Merkel C. Imaging Neuroscience. 2025;3:imag_a_00577.
sources.useFor: Five-session multiple-object-tracking training over two weeks with pre/post task fMRI in 33 adults.
sources.supports: 训练后MOT表现提高，目标位置表征更多在视觉皮层巩固，额叶控制网络中的对象式表征作用相对变化；论文同时强调向其他任务的迁移有限。
sources.safeUse: 可用于多目标追踪训练的直接证据，并帮助设计目标数量、速度、干扰密度和追踪持续时间的渐进负荷。
sources.boundary: 成人任务特异训练、没有独立未训练对照组，且研究本身指出迁移有限；不能把MOT收益讲成一般注意力或运动表现提升。

paradigms.label: 持续注意/CPT
paradigms.englishLabel: Continuous performance or sustained attention task
paradigms.upgradeQuestion: 持续注意/CPT 是否能支撑警觉维持和冲动控制讲解？
paradigms.riskNote: TOVA/CPT 有多种版本；当前结论只支持 Schaefer200 皮层生产 overlay 的谨慎讲解，不代表所有 CPT/TOVA 版本共享完全相同点位。丘脑、壳核、小脑和脑干峰值仍保留为图谱外边界。

sources.title: Sustaining attention to simple tasks: A meta-analytic review of the neural mechanisms of vigilant attention
sources.citation: Langner R, Eickhoff SB. Psychological Bulletin. 2013;139(4):870-900.
sources.useFor: Sustained attention, vigilance, CPT/TOVA-style continuous monitoring, and attention-control boundaries.
sources.supports: 候选用于持续注意和警觉维持的元分析证据。
sources.safeUse: 可作为 CPT/TOVA 持续注意范式的核验入口。
sources.boundary: 不同 CPT/TOVA 版本差异较大，未复核全文前不做精确点位或单一通路声称。

sources.title: Control of goal-directed and stimulus-driven attention in the brain
sources.citation: Corbetta M, Shulman GL. Nature Reviews Neuroscience. 2002;3(3):201-215.
sources.useFor: Attention orienting, dorsal attention, ventral attention, cueing, and reorienting language.
sources.supports: 注意定向和重定向的综述级网络框架，尤其适合解释背侧目标导向注意与腹侧刺激驱动重定向。
sources.safeUse: 可用于 Posner 线索任务和注意定向类范式的网络级讲解。
sources.boundary: 不能直接推出 Schaefer200 某个点位在某个任务中激活，也不能用于个体诊断。

sources.title: Computerized training of working memory in children with ADHD: a randomized, controlled trial
sources.citation: Klingberg T, Fernell E, Olesen PJ, et al. J Am Acad Child Adolesc Psychiatry. 2005;44(2):177-186.
sources.useFor: Multicenter randomized double-blind comparison of adaptive versus low-dose working-memory practice in 53 children aged 7-12 with ADHD, with post-training and three-month follow-up outcomes.
sources.supports: 53名7至12岁ADHD儿童被随机分配到自适应工作记忆训练或低剂量比较训练；完成训练者在未训练的视空间广度任务上改善，并报告了部分抑制、推理和症状指标变化。
sources.safeUse: 可作为儿童工作记忆训练的随机对照行为证据，说明在特定临床样本、训练剂量和近任务条件下，工作记忆表现可能改善。
sources.boundary: 样本是未用兴奋剂的ADHD儿童，完成者只有44人；没有训练前后MRI终点，远迁移、日常功能和一般儿童效果不能据此确定。

sources.title: Cortical network modulations associated with prolonged training of the multiple object-tracking task
sources.citation: Felssberg AM, Schonemann N, Hopf JM, Schoenfeld MA, Merkel C. Imaging Neuroscience. 2025;3:imag_a_00577.
sources.useFor: Five-session multiple-object-tracking training over two weeks with pre/post task fMRI in 33 adults.
sources.supports: 训练后MOT表现提高，目标位置表征更多在视觉皮层巩固，额叶控制网络中的对象式表征作用相对变化；论文同时强调向其他任务的迁移有限。
sources.safeUse: 可用于多目标追踪训练的直接证据，并帮助设计目标数量、速度、干扰密度和追踪持续时间的渐进负荷。
sources.boundary: 成人任务特异训练、没有独立未训练对照组，且研究本身指出迁移有限；不能把MOT收益讲成一般注意力或运动表现提升。

paradigms.label: 双任务
paradigms.upgradeQuestion: 双任务应讲成分配注意，还是执行控制下的资源协调？
paradigms.riskNote: Dux 2006 不是 ordinary whole-brain peak table，而是个体局部 ROI 平均坐标；不要把本条讲成所有双任务的完整网络，也不要把右 pLPFC 标签异常、IPS 异常坐标、小脑和 IFG/ACC 比较 ROI 显示成核心点位。

sources.title: The unity and diversity of executive functions and their contributions to complex frontal lobe tasks
sources.citation: Miyake A, Friedman NP, Emerson MJ, Witzki AH, Howerter A, Wager TD. Cognitive Psychology. 2000;41(1):49-100.
sources.useFor: Executive-function task taxonomy, updating, inhibition, shifting, and keep-track boundaries.
sources.supports: 候选用于执行功能中更新、抑制、切换等任务分类边界。
sources.safeUse: 适合帮助区分 keep-track、双任务、切换和抑制任务的功能归属。
sources.boundary: 这是行为/认知结构来源，不是脑区定位来源；不能直接支持点位级脑区声称。

sources.title: Meta-analytic evidence for a superordinate cognitive control network subserving diverse executive functions
sources.citation: Niendam TA, Laird AR, Ray KL, Dean YM, Glahn DC, Carter CS. Cognitive, Affective, & Behavioral Neuroscience. 2012;12(2):241-268.
sources.useFor: Cross-task executive control, inhibition, switching, working-memory control, and frontoparietal claims.
sources.supports: 候选用于执行控制、冲突监控、抑制、切换和工作记忆控制的跨任务网络框架。
sources.safeUse: 可作为 Stroop、Flanker、任务切换和 Go/No-Go 的候选核验入口。
sources.boundary: 全文和任务清单未逐条复核前，不把它说成某个单一范式的专属证据。

sources.title: Context-specific activations are a hallmark of the neural basis of individual differences in common executive function
sources.citation: Reineberg AE, Banich MT, Wager TD, Friedman NP. NeuroImage. 2022;249:118845.
sources.useFor: Executive-function task battery and keep-track/common-EF context; local PDF/HTML/supplement review supports network/context evidence but not Schaefer200 point overlay.
sources.supports: 支持 Keep-track 作为扫描版执行功能更新任务，并提供大样本 common executive function / updating 背景。
sources.safeUse: 可用于说明 Keep-track 的任务结构：在 remember trials 中持续更新目标类别的最新项目，并与 read trials / fixation 形成 fMRI 对比。
sources.boundary: PMC 全文已入库，但正文未提供可直接抽取的群体峰值坐标表；NeuroVault 或原始 maps 未定位前，不能把它用于 Schaefer200 点位级 reviewed overlay。

sources.title: Isolation of a Central Bottleneck of Information Processing with Time-Resolved fMRI
sources.citation: Dux PE, Ivanoff J, Asplund CL, Marois R. Neuron. 2006;52(6):1109-1120.
sources.useFor: Dual-task central-bottleneck source for information-processing limits and response-selection delay. Table 1 has been extracted as review-level ROI mean Talairach coordinates plus an MNI-converted Schaefer200 trial mapping; use left pLPFC and SMFC cautiously as bottleneck candidates, not as ordinary whole-brain peak evidence.
sources.supports: Dual-task central bottleneck ROI coordinates support pLPFC and SMFC bottleneck candidates for dual-task and response-selection limits.
sources.safeUse: 可用于双任务/反应选择瓶颈边界，解释并行任务时的中心处理限制。
sources.boundary: ROI mean 不是普通 whole-brain peak；不能替代 ordinary choice RT 或 simple RT。

sources.title: Training improves multitasking performance by increasing the speed of information processing in human prefrontal cortex
sources.citation: Dux PE, Tombu MN, Harrison S, Rogers BP, Tong F, Marois R. Neuron. 2009;63(1):127-138.
sources.useFor: Two-week dual-task practice with three fMRI sessions, testing how multitasking costs and prefrontal information-processing dynamics change with training.
sources.supports: 7名成人在约2周、8次双任务练习后，双任务反应时成本由约400 ms降到约40 ms；fMRI结果支持左侧额下交界的信息处理时序加快。
sources.safeUse: 可用于说明双任务干扰可以在高度相似的任务条件下通过重复练习明显降低，并为并行任务训练中的反应选择、节奏和自动化设计提供机制依据。
sources.boundary: 样本只有7名成人，训练任务和测验高度相似，残余双任务成本仍存在；不能讲成多任务能力被彻底消除、可远迁移到学习成绩或适用于儿童。

paradigms.label: 伦敦塔规划任务
paradigms.upgradeQuestion: 伦敦塔规划任务能否作为执行功能中规划能力的主范式？
paradigms.riskNote: 规划任务涉及尾状核等皮层外结构；当前 Schaefer 图只能展示皮层候选伙伴，尾状核需要作为 atlas 边界提示，不能讲成 Schaefer200 点位。

sources.title: A Meta-analysis on the neural basis of planning: Activation likelihood estimation of functional brain imaging results in the Tower of London task
sources.citation: Nitschke K, Köstering L, Finkel L, Weiller C, Kaller CP. Human Brain Mapping. 2017;38(1):396-413.
sources.useFor: Tower of London planning and planning-complexity ALE clusters. Table 2 has been extracted into a coordinate-intake file and mapped to Schaefer200 cortical candidate parcels; caudate rows remain atlas-boundary evidence.
sources.supports: Tower of London 规划任务的坐标级 ALE 元分析证据；Table 2 报告 overall planning 和 planning complexity 的 MNI weighted centroids。
sources.safeUse: 可用于把伦敦塔规划任务展示为双侧 mid-DLPFC、FEF、SMA/pre-SMA、IPL/楔前叶、前岛叶和 RLPFC 共同参与的规划网络。
sources.boundary: 尾状核等皮层外结构不在当前 Schaefer200 皮层模型内；Table 2 是群体 ALE centroid，不是个体训练靶点，也不能替代 Stop-signal 或 Keep-track 专门证据。

sources.title: Planning and problem solving: From neuropsychology to functional neuroimaging
sources.citation: Unterrainer JM, Owen AM. Journal of Physiology-Paris. 2006;99(4-6):308-317.
sources.useFor: Tower of London, planning, and executive problem-solving review entry.
sources.supports: 候选用于计划、问题解决和伦敦塔类任务的神经影像综述入口。
sources.safeUse: 可作为伦敦塔规划任务的证据检索入口。
sources.boundary: 当前还没有完成 DOI 和全文边界复核；只作为候选来源。

sources.title: Meta-analytic evidence for a superordinate cognitive control network subserving diverse executive functions
sources.citation: Niendam TA, Laird AR, Ray KL, Dean YM, Glahn DC, Carter CS. Cognitive, Affective, & Behavioral Neuroscience. 2012;12(2):241-268.
sources.useFor: Cross-task executive control, inhibition, switching, working-memory control, and frontoparietal claims.
sources.supports: 候选用于执行控制、冲突监控、抑制、切换和工作记忆控制的跨任务网络框架。
sources.safeUse: 可作为 Stroop、Flanker、任务切换和 Go/No-Go 的候选核验入口。
sources.boundary: 全文和任务清单未逐条复核前，不把它说成某个单一范式的专属证据。

sources.title: Playing Super Mario induces structural brain plasticity: gray matter changes resulting from training with a commercial video game
sources.citation: Kuhn S, Gleich T, Lorenz RC, Lindenberger U, Gallinat J. Molecular Psychiatry. 2014;19(2):265-271.
sources.useFor: Training/neuroplasticity background for explaining why complex 3D spatial-action tasks may engage spatial navigation, strategic planning, working memory, and motor coordination systems. Local PDF is archived; keep out of coordinate overlays, diagnosis, and product-efficacy promises.
sources.supports: 2个月、每天至少30分钟的商业3D平台游戏训练组，在结构MRI中观察到右海马结构、右背外侧前额叶和双侧小脑灰质增加；论文把这些区域解释为与空间导航、策略规划、工作记忆和动作表现相关。
sources.safeUse: 可用于资料库、训练设计和家长讲解中的“复杂任务练习可能打到多个脑功能系统，并且大脑具有可塑性”的背景说明。适合连接表象/空间操作、执行功能、短时/工作记忆和动作协调，不作为某个具体范式的点位来源。
sources.boundary: 样本是成人纵向训练研究，任务是 Super Mario 类3D平台游戏；不能据此承诺本项目训练会让儿童脑区灰质增长，不能作为疗效、诊断、个体预测或生产3D点位证据。

paradigms.label: 保持追踪
paradigms.upgradeQuestion: 保持追踪应归为执行功能更新，还是短时记忆容量？
paradigms.riskNote: Keep-track 是执行功能更新范式，不应和简单数字广度混为一类；Reineberg 可支持网络层/讲法层，不支持 Schaefer200 点位级 overlay；Collette、Murty、Nee/Brown 支持 updating-family 或 hierarchical-context updating，不等同 keep-track 原范式；Rottschy 2012/N-back 坐标只能作为工作记忆更新背景，不能替代 Keep-track 专属点位。

sources.title: The unity and diversity of executive functions and their contributions to complex frontal lobe tasks
sources.citation: Miyake A, Friedman NP, Emerson MJ, Witzki AH, Howerter A, Wager TD. Cognitive Psychology. 2000;41(1):49-100.
sources.useFor: Executive-function task taxonomy, updating, inhibition, shifting, and keep-track boundaries.
sources.supports: 候选用于执行功能中更新、抑制、切换等任务分类边界。
sources.safeUse: 适合帮助区分 keep-track、双任务、切换和抑制任务的功能归属。
sources.boundary: 这是行为/认知结构来源，不是脑区定位来源；不能直接支持点位级脑区声称。

sources.title: Context-specific activations are a hallmark of the neural basis of individual differences in common executive function
sources.citation: Reineberg AE, Banich MT, Wager TD, Friedman NP. NeuroImage. 2022;249:118845.
sources.useFor: Executive-function task battery and keep-track/common-EF context; local PDF/HTML/supplement review supports network/context evidence but not Schaefer200 point overlay.
sources.supports: 支持 Keep-track 作为扫描版执行功能更新任务，并提供大样本 common executive function / updating 背景。
sources.safeUse: 可用于说明 Keep-track 的任务结构：在 remember trials 中持续更新目标类别的最新项目，并与 read trials / fixation 形成 fMRI 对比。
sources.boundary: PMC 全文已入库，但正文未提供可直接抽取的群体峰值坐标表；NeuroVault 或原始 maps 未定位前，不能把它用于 Schaefer200 点位级 reviewed overlay。

sources.title: Modelling neural correlates of working memory: A coordinate-based meta-analysis
sources.citation: Rottschy C, Langner R, Dogan I, et al. NeuroImage. 2012;60(1):830-846.
sources.useFor: Working-memory maintenance, manipulation, and short-term capacity claims.
sources.supports: 坐标元分析入口，用于工作记忆保持、操作、负荷和材料类型相关任务的候选脑区核验。
sources.safeUse: 可作为 N-back、数字广度、空间广度和物体广度的工作记忆复核入口，尤其用于拆分保持、操作和容量负荷。
sources.boundary: Rottschy 核心表已可作通用工作记忆候选背景，但不能替代材料专门证据；语言复述、空间位置保持、物体保持和容量瓶颈必须分开映射。

sources.title: Characterising the unity and diversity of executive functions in a within-subject fMRI study
sources.citation: Saylik R, Williams AL, Murphy RA, Szameitat AJ. Scientific Reports. 2022;12:8182.
sources.useFor: Within-subject fMRI comparison of updating, inhibition, switching and dual-tasking; Table 1 MNI conjunction peaks support common executive-function / updating boundaries, not keep-track original-task localization.
sources.supports: Within-subject executive-function source provides common-EF conjunction peaks and diversity/task-family framing.
sources.safeUse: Use as a compact common-EF candidate scaffold for updating/inhibition/shifting discussion.
sources.boundary: It is not a keep-track original paradigm source and should not replace task-specific updating, inhibition or switching coordinates.

sources.title: Exploring the unity and diversity of the neural substrates of executive functioning
sources.citation: Collette F, Van der Linden M, Laureys S, Delfiore G, Degueldre C, Luxen A, Salmon E. Human Brain Mapping. 2005;25(4):409-423.
sources.useFor: PET comparison of updating, shifting and inhibition. PMC tables archived/extracted; use Table I/II Talairach coordinates as executive updating/common-EF candidates after MNI conversion, not as keep-track original-task proof.
sources.supports: Executive-function PET/fMRI coordinate source supports common and diverse updating, inhibition and shifting candidates; local tables have been extracted and converted for updating-family review.
sources.safeUse: Use as one updating/common-EF candidate source alongside Murty, Nee/Brown and Saylik, especially for frontoparietal and medial control boundaries.
sources.boundary: Do not treat Collette as a keep-track original task or a production-reviewed overlay by itself; Talairach-derived rows require cross-source pruning.

sources.title: Selective updating of working memory content modulates meso-cortico-striatal activity
sources.citation: Murty VP, Sambataro F, Radulescu E, Altamura M, Iudicello J, Zoltick B, Weinberger DR, Goldberg TE, Mattay VS. NeuroImage. 2011;57(3):1264-1272.
sources.useFor: Selective working-memory updating source. PMC Table 2 MNI coordinates support updating > maintenance and updating > overwriting candidates; caudate/SN-VTA/cerebellum remain atlas-boundary evidence.
sources.supports: Flexible-updating task fMRI source supports updating and rule/context reconfiguration candidates in frontal, parietal and control regions.
sources.safeUse: Use for executive updating and working-memory updating candidate review with Collette and Nee/Brown.
sources.boundary: Do not equate flexible updating with all keep-track tasks or all short-term memory capacity tests.

sources.title: Dissociable Frontal-Striatal and Frontal-Parietal Networks Involved in Updating Hierarchical Contexts in Working Memory
sources.citation: Nee DE, Brown JW. Cerebral Cortex. 2013;23(9):2146-2158.
sources.useFor: Hierarchical context-updating fMRI source. PMC Tables 1-2 MNI coordinates support frontal-cingulate, frontal-parietal and frontostriatal updating boundaries, not keep-track original-task localization.
sources.supports: Hierarchical-context updating source supports nested context/rule updating candidates across frontal and parietal control systems.
sources.safeUse: Use to explain that updating can involve higher-order context/rule revision rather than only refreshing item contents.
sources.boundary: Do not present this as the definitive keep-track neural map; it is a context-updating candidate source.

sources.title: Computerized training of working memory in children with ADHD: a randomized, controlled trial
sources.citation: Klingberg T, Fernell E, Olesen PJ, et al. J Am Acad Child Adolesc Psychiatry. 2005;44(2):177-186.
sources.useFor: Multicenter randomized double-blind comparison of adaptive versus low-dose working-memory practice in 53 children aged 7-12 with ADHD, with post-training and three-month follow-up outcomes.
sources.supports: 53名7至12岁ADHD儿童被随机分配到自适应工作记忆训练或低剂量比较训练；完成训练者在未训练的视空间广度任务上改善，并报告了部分抑制、推理和症状指标变化。
sources.safeUse: 可作为儿童工作记忆训练的随机对照行为证据，说明在特定临床样本、训练剂量和近任务条件下，工作记忆表现可能改善。
sources.boundary: 样本是未用兴奋剂的ADHD儿童，完成者只有44人；没有训练前后MRI终点，远迁移、日常功能和一般儿童效果不能据此确定。

sources.title: The dynamics of change in striatal activity following updating training
sources.citation: Kühn S, Schmiedek F, Noack H, et al. Human Brain Mapping. 2013;34(7):1530-1541.
sources.useFor: Randomized intensive updating and spatial n-back training with active control, about 54 sessions, and three fMRI measurements.
sources.supports: 高强度组练习数字更新和空间n-back，纹状体活动随训练呈先升后降的动态变化，显示影像变化不是简单的单向增强。
sources.safeUse: 可用于解释工作记忆更新训练需要看训练进程、难度和时点，脑活动上升或下降都可能反映学习阶段变化。
sources.boundary: 成人高剂量训练、主动对照剂量不等价，且局部BOLD变化不是能力高低刻度；不能把纹状体变化转成个体诊断或儿童训练靶点。

sources.title: Plasticity of Executive Control through Task Switching Training in Adolescents
sources.citation: Zinke K, Einert M, Pfennig L, Kliegel M. Frontiers in Human Neuroscience. 2012;6:41.
sources.useFor: Three-session task-switching training in 80 adolescents with exercise and non-training comparison groups and explicit near/far-transfer tests.
sources.supports: 任务切换训练降低了训练内切换成本，并对相似切换任务的混合成本产生近迁移；远迁移仅限选择反应时和更新速度趋势。
sources.safeUse: 可用于说明青少年的任务切换成本可以通过少量针对性练习改善，但主要收益仍贴近训练结构。
sources.boundary: 没有MRI终点，训练只有3次，远迁移有限；不能把切换训练讲成普遍提升工作记忆、抑制或学业表现。

paradigms.label: 物体广度
paradigms.upgradeQuestion: 物体广度能否补足视觉短时记忆容量演示？
paradigms.riskNote: 生产讲法限定为视觉物体短时保持：Courtney 支撑腹侧视觉/梭状和右额叶控制，Rottschy 只作通用容量背景；不能讲成诊断级物体广度靶点或所有儿童训练任务的唯一网络。

sources.title: Object and Spatial Visual Working Memory Activate Separate Neural Systems in Human Cortex
sources.citation: Courtney SM, Ungerleider LG, Keil K, Haxby JV. Cerebral Cortex. 1996;6(1):39-49.
sources.useFor: Object versus spatial visual working-memory dissociation; useful for grid span and object-span boundaries.
sources.supports: 物体与空间视觉工作记忆分离的神经影像来源，可用于空间广度和物体广度的边界。
sources.safeUse: 用于解释空间广度不是所有视觉短时记忆，也不是物体形状保持；应优先核空间位置保持网络。
sources.boundary: 需要全文坐标后才能判断哪些 Schaefer200 parcel 可被显示；当前只作为候选来源。

sources.title: Modelling neural correlates of working memory: A coordinate-based meta-analysis
sources.citation: Rottschy C, Langner R, Dogan I, et al. NeuroImage. 2012;60(1):830-846.
sources.useFor: Working-memory maintenance, manipulation, and short-term capacity claims.
sources.supports: 坐标元分析入口，用于工作记忆保持、操作、负荷和材料类型相关任务的候选脑区核验。
sources.safeUse: 可作为 N-back、数字广度、空间广度和物体广度的工作记忆复核入口，尤其用于拆分保持、操作和容量负荷。
sources.boundary: Rottschy 核心表已可作通用工作记忆候选背景，但不能替代材料专门证据；语言复述、空间位置保持、物体保持和容量瓶颈必须分开映射。

sources.title: Dissociating Verbal and Spatial Working Memory Using PET
sources.citation: Smith EE, Jonides J, Koeppe RA. Cerebral Cortex. 1996;6(1):11-20.
sources.useFor: Verbal versus spatial working-memory dissociation; boundary source for digit-span versus spatial/grid-span overlays.
sources.supports: 言语工作记忆和空间工作记忆分离的 PET 研究入口，可用于数字广度与空间广度的边界对照。
sources.safeUse: 用于说明数字广度和空间广度不能共享同一套点位；一个偏语音序列，一个偏空间位置保持。
sources.boundary: 全文坐标未映射前，只能作为任务族边界来源，不把左右顶叶或额叶点位讲成最终定位。

sources.title: Computerized training of working memory in children with ADHD: a randomized, controlled trial
sources.citation: Klingberg T, Fernell E, Olesen PJ, et al. J Am Acad Child Adolesc Psychiatry. 2005;44(2):177-186.
sources.useFor: Multicenter randomized double-blind comparison of adaptive versus low-dose working-memory practice in 53 children aged 7-12 with ADHD, with post-training and three-month follow-up outcomes.
sources.supports: 53名7至12岁ADHD儿童被随机分配到自适应工作记忆训练或低剂量比较训练；完成训练者在未训练的视空间广度任务上改善，并报告了部分抑制、推理和症状指标变化。
sources.safeUse: 可作为儿童工作记忆训练的随机对照行为证据，说明在特定临床样本、训练剂量和近任务条件下，工作记忆表现可能改善。
sources.boundary: 样本是未用兴奋剂的ADHD儿童，完成者只有44人；没有训练前后MRI终点，远迁移、日常功能和一般儿童效果不能据此确定。

sources.title: The dynamics of change in striatal activity following updating training
sources.citation: Kühn S, Schmiedek F, Noack H, et al. Human Brain Mapping. 2013;34(7):1530-1541.
sources.useFor: Randomized intensive updating and spatial n-back training with active control, about 54 sessions, and three fMRI measurements.
sources.supports: 高强度组练习数字更新和空间n-back，纹状体活动随训练呈先升后降的动态变化，显示影像变化不是简单的单向增强。
sources.safeUse: 可用于解释工作记忆更新训练需要看训练进程、难度和时点，脑活动上升或下降都可能反映学习阶段变化。
sources.boundary: 成人高剂量训练、主动对照剂量不等价，且局部BOLD变化不是能力高低刻度；不能把纹状体变化转成个体诊断或儿童训练靶点。

sources.title: The capacity of visual working memory for features and conjunctions
sources.citation: Luck SJ, Vogel EK. Nature. 1997;390:279-281.
sources.useFor: Primary behavioral source for visual working-memory capacity and integrated-object rather than independent-feature storage.
sources.supports: 参与者短暂观看由颜色、方向等特征构成的阵列，经过空屏后判断是否变化。研究显示，大约四个整合物体可以被短暂保持；同一物体包含多个特征时，表现没有按特征总数成比例下降。
sources.safeUse: 可用于解释物体广度测量的是有限数量的整合视觉对象，以及颜色、方向、大小等特征为什么会以物体为单位绑定。
sources.boundary: 四个是该组成人实验和材料下的容量估计，不是所有年龄、材料和个体的固定上限，也不能直接换算成儿童学习能力等级。

sources.title: Change Detection: Training and Transfer
sources.citation: Gaspar JG, Neider MB, Simons DJ, McCarley JS, Kramer AF. PLoS ONE. 2013;8(6):e67781.
sources.useFor: Direct adaptive object-change training source with active controls and explicit near- and broader-transfer tests.
sources.supports: 40名年轻成人和40名老年成人分别进入变化检测训练或电脑纸牌主动对照。训练组完成16次、每次一小时的自适应练习，在三或五个汽车、标志、形状、字母物体中找变化。训练后的编码速度提高，但更换为彩条的一次性变化检测和真实驾驶场景闪烁变化检测都没有优于对照组。
sources.safeUse: 可用于说明物体变化检测练习能够提高训练材料上的速度和准确性，同时提醒读者把原任务进步、换材料迁移和真实情境迁移分开检验。
sources.boundary: 样本是成人，训练剂量很高，且自适应变量主要是编码时间。不能把结果外推为儿童物体广度训练处方，也不能把熟悉训练材料后的进步写成视觉工作记忆容量普遍提升。

paradigms.label: 概率反转学习
paradigms.upgradeQuestion: 概率反转学习能否支撑认知灵活性和反馈学习的演示？
paradigms.riskNote: 当前只能显示皮层反馈学习伙伴，不能说已经显示完整 OFC-纹状体奖励学习环路。

sources.title: Defining the Neural Mechanisms of Probabilistic Reversal Learning Using Event-Related Functional Magnetic Resonance Imaging
sources.citation: Cools R, Clark L, Owen AM, Robbins TW. The Journal of Neuroscience. 2002;22(11):4563-4567.
sources.useFor: Probabilistic reversal learning, feedback learning, cognitive flexibility, and OFC/control-network candidate language.
sources.supports: 支持概率反转学习作为反馈学习和认知灵活性任务，并提供 OFC/控制相关神经影像入口。
sources.safeUse: 可用于讲解规则改变后大脑如何利用反馈调整选择策略。
sources.boundary: 尚未逐坐标映射；且当前 Schaefer200 不覆盖纹状体，不能讲成完整奖赏-基底节环路。

paradigms.label: 时间顺序判断
paradigms.upgradeQuestion: 时间顺序判断是否可以作为反应速度中的时间排序范式？
paradigms.riskNote: 时间顺序判断可到生产级，但不能代表简单反应时、选择反应时、符号搜索或知觉辨别 RT。丘脑等皮层外点仍只作为 atlas-boundary。

sources.title: Temporal Order Judgments Activate Temporal Parietal Junction
sources.citation: Davis B, Christie J, Rorden C. The Journal of Neuroscience. 2009;29(10):3182-3188.
sources.useFor: Temporal order judgment, event timing, and TPJ/IPS/FEF/IFG/SMA candidate mapping boundaries. Tables 1 and 2 have been extracted into a coordinate-intake file; Table 2 thalamus is retained as atlas-boundary evidence.
sources.supports: 支持时间顺序判断任务和 TPJ 参与事件先后排序的候选证据。
sources.safeUse: 可用于反应速度/判断速度中“先后顺序判断”的范式身份和 TPJ 候选讲法。
sources.boundary: 当前显示的 TPJ 是 Schaefer200 代理分区，不能等同论文坐标。

sources.title: Sequence Memory in the Hippocampal-Entorhinal Region
sources.citation: Bellmund JLS, Deuker L, Schröder TN, Doeller CF. Journal of Cognitive Neuroscience. 2020;32(11):2056-2070.
sources.useFor: Hippocampal-entorhinal sequence memory mechanism source for episodic order and temporal sequence boundaries. Local PDF review found no numeric MNI/Talairach coordinate table; use it to justify MTL/entorhinal atlas language, not direct Schaefer200 point overlays.
sources.supports: Hippocampal-entorhinal sequence-memory review supports MTL/entorhinal mechanism language for episodic order and temporal sequence memory.
sources.safeUse: 可用于事件顺序/情景顺序记忆的 MTL/海马-内嗅机制边界。
sources.boundary: 本地复核未发现数字 MNI/Talairach 坐标表；不能作为 Schaefer200 点位来源。

sources.title: Do brain-training programs work?
sources.citation: Simons DJ, Boot WR, Charness N, et al. Psychological Science in the Public Interest. 2016;17(3):103-186.
sources.useFor: Comprehensive methods-and-transfer review of task/game-based brain-training evidence and the study-design standards needed for credible efficacy claims.
sources.supports: 综合评估认为，训练任务本身的改善证据很多，接近任务的迁移证据较少，远距离任务和日常认知表现的改善证据很少；许多研究还存在控制、盲法、样本和分析问题。
sources.safeUse: 可作为九项功能共同的证据边界：先讲训练内容、样本、剂量和直接结果，再单独证明是否迁移到真实学习。
sources.boundary: 它评估的是外部脑训练研究，不证明本项目无效或有效；具体训练仍需自己的对照、随访、真实任务和产品级验证。

paradigms.label: 语义任务
paradigms.upgradeQuestion: 语义任务能否补足阅读能力和长时语义记忆的分布式语义系统演示层？
paradigms.riskNote: 当前 reviewed_parcel 只表示阅读/长时记忆中“左侧语言语义任务链路”可演示；不要讲成完整 Binder 2009 语义系统、完整语言网络、个体诊断图谱或儿童训练因果证据。

sources.title: Where Is the Semantic System? A Critical Review and Meta-Analysis of 120 Functional Neuroimaging Studies
sources.citation: Binder JR, Desai RH, Graves WW, Conant LL. Cerebral Cortex. 2009;19(12):2767-2796.
sources.useFor: Semantic task, reading comprehension, temporal semantic cortex, angular/inferior parietal, and semantic-control boundaries.
sources.supports: 支持语义系统为分布式网络，涉及颞叶、下顶叶和前额叶语义控制等候选区域。
sources.safeUse: 可用于阅读理解和长时语义记忆中的语义系统层级讲解。
sources.boundary: 元分析支持分布式系统，不支持把语义压缩为单个点位。

sources.title: Conflict control during sentence comprehension: fMRI evidence
sources.citation: Ye Z, Zhou X. NeuroImage. 2009;48(1):280-290.
sources.useFor: Sentence comprehension conflict-control source for semantic/syntactic conflict, reading comprehension and executive-control overlap. Tables 2/4 have been extracted into 28 MNI candidate coordinates; Table 3 is comparator context only.
sources.supports: Sentence conflict-control coordinates support IFG, temporal language/context and control-network candidates for sentence comprehension and semantic conflict.
sources.safeUse: 可用于句子理解中语义/句法冲突与执行控制重叠的讲法。
sources.boundary: Table 3 只作 Stroop/Flanker 比较背景；不要把句子冲突直接等同 Stroop 冲突。

sources.title: Meta-analyzing left hemisphere language areas: phonology, semantics, and sentence processing
sources.citation: Vigneau M, Beaucousin V, Hervé PY, et al. NeuroImage. 2006;30(4):1414-1432.
sources.useFor: Language meta-analysis source separating phonology, semantics and sentence processing in left-hemisphere language areas. Table 4 has been extracted into 30 MNI cluster-mean candidate coordinates: 11 phonological, 11 semantic and 8 sentence-processing clusters.
sources.supports: 左半球语言区域中音韵、语义和句子加工的元分析候选证据；Table 4 已抽取 30 个 MNI cluster mean。
sources.safeUse: 可作为 `sentence-comprehension`、`semantic-task` 和 `phonological-decoding` 的语言分层坐标候选来源。
sources.boundary: Vigneau 是元分析 cluster mean，不是儿童训练因果证据或精确语言 atlas；生产 overlay 仍需与 Taylor、Jobard、Cohen、Constable、Ye & Zhou 和 Binder/Price 交叉裁剪。

sources.title: Do brain-training programs work?
sources.citation: Simons DJ, Boot WR, Charness N, et al. Psychological Science in the Public Interest. 2016;17(3):103-186.
sources.useFor: Comprehensive methods-and-transfer review of task/game-based brain-training evidence and the study-design standards needed for credible efficacy claims.
sources.supports: 综合评估认为，训练任务本身的改善证据很多，接近任务的迁移证据较少，远距离任务和日常认知表现的改善证据很少；许多研究还存在控制、盲法、样本和分析问题。
sources.safeUse: 可作为九项功能共同的证据边界：先讲训练内容、样本、剂量和直接结果，再单独证明是否迁移到真实学习。
sources.boundary: 它评估的是外部脑训练研究，不证明本项目无效或有效；具体训练仍需自己的对照、随访、真实任务和产品级验证。

sources.title: The Effects of Instruction Using Semantic Mapping on Vocabulary and Comprehension
sources.citation: Margosein CM, Pascarella ET, Pflaum SW. The Journal of Early Adolescence. 1982;2(2):185-194.
sources.useFor: Randomized junior-high vocabulary study comparing semantic mapping with context-rich definition instruction. Use for vocabulary and semantic-relation learning, not broad comprehension transfer.
sources.supports: 44名初中生被随机分到丰富语境释义或语义映射教学；把新词与已知相关词比较异同的语义映射组，在周测、后测和标准化一般词汇测验上表现更好。
sources.safeUse: 可用于语义训练的具体形式：把新概念放进类别、特征、相似点和区别组成的关系网，再用新语境检索。
sources.boundary: 可核验结果主要是词汇学习，不能把题名中的 comprehension 直接扩写成篇章理解、学科成绩或长期保持；当前没有脑成像结论。

paradigms.label: DRM 词表假记忆
paradigms.upgradeQuestion: DRM 词表假记忆是否适合演示长时记忆中的语义重构？
paradigms.riskNote: Thakral 2025 是 false-recognition 元分析，Slotnick 2004 是形状材料 true-vs-false recognition 研究，Kim & Cabeza 2007 是改造 categorical false-memory encoding/formation 任务；三者都不能被讲成单一 DRM primary-task 坐标或一个固定假记忆中心。Slotnick/Kim-Cabeza 的海马、海马旁、尾状核、丘脑和小脑都需要专门图谱边界，不硬塞进 Schaefer200。

sources.title: Creating false memories: Remembering words not presented in lists
sources.citation: Roediger HL, McDermott KB. Journal of Experimental Psychology: Learning, Memory, and Cognition. 1995;21(4):803-814.
sources.useFor: DRM false-memory task identity, semantic gist, false recognition, and source-monitoring caution.
sources.supports: 支持 DRM 作为语义相关词表诱发假记忆的经典行为范式。
sources.safeUse: 可用于讲解长时记忆会受到语义 gist 和来源监控影响。
sources.boundary: 这是行为范式来源，不直接支持脑区点位，需要另配神经影像文献。

sources.title: Where Is the Semantic System? A Critical Review and Meta-Analysis of 120 Functional Neuroimaging Studies
sources.citation: Binder JR, Desai RH, Graves WW, Conant LL. Cerebral Cortex. 2009;19(12):2767-2796.
sources.useFor: Semantic task, reading comprehension, temporal semantic cortex, angular/inferior parietal, and semantic-control boundaries.
sources.supports: 支持语义系统为分布式网络，涉及颞叶、下顶叶和前额叶语义控制等候选区域。
sources.safeUse: 可用于阅读理解和长时语义记忆中的语义系统层级讲解。
sources.boundary: 元分析支持分布式系统，不支持把语义压缩为单个点位。

sources.title: Are False Memory and Creative Thinking Mediated by Common Neural Substrates? An fMRI Meta-Analysis
sources.citation: Thakral PP, Starkey CC, Devitt AL, Schacter DL. Creativity Research Journal. 2025;37(1):6-21.
sources.useFor: False-recognition neural substrate meta-analysis candidate. PMC full text Table 3 ALE false-recognition peaks have been extracted into coordinate intake; use cautiously for DRM-family false recognition and do not overclaim creativity/false-memory conjunction.
sources.supports: Thakral/Schacter 2025 Table 3 报告 false-recognition ALE 坐标；本项目已把左 IPS/楔前叶、左角回/IPL 和左扣带/额内侧峰值裁剪成 DRM-family 错误再认演示层。
sources.safeUse: 可用于说明 DRM/假再认中语义 gist 可能带来错误熟悉感，随后需要后顶叶证据整合和额内侧监控复核；展示时必须说成 false-recognition 元分析支持的谨慎演示层。
sources.boundary: 不能说这是单一 DRM primary-task 坐标，也不能说假记忆和创造力共享同一个核心网络；Slotnick 2004 已补 true-vs-false sensory specificity 候选，Kim & Cabeza 2007 已补 formation-stage 候选，但海马/MTL 仍需专门图谱边界。

sources.title: A sensory signature that distinguishes true from false memories
sources.citation: Slotnick SD, Schacter DL. Nature Neuroscience. 2004;7(6):664-672.
sources.useFor: True versus false recognition evidence for sensory-perceptual reactivation and false-memory boundaries. Tables 1-3 have been extracted into Talairach and MNI-converted coordinate intake with 73 cortical review candidates and caudate/thalamus/hippocampus boundary rows.
sources.supports: True versus false recognition coordinates support sensory reactivation and caudate/thalamus/hippocampus boundary evidence for false-memory refinement.
sources.safeUse: 可用于 DRM/假记忆精修中说明 true-vs-false recognition 的感觉再激活差异。
sources.boundary: 不是 DRM primary-task 坐标；海马、丘脑和尾状核需要专门图谱，不能直接塞入 Schaefer200 主图。

sources.title: Differential Contributions of Prefrontal, Medial Temporal, and Sensory-Perceptual Regions to True and False Memory Formation
sources.citation: Kim H, Cabeza R. Cerebral Cortex. 2007;17(9):2143-2150.
sources.useFor: True/false memory formation source separating PFC, MTL and sensory-perceptual contributions.
sources.supports: True/false memory formation coordinates support PFC, MTL and sensory-perceptual boundary refinement for false-memory formation.
sources.safeUse: 可用于 DRM/假记忆形成阶段解释 PFC、感觉再激活和 MTL 边界。
sources.boundary: 不是单一 DRM primary task；MTL、丘脑和小脑仍需专门图谱。

paradigms.label: 演绎推理
paradigms.upgradeQuestion: 演绎推理是否能作为推理能力的主范式之一？
paradigms.riskNote: 生产讲法仅限语言命题/规则型演绎推理；不要泛化成所有抽象逻辑、瑞文矩阵、几何证明或课堂概率统计。尾状核、丘脑、MTL/海马旁、杏仁核和小脑仍是 atlas 外边界，不能硬映射为 Schaefer200 皮层点。

sources.title: The dynamics of deductive reasoning: An fMRI investigation
sources.citation: Rodriguez-Moreno D, Hirsch J. Neuropsychologia. 2009;47(4):949-961.
sources.useFor: Deductive reasoning, premise processing, rule inference, and frontoparietal/language-control candidate mapping.
sources.supports: 支持演绎推理 fMRI 任务作为规则推导和前提处理的候选神经影像来源；用户补入 PDF 后，Table 2 已抽取 Talairach 峰值、转 MNI 并完成 Schaefer200 最近点候选映射。
sources.safeUse: 可用于推理能力中“根据前提推出结论”的演示入口，先作为 70% 坐标候选展示额顶控制、顶叶关系工作区和规则/结论检查。
sources.boundary: 演绎推理材料差异较大；premise integration、conclusion validation 和尾状核/丘脑边界还要人工裁剪，不能直接讲成所有逻辑推理的 100% 点位。

sources.title: New Evidence for Distinct Right and Left Brain Systems for Deductive versus Probabilistic Reasoning
sources.citation: Parsons LM, Osherson DN. Cerebral Cortex. 2001;11(10):954-965.
sources.useFor: Deductive versus probabilistic reasoning PET source with Talairach Table 1 coordinates. Use as candidate evidence for differentiating right-hemisphere deductive-rule processing from left IFG/posterior-cingulate/MTL probabilistic-world-knowledge evaluation; requires modern task-fMRI cross-source review before production overlay.
sources.supports: 演绎与概率推理 PET 坐标候选，可用于推理能力中 deductive versus probabilistic reasoning 的任务边界。
sources.safeUse: 可用于补强推理演示中的演绎/概率判断差异，并与 Kroger、Bunge、Rodriguez、Hampshire 交叉裁剪。
sources.boundary: 早期 PET 坐标需要转换和人工复核；不能单独升为所有推理范式的 reviewed parcel。

sources.title: At the core of reasoning: Dissociating deductive and non-deductive load
sources.citation: Coetzee JP, Monti MM. Human Brain Mapping. 2018;39(4):1850-1861.
sources.useFor: Reasoning complexity and memory-complexity contrast source for separating deductive reasoning load from non-deductive memory load.
sources.supports: Deductive reasoning complexity and reasoning-over-memory contrasts support left frontal rule integration, medial frontal/pre-SMA monitoring and parietal relational workspace.
sources.safeUse: 可用于演绎推理生产图的前额-顶叶-中线监控主干。
sources.boundary: Tables 2/4 是非演绎/记忆负荷边界，不应混入演绎推理核心；小脑行留作 atlas-boundary。

sources.title: Probabilistic and deductive reasoning in the human brain
sources.citation: Gazzo Castañeda LE, Sklarek B, Dal Mas DE, et al. NeuroImage. 2023;275:120180.
sources.useFor: Modern fMRI source contrasting probabilistic and deductive reasoning. Tables 1-3 have been extracted into coordinate intake: cortical deductive/probabilistic peaks are Schaefer200 candidates, while hippocampal ROI/SVC rows stay as MTL atlas-boundary evidence.
sources.supports: Modern probabilistic versus deductive reasoning fMRI supports right IFC, dACC/mCC and parietal/precuneus deductive candidates plus vmPFC/insula/MTL probability candidates.
sources.safeUse: 可用于演绎推理生产图的右额/中线补强，并为概率判断保留候选边界。
sources.boundary: 概率分支不能直接讲成课堂概率统计；hippocampal ROI/SVC 行必须走 MTL 专门图谱。

sources.title: Differential effects of reasoning and speed training in children
sources.citation: Mackey AP, Hill SS, Stone SI, Bunge SA. Developmental Science. 2011;14(3):582-590.
sources.useFor: Eight-week randomized comparison of reasoning games versus processing-speed games in 28 children aged 7-9 from low socioeconomic backgrounds.
sources.supports: 28名7至9岁儿童分别接受8周推理训练或加工速度训练；推理组主要改善非言语推理测验，速度组主要改善编码速度，显示训练收益与所练任务成分有选择性。
sources.safeUse: 可用于说明儿童的推理和加工速度表现具有可训练性，而且训练效果更可能先出现在与训练内容接近的任务上。
sources.boundary: 样本小、没有无训练控制组、部分评估未完全盲法，也没有MRI终点；论文中的大效应不能当作一般儿童、智商或学业提升的稳定估计。

paradigms.label: 面孔-姓名联结
paradigms.upgradeQuestion: 面孔-姓名联结能否作为长时记忆中最直观的联结绑定演示，同时安全显示海马而不伪装成 Schaefer 点位？
paradigms.riskNote: 海马是物理辅助层，不是 Schaefer200 点位；梭状回候选点也不是 face-selective localizer 精确定位。生产级讲法只允许说成面孔-姓名联结的候选演示网络。

sources.title: Putting names to faces:
sources.citation: Sperling R, Chua E, Cocchiarella A, et al. NeuroImage. 2003;20(2):1400-1410.
sources.useFor: Face-name associative encoding fMRI; candidate for hippocampal/MTL binding, face visual input, and prefrontal strategy language.
sources.supports: 候选支持 face-name associative encoding 中面孔、姓名与海马/内侧颞叶联结绑定的任务身份和 fMRI 入口。
sources.safeUse: 可用于说明面孔-姓名联结需要把视觉人脸和语义姓名绑定成长期关联。
sources.boundary: 全文坐标未抽取前，不讲具体 Schaefer 点位；海马必须保持为物理辅助层。

sources.title: Evidence for a specific role of the anterior hippocampal region in successful associative encoding
sources.citation: Chua EF, Schacter DL, Rand-Giovannetti E, Sperling RA. Hippocampus. 2007;17(11):1071-1080.
sources.useFor: Face-name associative encoding and anterior hippocampal associative-memory support; MNI1305 anterior hippocampal and parahippocampal/perirhinal boundary coordinates have been extracted for the specialized MTL atlas route.
sources.supports: 候选支持 anterior hippocampal formation 对成功 face-name 联结编码的贡献。
sources.safeUse: 可用于增强面孔-姓名联结中海马绑定层的证据优先级。
sources.boundary: 需要全文坐标和任务细节复核，不能直接当成坐标级最终证据。

sources.title: Dynamics of the Hippocampus During Encoding and Retrieval of Face-Name Pairs
sources.citation: Zeineh MM, Engel SA, Thompson PM, Bookheimer SY. Science. 2003;299(5606):577-580.
sources.useFor: High-resolution face-name associative-learning source for CA2/3-DG encoding, posterior-subiculum retrieval, and MTL subfield boundary language. SOM Figure S1 whole-brain recall foci can support cautious recall-success cortical candidates.
sources.supports: Science 主文和 SOM 支持 face-name 联结学习中的 CA2/3-DG 编码和 posterior subiculum 提取机制；SOM Figure S1 提供 6 个 whole-brain recall-success 候选焦点。
sources.safeUse: 可用于把面孔-姓名联结讲成 MTL/海马亚区内部也有编码与提取分工；皮层候选焦点只作 recall-success 辅助，不替代主 MTL 机制。
sources.boundary: CA2/3、齿状回、下托、内嗅、嗅周和海马旁边界来自研究自有 hippocampal-unfolding 模板，不能强行映射为 Schaefer200 皮层点。

sources.title: Multiple routes to memory: Distinct medial temporal lobe processes build item and source memories
sources.citation: Davachi L, Mitchell JP, Wagner AD. Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences. 2003;100(4):2157-2162.
sources.useFor: Task fMRI source separating item recognition from source recollection during encoding. Use for associative-memory and source-memory atlas-boundary language; MTL peaks remain outside the current cortical Schaefer200 display.
sources.supports: PNAS task fMRI 来源，区分 item recognition 与 source recollection 的编码机制，并指出海马/后海马旁等 MTL 对来源回忆更关键。
sources.safeUse: 可用于联想记忆和来源记忆的任务身份、MTL 边界和海马不能硬塞进 Schaefer200 的说明。
sources.boundary: PDF 已入库，但主要关键结构在内侧颞叶；当前皮层模型只能显示语义线索、下顶叶提取和前额叶监控代理层。

sources.title: Activation and effective connectivity changes following explicit-memory training for face-name pairs in patients with mild cognitive impairment: a pilot study
sources.citation: Hampstead BM, Stringer AY, Stilla RF, et al. Neurorehabilitation and Neural Repair. 2011;25(3):210-222.
sources.useFor: Pilot explicit-memory training study with three face-name mnemonic sessions and pre/post fMRI in six patients with amnestic multidomain MCI.
sources.supports: 训练项目在行为上改善，并伴随训练项目特异的分布式激活和连接增加；助记策略将面部特征、语言线索与心理表象结合。
sources.safeUse: 可用于面孔-姓名联结和联想记忆训练的策略机制：把难记的配对转成显著视觉特征、语言钩子和可回想图像。
sources.boundary: 只有6名MCI患者、无独立对照组，属于先导研究；不能外推到健康儿童、所有情景记忆或海马结构变化。

paradigms.label: 事件顺序/情景顺序记忆
paradigms.upgradeQuestion: 事件/情景顺序记忆能否独立于毫秒级时间顺序判断，作为长期情景组织和步骤顺序演示？
paradigms.riskNote: Konishi 2002 只能讲词序列近因/temporal-order retrieval；Kumaran 2006 只能讲 unexpected-sequence / mismatch detection；Tubridy 2011 只能讲词三联体顺序编码的 MTL/海马边界；Ezzyat 2014 只能讲 temporal-proximity/context-boundary pattern similarity；Bellmund 2020 和 Hsieh 2014 是 MTL/海马机制边界，不生成 Schaefer200 皮层点。不能把这组证据讲成完整真实生活事件顺序、故事顺序、个体诊断或训练因果靶点。

sources.title: Neural correlates of recency judgment
sources.citation: Konishi S, Uchida I, Okuaki T, Machida T, Shirouzu I, Miyashita Y. The Journal of Neuroscience. 2002;22(21):9549-9555.
sources.useFor: Recency judgment / temporal-order retrieval fMRI source with PMC full text. Table 1 reports HIGH minus LOW demand peaks for temporal-order retrieval; use for episodic-order-memory as sequence/recency retrieval evidence, not for millisecond perceptual temporal-order judgment.
sources.supports: 支持词序列近因判断和 temporal-order retrieval 的任务 fMRI 证据。Table 1 报告 HIGH minus LOW 检索需求的皮层峰值，并保留双侧内侧颞叶、丘脑/尾状、脑干和小脑边界。
sources.safeUse: 可用于把事件/情景顺序记忆中的“顺序检索、上下文排序、前额叶监控”推进到坐标候选层，尤其是 DLPFC/IFG、内侧额叶、顶叶和视觉/运动输出链路。
sources.boundary: 这不是故事情景顺序或真实生活事件排序的完整证据，也不是毫秒级时间顺序判断；坐标空间需继续复核，因为方法段写 MNI template，而图注使用 Talairach 切片语言。

sources.title: An Unexpected Sequence of Events: Mismatch Detection in the Human Hippocampus
sources.citation: Kumaran D, Maguire EA. PLoS Biology. 2006;4(12):e424.
sources.useFor: Unexpected event-sequence / mismatch-detection fMRI source. PLOS Table S1 was downloaded and extracted into MNI coordinate intake: use cortical rows as episodic-order candidates and MTL rows as specialized-atlas boundary evidence.
sources.supports: Unexpected-sequence event fMRI source supports mismatch/sequence-memory candidates and MTL boundary rows for episodic-order memory.
sources.safeUse: Use for cautious event/sequence memory narration, especially unexpected sequence mismatch and MTL boundary language.
sources.boundary: Do not equate this with full autobiographical or story event-order memory; MTL rows require specialized atlas handling.

sources.title: The hippocampus, ventromedial prefrontal cortex, and episodic and semantic memory
sources.citation: Rolls ET. Progress in Neurobiology. 2022;217:102334.
sources.useFor: Hippocampus/vmPFC episodic and semantic memory framework; use for event-order/schema/context boundary language, not coordinates.
sources.supports: 综述级支持海马、vmPFC、情景记忆、语义记忆和 schema/context 的框架语言。
sources.safeUse: 可用于事件/情景顺序记忆的框架说明和边界提示。
sources.boundary: 综述不能替代具体事件顺序任务 fMRI 坐标。

sources.title: Multiple routes to memory: Distinct medial temporal lobe processes build item and source memories
sources.citation: Davachi L, Mitchell JP, Wagner AD. Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences. 2003;100(4):2157-2162.
sources.useFor: Task fMRI source separating item recognition from source recollection during encoding. Use for associative-memory and source-memory atlas-boundary language; MTL peaks remain outside the current cortical Schaefer200 display.
sources.supports: PNAS task fMRI 来源，区分 item recognition 与 source recollection 的编码机制，并指出海马/后海马旁等 MTL 对来源回忆更关键。
sources.safeUse: 可用于联想记忆和来源记忆的任务身份、MTL 边界和海马不能硬塞进 Schaefer200 的说明。
sources.boundary: PDF 已入库，但主要关键结构在内侧颞叶；当前皮层模型只能显示语义线索、下顶叶提取和前额叶监控代理层。

sources.title: Executive control during episodic retrieval: multiple prefrontal processes subserve source memory
sources.citation: Dobbins IG, Foley H, Schacter DL, Wagner AD. Neuron. 2002;35(5):989-996.
sources.useFor: Task fMRI source for prefrontal control during episodic/source retrieval. Use for source-monitoring and retrieval-control claims; full text still needs institution access.
sources.supports: 候选用于来源记忆中前额叶控制、提取策略和来源监控的任务 fMRI 证据。
sources.safeUse: 可用于说明 source-memory 不只是再认，还需要前额叶参与来源判断和控制检索。
sources.boundary: 当前只完成元数据核验，Neuron 全文仍需机构权限；不能把 DLPFC 点位讲成已由该文坐标复核。

sources.title: Sequence Memory in the Hippocampal-Entorhinal Region
sources.citation: Bellmund JLS, Deuker L, Schröder TN, Doeller CF. Journal of Cognitive Neuroscience. 2020;32(11):2056-2070.
sources.useFor: Hippocampal-entorhinal sequence memory mechanism source for episodic order and temporal sequence boundaries. Local PDF review found no numeric MNI/Talairach coordinate table; use it to justify MTL/entorhinal atlas language, not direct Schaefer200 point overlays.
sources.supports: Hippocampal-entorhinal sequence-memory review supports MTL/entorhinal mechanism language for episodic order and temporal sequence memory.
sources.safeUse: 可用于事件顺序/情景顺序记忆的 MTL/海马-内嗅机制边界。
sources.boundary: 本地复核未发现数字 MNI/Talairach 坐标表；不能作为 Schaefer200 点位来源。

sources.title: Medial Temporal Lobe Contributions to Episodic Sequence Encoding
sources.citation: Tubridy S, Davachi L. Cerebral Cortex. 2011;21(2):272-280.
sources.useFor: Episodic sequence encoding source. PMC full text reports ordered > misordered MTL MNI coordinates; use as hippocampal/subicular/parahippocampal specialized-atlas boundary evidence for episodic-order-memory.
sources.supports: Episodic sequence encoding source supports ordered versus misordered MTL/hippocampal boundary evidence.
sources.safeUse: Use for MTL/hippocampal sequence-encoding boundary language in episodic-order memory.
sources.boundary: Do not force hippocampal, subicular or parahippocampal findings into Schaefer200 cortical parcels or treat this as full story-order memory.

sources.title: Hippocampal Activity Patterns Carry Information about Objects in Temporal Context
sources.citation: Hsieh LT, Gruber MJ, Jenkins LJ, Ranganath C. Neuron. 2014;81(5):1165-1178.
sources.useFor: Hippocampal/MTL ROI and MVPA mechanism source for temporal-context sequence memory. Local article and supplement were reviewed: use as MTL boundary/mechanism evidence, not as a Schaefer200 coordinate table.
sources.supports: Object-in-temporal-context MVPA source supports hippocampus, PRc, PHc and anterior/posterior hippocampal ROI mechanism boundaries for sequence and temporal-context memory.
sources.safeUse: Use for MTL/hippocampal temporal-context mechanism narration and specialized-atlas boundary language in episodic-order memory.
sources.boundary: The reviewed article and supplement do not provide a numeric MNI/Talairach peak table; do not create Schaefer200 cortical overlay points from this source alone.

sources.title: Similarity Breeds Proximity: Pattern Similarity within and across Contexts Is Related to Later Mnemonic Judgments of Temporal Proximity
sources.citation: Ezzyat Y, Davachi L. Neuron. 2014;81(5):1179-1189.
sources.useFor: Temporal-proximity and context-boundary fMRI source. Supplemental Table S2 reports MNI coordinates now extracted for episodic-order-memory candidate mapping; thalamus, striatum, cerebellum and parahippocampal rows remain atlas boundaries.
sources.supports: Temporal-proximity pattern-similarity source provides Supplemental Table S2 MNI cortical peaks for context-boundary and temporal-proximity candidate review, plus subcortical/cerebellar/MTL atlas-boundary rows.
sources.safeUse: Use as a candidate temporal-proximity / context-boundary layer for episodic-order memory, especially medial frontal, parietal, IFG/insula and visual/context-boundary nodes.
sources.boundary: Do not mix Supplemental Table S1 source-memory context rows into the temporal-proximity overlay; do not treat this candidate layer as full autobiographical or story event-order memory.

sources.title: Effects of memory training on cortical thickness in the elderly
sources.citation: Engvig A, Fjell AM, Westlye LT, et al. NeuroImage. 2010;52(4):1667-1676.
sources.useFor: Eight-week Method-of-Loci training in middle-aged and older adults with pre/post memory testing and structural MRI cortical-thickness analysis.
sources.supports: 42名完成者中，训练组接受8周地点法记忆训练；来源记忆表现提高，并相较被动控制组出现局部皮层厚度增加，厚度变化与记忆改善相关。
sources.safeUse: 可用于说明在中老年样本中，结构化记忆策略训练可能同时伴随来源记忆改善和局部结构MRI变化。
sources.boundary: 样本为42至77岁的健康中老年人，控制组是被动控制；不能外推到儿童、一般学习成绩或所有长期记忆训练。MRI形态变化也不是个体诊断指标。

paradigms.label: 视觉延迟记忆

paradigms.riskNote: 当前只支持视觉材料长期编码候选表达，不代表所有视觉延迟记忆任务共享同一组点位；海马和内嗅/海马旁继续作为专门图谱边界。

sources.title: The hippocampal formation participates in novel picture encoding: evidence from functional magnetic resonance imaging
sources.citation: Stern CE, Corkin S, Gonzalez RG, et al. Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences. 1996;93(16):8660-8665.
sources.useFor: Novel picture encoding and visual long-term memory candidate source; supports hippocampal formation plus ventral visual areas, pending coordinate extraction.
sources.supports: 候选支持新图片编码中海马结构、海马旁回、舌回/梭状回的视觉-记忆互动。
sources.safeUse: 可用于视觉延迟记忆的种子说明，特别是视觉输入与 MTL 编码的关系。
sources.boundary: 早期 fMRI 研究需核坐标空间和表格；当前不做精确 parcel 声称。

sources.title: Neural activity that predicts subsequent memory and forgetting: A meta-analysis of 74 fMRI studies
sources.useFor: Long-term encoding and subsequent-memory regional evidence. Four legacy boundary conversions have arithmetic-only corrections with original values retained; exact transform variant and current FSL compatibility remain unverified.
sources.supports: 候选用于后续记忆和遗忘相关的长时编码元分析。
sources.safeUse: 可作为词表学习的编码环节核验入口。
sources.boundary: 海马和内侧颞叶不能由皮层分区完整表达。旧换算的4条边界结果已按声明算式修正，原值及差异保留；原文转换变体未明确，仍不能用于精确 FSL 峰值定位。

sources.title: Event-related fMRI studies of episodic encoding and retrieval: Meta-analyses using activation likelihood estimation
sources.citation: Spaniol J, Davidson PSR, Kim ASN, Han H, Moscovitch M, Grady CL. Neuropsychologia. 2009;47(8-9):1765-1779.
sources.useFor: Recognition memory, episodic retrieval, and memory-system caution.
sources.supports: 候选用于情景记忆编码和提取的 ALE 元分析。
sources.safeUse: 可作为再认记忆和词表学习提取环节的核验入口。
sources.boundary: 熟悉性、回忆性和内侧颞叶贡献需要进一步细分。

sources.title: Differential Contributions of Prefrontal, Medial Temporal, and Sensory-Perceptual Regions to True and False Memory Formation
sources.citation: Kim H, Cabeza R. Cerebral Cortex. 2007;17(9):2143-2150.
sources.useFor: True/false memory formation source separating PFC, MTL and sensory-perceptual contributions.
sources.supports: True/false memory formation coordinates support PFC, MTL and sensory-perceptual boundary refinement for false-memory formation.
sources.safeUse: 可用于 DRM/假记忆形成阶段解释 PFC、感觉再激活和 MTL 边界。
sources.boundary: 不是单一 DRM primary task；MTL、丘脑和小脑仍需专门图谱。

sources.citation: Taylor JS, Rastle K, Davis MH. Psychological Bulletin. 2013;139(4):766-791.
sources.useFor: Lexical decision, word reading, and reading task evidence.
sources.supports: 候选用于词读、伪词读和词汇判断相关阅读任务的元分析证据。
sources.safeUse: 优先用于词汇判断和基础字词识别讲解。

sources.title: The visual word form area: expertise for reading in the fusiform gyrus
sources.citation: McCandliss BD, Cohen L, Dehaene S. 2003. Trends in Cognitive Sciences.
sources.useFor: VWFA/left fusiform reading expertise boundary for orthographic processing and word-form claims.
sources.supports: Supports the conceptual VWFA/left fusiform reading-expertise framing.

sources.citation: Jobard G, Crivello F, Tzourio-Mazoyer N. NeuroImage. 2003;20(2):693-712.

sources.supports: Dual-route reading meta-analysis clusters support visual word-form, phonological, lexical-semantic and left IFG reading-route boundaries.
sources.safeUse: 可用于阅读能力中词汇判断、字词/伪词、音韵解码和正字法加工的通路支架。
sources.boundary: Cluster mean 不是个体诊断或完整语言 atlas；语义系统仍需专门语义来源。

sources.title: Language-specific tuning of visual cortex? Functional properties of the visual word form area
sources.citation: Cohen L, Lehéricy S, Chochon F, et al. Brain. 2002;125(5):1054-1069.
sources.useFor: VWFA and ventral occipitotemporal word-form source for orthographic processing and visual word reading. Tables 1-5 have been extracted into 11 Talairach VWFA/visual-input candidate coordinates plus an MNI-converted Schaefer200 review mapping.
sources.supports: VWFA and visual word-form coordinates support ventral occipitotemporal word-form processing and visual-input boundaries.
sources.safeUse: 可用于阅读通路中 VWFA/左腹侧颞枕候选层。
sources.boundary: 不要讲成个体级 VWFA 精确定位；右侧和后部视觉点只作边界。

sources.title: Neural deficits in children with dyslexia ameliorated by behavioral remediation: Evidence from functional MRI
sources.citation: Temple E, Deutsch GK, Poldrack RA, Miller SL, Tallal P, Merzenich MM, Gabrieli JDE. PNAS. 2003;100(5):2860-2865.
sources.useFor: Eight-week auditory-language and phonological remediation in 20 children with dyslexia, with reading/language gains and pre/post phonological-task fMRI change.
sources.supports: 20名阅读障碍儿童完成8周听觉语言与音韵训练后，口语和阅读表现改善，音韵任务fMRI中左颞顶、左额下及部分右侧补偿区域活动增加。
sources.safeUse: 可用于说明针对音韵与口语加工的矫正训练，在特定阅读障碍样本中可伴随阅读表现和任务脑反应变化。
sources.boundary: 这不是典型儿童的一般阅读训练证据，干预并非随机盲法产品试验；不能把区域变化讲成固定训练靶点或本项目疗效。

sources.title: Altering cortical connectivity: remediation-induced changes in the white matter of poor readers
sources.citation: Keller TA, Just MA. Neuron. 2009;64(5):624-631.
sources.useFor: Randomized reading-remediation study with about 100 hours of instruction over six months and pre/post DTI in 8-12-year-old poor readers.
sources.supports: 强化解码训练后，非词阅读改善，并在左侧前部半卵圆中心观察到FA增加和径向弥散下降；未干预组没有同样变化。
sources.safeUse: 可用于说明阅读训练需要瞄准具体瓶颈；在阅读困难儿童中，足量音韵解码训练可能同时伴随行为和白质指标变化。
sources.boundary: 样本是阅读困难儿童，四种干预被合并分析；影像指标不能直接解释为髓鞘增加，篇章理解也未出现可靠改善，不能宣传为全面阅读能力提升。

sources.title: Early Intervention for Reading Disabilities: Teaching the Alphabetic Principle in a Connectionist Framework
sources.citation: Berninger VW, Abbott RD, Zook D, Ogier S, Lemos-Britton Z, Brooksher R. Journal of Learning Disabilities. 1999;32(6):491-503.
sources.useFor: Randomized early-reading intervention comparing whole-word, subword, and combined instruction in 48 end-of-first-grade children with reading difficulty. Use as near-component evidence for lexical and word-reading instruction.
sources.supports: 48名一年级末有阅读困难的儿童被随机分配到整词、字词内部单元或两者结合的教学，共8次、每次30分钟；各组在所教词和标准化阅读测验上均有进步，字词内部单元教学在标准化真实词阅读上呈现优势。
sources.safeUse: 可作为字词识别、拼写声音单元与早期阅读教学的近成分证据，帮助把训练形式写成整词识别、字词拆分和新词迁移三层。
sources.boundary: 样本小、训练只有8次，且结局不是标准词汇判断任务；不能由此承诺长期篇章理解、学科成绩或普通儿童的统一剂量。

sources.boundary: 这不是典型儿童的一般阅读训练证据，干预并非随机盲法产品试验；不能把区域变化讲成固定训练靶点或本项目疗效。

sources.title: Altering cortical connectivity: remediation-induced changes in the white matter of poor readers
sources.citation: Keller TA, Just MA. Neuron. 2009;64(5):624-631.
sources.useFor: Randomized reading-remediation study with about 100 hours of instruction over six months and pre/post DTI in 8-12-year-old poor readers.
sources.supports: 强化解码训练后，非词阅读改善，并在左侧前部半卵圆中心观察到FA增加和径向弥散下降；未干预组没有同样变化。
sources.safeUse: 可用于说明阅读训练需要瞄准具体瓶颈；在阅读困难儿童中，足量音韵解码训练可能同时伴随行为和白质指标变化。
sources.boundary: 样本是阅读困难儿童，四种干预被合并分析；影像指标不能直接解释为髓鞘增加，篇章理解也未出现可靠改善，不能宣传为全面阅读能力提升。

paradigms.label: 正字法/字形加工
paradigms.upgradeQuestion: Can orthographic/visual word-form processing be shown as a left ventral occipitotemporal candidate layer?
paradigms.riskNote: 生产级只覆盖核心词/伪词阅读、音韵解码和正字法加工；不要把这些 Schaefer200 代理点说成精确 VWFA，也不要外推到句子理解或完整语义系统。

sources.title: The visual word form area: expertise for reading in the fusiform gyrus
sources.citation: McCandliss BD, Cohen L, Dehaene S. 2003. Trends in Cognitive Sciences.

sources.boundary: Review-level source, not a coordinate table for this app; exact points need coordinate extraction from primary studies or meta-analysis.

sources.boundary: 不能把它直接扩展成所有阅读理解、篇章理解或训练效果证据。

sources.title: Evaluation of the dual route theory of reading: a metanalysis of 35 neuroimaging studies
sources.citation: Jobard G, Crivello F, Tzourio-Mazoyer N. NeuroImage. 2003;20(2):693-712.
sources.useFor: Reading dual-route meta-analysis source for orthographic, phonological and lexical-semantic pathway boundaries. Tables 2-12 have been extracted into 10 MNI cluster-mean candidate coordinates plus 1 low-confidence visual-input boundary row.
sources.supports: Dual-route reading meta-analysis clusters support visual word-form, phonological, lexical-semantic and left IFG reading-route boundaries.
sources.safeUse: 可用于阅读能力中词汇判断、字词/伪词、音韵解码和正字法加工的通路支架。
sources.boundary: Cluster mean 不是个体诊断或完整语言 atlas；语义系统仍需专门语义来源。

sources.title: Language-specific tuning of visual cortex? Functional properties of the visual word form area
sources.citation: Cohen L, Lehéricy S, Chochon F, et al. Brain. 2002;125(5):1054-1069.
sources.useFor: VWFA and ventral occipitotemporal word-form source for orthographic processing and visual word reading. Tables 1-5 have been extracted into 11 Talairach VWFA/visual-input candidate coordinates plus an MNI-converted Schaefer200 review mapping.
sources.supports: VWFA and visual word-form coordinates support ventral occipitotemporal word-form processing and visual-input boundaries.
sources.safeUse: 可用于阅读通路中 VWFA/左腹侧颞枕候选层。
sources.boundary: 不要讲成个体级 VWFA 精确定位；右侧和后部视觉点只作边界。
