sources.title: Spelling and reading development: The effect of teaching children multiple levels of representation in their orthography
sources.citation: Devonshire V, Morris P, Fluck M. Learning and Instruction. 2013;25:85-94.
sources.useFor: Randomized cross-over classroom evidence comparing multi-level orthographic instruction with phonics in 120 English-speaking children aged 5 to 7.
sources.supports: 120名5至7岁英语儿童参加随机交叉设计；明确联结词形、音韵、词素和词源规则的教学，相比传统自然拼读阶段提高了字词阅读和拼写。
sources.safeUse: 可用于正字法训练中的多层次比较：孩子既看字母位置和词形，也解释声音、词素与词源为何这样组合。
sources.boundary: 干预同时包含多个成分，不能把全部效果单独归因于视觉字形加工；英语结果不能直接外推到汉字结构，也没有提供脑成像训练结论。

paradigms.label: 符号搜索/编码速度
paradigms.upgradeQuestion: Which sources support symbol search/coding speed as visual scanning, parietal attention, motor output, and cerebellar timing?
paradigms.riskNote: Forn 2009 是更干净的健康成人 SDMT 直接任务源；Fittipaldi 2017 是 MS/HC 任务负荷样本，不能替代 Forn 作为学生加工速度主 overlay。二者都不能讲成普通反应时、全部课堂加工速度、个体诊断或训练因果证据；Gawryluk 2014 仍只作 white-matter/边界。

sources.title: Reaction time and movement time as measures of stimulus evaluation and response processes
sources.citation: Houlihan M, Campbell K, Stelmack RM. Intelligence. 1994;18(3):289-307.
sources.useFor: Simple and choice reaction-time decomposition into stimulus evaluation, response selection, and movement/output timing.
sources.supports: 候选用于把反应时和运动时分解为刺激评价、反应选择和动作输出过程的行为来源。
sources.safeUse: 可用于把简单反应时作为行为基线，讲刺激评估和动作输出速度。
sources.boundary: 这是行为过程来源，不支持具体脑区激活或复杂网络声称。

sources.title: A Symbol Digit Modalities Test version suitable for functional MRI studies
sources.citation: Forn C, Belloch V, Bustamante JC, Garbin G, Parcet-Ibars MA, Sanjuan A, Ventura N, Avila C. Neuroscience Letters. 2009;456(1):11-14.
sources.useFor: Primary SDMT task-fMRI coordinate source for symbol digit / coding-speed visual scanning, frontoparietal attention-working-memory and response-selection candidates; caudate and cerebellum remain atlas-boundary evidence.
sources.supports: SDMT 直接任务 fMRI 来源，Table 1 报告健康成人执行 SDMT 时的 Talairach 峰值，覆盖枕叶/枕颞视觉输入、顶叶/楔前叶扫描注意、额叶规则/反应支持，并报告尾状核和小脑边界点。
sources.safeUse: 可用于把符号搜索/编码速度从区域级说明推进到 SDMT 专门坐标候选层；适合讲视觉符号输入、顶叶扫描/匹配、额叶反应准备和皮层外边界共同支撑加工速度。
sources.boundary: Forn 2009 不是普通反应时或所有课堂加工速度的坐标源；尾状核和小脑点不能强行映射到 Schaefer200，视觉峰值也需要生产裁剪后再演示。

sources.title: Exploring Neural Efficiency in Multiple Sclerosis Patients during the Symbol Digit Modalities Test: A Functional Magnetic Resonance Imaging Study
sources.citation: Fittipaldi-Marquez MS, et al. Neurodegenerative Diseases. 2017;17(6):292-300.
sources.useFor: Supplementary SDMT task-fMRI coordinate source. Figshare S1-S2 provide MNI activation tables for MS patients and healthy controls across SDMT ISI conditions and task-load contrasts; use as SDMT/coding-speed cross-check and load boundary, not as the primary healthy-student overlay.
sources.supports: SDMT fMRI 补充表来源，S1/S2 报告 MS 患者和健康对照在不同 ISI 条件下执行 SDMT 的 MNI 激活坐标，以及 1.5s ISI 相比 2s/2.5s 的负荷增强坐标。
sources.safeUse: 可用于补强符号搜索/编码速度的跨源一致性检查，特别是视觉输入、额顶扫描/控制、MTL/皮层外和小脑边界，以及任务负荷变高时激活增强的候选说明。
sources.boundary: 这是 MS/HC 样本和任务负荷研究，不替代 Forn 2009 的健康成人主 overlay；没有主文终审前，不讲成学生加工速度、普通反应时、个体诊断或训练效果证据。

sources.title: Sustaining attention to simple tasks: A meta-analytic review of the neural mechanisms of vigilant attention
sources.citation: Langner R, Eickhoff SB. Psychological Bulletin. 2013;139(4):870-900.
sources.useFor: Sustained attention, vigilance, CPT/TOVA-style continuous monitoring, and attention-control boundaries.
sources.supports: 候选用于持续注意和警觉维持的元分析证据。
sources.safeUse: 可作为 CPT/TOVA 持续注意范式的核验入口。
sources.boundary: 不同 CPT/TOVA 版本差异较大，未复核全文前不做精确点位或单一通路声称。

sources.title: Functional boundaries in the human cerebellum revealed by a multi-domain task battery
sources.citation: King M, Hernandez-Castillo CR, Poldrack RA, Ivry RB, Diedrichsen J. 2019. Nature Neuroscience.
sources.useFor: Cerebellar task-domain framing for motor, timing, working-memory, language, math, and spatial task candidates.
sources.supports: Supports cerebellar task-domain organization across motor, language, working-memory, math, and spatial task domains.
sources.safeUse: Use for cautious cerebellar candidate layer language when a task plausibly involves timing, sequencing, or practiced output.
sources.boundary: Does not by itself prove a cerebellar node for every paradigm in this library.

sources.title: Differential effects of reasoning and speed training in children
sources.citation: Mackey AP, Hill SS, Stone SI, Bunge SA. Developmental Science. 2011;14(3):582-590.
sources.useFor: Eight-week randomized comparison of reasoning games versus processing-speed games in 28 children aged 7-9 from low socioeconomic backgrounds.
sources.supports: 28名7至9岁儿童分别接受8周推理训练或加工速度训练；推理组主要改善非言语推理测验，速度组主要改善编码速度，显示训练收益与所练任务成分有选择性。
sources.safeUse: 可用于说明儿童的推理和加工速度表现具有可训练性，而且训练效果更可能先出现在与训练内容接近的任务上。
sources.boundary: 样本小、没有无训练控制组、部分评估未完全盲法，也没有MRI终点；论文中的大效应不能当作一般儿童、智商或学业提升的稳定估计。

paradigms.label: 视觉搜索/舒尔特方格
paradigms.upgradeQuestion: Which visual search/Schulte-like sources support FEF-IPS visual scanning?
paradigms.riskNote: Manjaly 2003 Table 1A 是 broad visual search scaffold，不是 Schulte table 专门 fMRI，也不是 feature/conjunction search 专属峰值表；不能把视觉搜索速度差异直接诊断为某一个顶叶或额叶点位问题。

sources.title: Attention Response Functions
sources.citation: Culham JC, Cavanagh P, Kanwisher NG. Neuron. 2001;32(4):737-745.
sources.useFor: Multiple object tracking, attentional load, and parietal/frontal attention response language.
sources.supports: 候选用于多目标追踪中注意负荷、视觉空间注意和额顶/顶叶注意反应的任务证据。
sources.safeUse: 可作为多目标追踪的优先区域级证据入口，用于解释动态目标追踪会牵动顶叶和额叶注意系统，并区分 task-only 与 load-dependent 反应。
sources.boundary: PDF 已入库，但未发现显式峰值坐标表；尚未逐坐标映射到 Schaefer200，当前只能作为区域级候选点位依据。

sources.title: Control of goal-directed and stimulus-driven attention in the brain
sources.citation: Corbetta M, Shulman GL. Nature Reviews Neuroscience. 2002;3(3):201-215.
sources.useFor: Attention orienting, dorsal attention, ventral attention, cueing, and reorienting language.
sources.supports: 注意定向和重定向的综述级网络框架，尤其适合解释背侧目标导向注意与腹侧刺激驱动重定向。
sources.safeUse: 可用于 Posner 线索任务和注意定向类范式的网络级讲解。
sources.boundary: 不能直接推出 Schaefer200 某个点位在某个任务中激活，也不能用于个体诊断。

sources.title: Sustaining attention to simple tasks: A meta-analytic review of the neural mechanisms of vigilant attention

sources.title: In search of the hidden: an fMRI study with implications for the study of patients with autism and with acquired brain injury
sources.citation: Manjaly ZM, Bruning N, Neufang S, et al. NeuroImage. 2003;19(3):674-683.
sources.useFor: Hidden/embedded figures task-fMRI source. Table 1 has been extracted: Table 1B provides EFT-specific left IFG/ventral premotor and left IPS convergence candidates; Table 1A provides broad visual-search scaffold only.
sources.supports: Hidden figures fMRI coordinates support left IFG/ventral premotor and left IPS consistency candidates, with broad visual-search rows as background.
sources.safeUse: 可用于嵌入图形/复杂图形搜索生产图中补强核心 EFT-specific 点位。
sources.boundary: Table 1A 的一般视觉搜索底座不能被讲成嵌入图形特异核心。

sources.title: Neuroplasticity: changes in grey matter induced by training
sources.citation: Draganski B, Gaser C, Busch V, Schuierer G, Bogdahn U, May A. Nature. 2004;427:311-312.
sources.useFor: Three-month juggling acquisition with repeated structural MRI in 24 young adults, showing transient grey-matter change in visual-motion and parietal regions.
sources.supports: 24名年轻成人中，学习三球杂耍的组在3个月后出现双侧hMT/V5和左后顶内沟灰质暂时增加，停止练习后的第三次扫描显示部分回落。
sources.safeUse: 可作为感知运动学习引起成人脑结构可塑性的经典背景证据，帮助解释训练剂量、持续练习和停止练习后的变化。
sources.boundary: 杂耍不是九项功能中的标准认知范式，也不是儿童学习训练；只能作为广义可塑性背景，不能证明推理、速度或表象能力会自动迁移。

sources.title: Playing Super Mario induces structural brain plasticity: gray matter changes resulting from training with a commercial video game
sources.citation: Kuhn S, Gleich T, Lorenz RC, Lindenberger U, Gallinat J. Molecular Psychiatry. 2014;19(2):265-271.
sources.useFor: Training/neuroplasticity background for explaining why complex 3D spatial-action tasks may engage spatial navigation, strategic planning, working memory, and motor coordination systems. Local PDF is archived; keep out of coordinate overlays, diagnosis, and product-efficacy promises.
sources.supports: 2个月、每天至少30分钟的商业3D平台游戏训练组，在结构MRI中观察到右海马结构、右背外侧前额叶和双侧小脑灰质增加；论文把这些区域解释为与空间导航、策略规划、工作记忆和动作表现相关。
sources.safeUse: 可用于资料库、训练设计和家长讲解中的“复杂任务练习可能打到多个脑功能系统，并且大脑具有可塑性”的背景说明。适合连接表象/空间操作、执行功能、短时/工作记忆和动作协调，不作为某个具体范式的点位来源。
sources.boundary: 样本是成人纵向训练研究，任务是 Super Mario 类3D平台游戏；不能据此承诺本项目训练会让儿童脑区灰质增长，不能作为疗效、诊断、个体预测或生产3D点位证据。

sources.title: Cortical network modulations associated with prolonged training of the multiple object-tracking task
sources.citation: Felssberg AM, Schonemann N, Hopf JM, Schoenfeld MA, Merkel C. Imaging Neuroscience. 2025;3:imag_a_00577.
sources.useFor: Five-session multiple-object-tracking training over two weeks with pre/post task fMRI in 33 adults.
sources.supports: 训练后MOT表现提高，目标位置表征更多在视觉皮层巩固，额叶控制网络中的对象式表征作用相对变化；论文同时强调向其他任务的迁移有限。
sources.safeUse: 可用于多目标追踪训练的直接证据，并帮助设计目标数量、速度、干扰密度和追踪持续时间的渐进负荷。
sources.boundary: 成人任务特异训练、没有独立未训练对照组，且研究本身指出迁移有限；不能把MOT收益讲成一般注意力或运动表现提升。

paradigms.label: 知觉辨别反应时

sources.citation: King M, Hernandez-Castillo CR, Poldrack RA, Ivry RB, Diedrichsen J. 2019. Nature Neuroscience.

sources.title: A general mechanism for perceptual decision-making in the human brain
sources.citation: Heekeren HR, Marrett S, Bandettini PA, Ungerleider LG. Nature. 2004;431(7010):859-862.
sources.useFor: Visual perceptual-decision fMRI source for noisy face/house categorization. Figure 4 provides two MNI left posterior DLPFC/SFS decision-integration candidate coordinates; Figure 3 attention-demand regions are qualitative boundaries only.
sources.supports: Visual perceptual-decision fMRI supports left posterior DLPFC / superior frontal sulcus candidate coordinates for integrating sensory evidence from face- and house-selective visual regions.
sources.safeUse: 可用于知觉辨别反应时中“感觉证据比较清楚以后进入决策整合”的候选讲法。
sources.boundary: 不是普通 simple RT、symbol search 或听觉 Tone 辨别坐标；Figure 3 的 FEF/SEF/IPS/INS 只有图示标签，不能直接变成 Schaefer200 点位。

sources.title: Quantitative Characterization of Functional Anatomical Contributions to Cognitive Control under Uncertainty
sources.citation: Fan J, Gu X, Liu X, Guise KG, Park Y, Martin L, de Marchena A, Tang CY, Minzenberg MJ, Hof PR. Journal of Cognitive Neuroscience. 2014;26(7):1490-1506.
sources.useFor: Visual majority-function fMRI source for information-entropy, uncertainty and control-load effects. Figure 4 ROI coordinates are extracted as a bridge for perceptual-decision RT explanation, but this does not replace Wu 2018 ordinary choice-RT / Hick-Hyman supplementary tables.
sources.supports: Visual majority-function fMRI supports information-entropy/control-load candidate coordinates for ACC, anterior insula, FEF, IPC/IPS and visual regions, with thalamus and cerebellar vermis retained as specialized-atlas boundaries.
sources.safeUse: 可用于知觉辨别反应时中解释“刺激信息不确定性越高，反应越慢，额顶扣带/前岛控制系统越需要介入”的桥接讲法。
sources.boundary: 这不是 ordinary Hick-Hyman response-alternative choice RT；response selection 在任务里是二选一且恒定，不能替代 Wu 2018 supplement；丘脑和小脑不能硬映射成 Schaefer200 皮层点。

sources.title: Effector-dependent neural representations of perceptual decisions independent of motor actions and sensory modalities
sources.citation: Esmeyer J, Schmidt TT, Blankenburg F. Imaging Neuroscience. 2025;3:IMAG.a.11.
sources.useFor: Visual delayed match-to-comparison fMRI plus cross-modal visual/vibrotactile conjunction source for perceptual-decision representations in IPS and PMd. PMC peak coordinates are extracted and NeuroVault WILTPYNG stat-map zip has passed map-level integrity review; threshold/cluster/parcel review remains optional if a production map is needed. Use as candidate evidence for cross-modal perceptual-discrimination RT; do not use as generic simple RT, SDMT, ordinary choice RT, or auditory RT evidence.
sources.supports: Visual delayed match-to-comparison fMRI and a visual/vibrotactile conjunction support IPS and PMd candidate coordinates for perceptual-decision representations that are not tied to one sensory modality or one final motor action.
sources.safeUse: 可用于知觉辨别反应时中说明“差异判断”不只是视觉输入，还可能经过顶叶抽象决策和前运动效应器准备路线。
sources.boundary: 跨模态 conjunction 是候选层，不能升成普通 reaction-speed production map；它也不能替代 SDMT、ordinary choice RT、simple RT 或听觉专门反应时来源。

sources.title: Revealing the mechanisms behind novel auditory stimuli discrimination: An evaluation of silent functional MRI using looping star
sources.citation: Damestani NL, O'Daly O, Solana AB, Wiesinger F, Lythgoe DJ, Hill S, de Lara Rubio A, Makovac E, Williams SCR, Zelaya F. Human Brain Mapping. 2021;42(9):2833-2850.
sources.useFor: Open PMC auditory oddball / tone-discrimination fMRI source. Table 2 MNI peaks support an auditory-specific candidate branch for perceptual-discrimination RT: bilateral auditory/STG input, frontal-opercular/anterior-insula salience support, SMA/medial-frontal response preparation, and limited parietal support. Do not use as generic simple RT, ordinary choice RT, SDMT, symbol-search, or classroom processing-speed production evidence.
sources.supports: Auditory oddball / tone-discrimination task-fMRI coordinates support an auditory-specific candidate branch for perceptual-discrimination RT, including bilateral auditory/STG input, frontal-opercular/anterior-insula salience marking, medial frontal/SMA response preparation and limited parietal support.
sources.safeUse: 可用于补足知觉辨别反应时里的听觉输入与偏离音检测候选层，说明反应速度不只发生在视觉材料里。
sources.boundary: 这是 Looping Star versus GRE-EPI auditory oddball 方法学论文中的任务坐标，不是普通 simple RT、ordinary choice RT、SDMT、符号搜索或课堂加工速度 production overlay；采集序列差异不能讲成认知网络差异，小脑/后颅窝行只走专门图谱边界。

sources.title: Hick-Hyman Law is Mediated by the Cognitive Control Network in the Brain
sources.citation: Wu T, Dufford AJ, Egan LJ, Mackie MA, Chen C, Yuan C, Chen C, Li X, Liu X, Hof PR, Fan J. Cerebral Cortex. 2018;28(7):2267-2282.
sources.useFor: Ordinary choice reaction-time / Hick-Hyman candidate source. Main article is archived and the user-provided bhx127suppl_1.zip has been extracted: Supplementary Tables 2-15 and 17 provide numeric MNI x/y/z rows, Table 6 gives CCN ROI coordinates/model parameters, and Table 16 gives ROI mediation coefficients. 2026-06-19 first-pass pruning keeps SMA/ACC, anterior insula/frontal operculum, FEF, IPS/posterior parietal, precentral output and low-weight visual input as a compact candidate overlay.
sources.supports: Main article supports ordinary choice reaction-time / Hick-Hyman task identity and cognitive-control-network involvement, including SMA/ACC, anterior insula, FEF, IPS, thalamus and putamen ROI families.
sources.safeUse: 可用于把 ordinary choice RT 和 response-alternative load 放进反应速度证据队列，并作为比 Heekeren/Fan 更贴近 Hick-Hyman 的候选来源。
sources.boundary: 真实 supplementary zip 已取得并抽取；Table 6 ROI 与 Tables 9-12/17 已进入候选裁剪，但仍不能直接升 production-reviewed 普通反应速度网络，丘脑/基底神经节/MTL/小脑继续走专门图谱边界。

sources.title: Neuroplasticity: changes in grey matter induced by training
sources.citation: Draganski B, Gaser C, Busch V, Schuierer G, Bogdahn U, May A. Nature. 2004;427:311-312.
sources.useFor: Three-month juggling acquisition with repeated structural MRI in 24 young adults, showing transient grey-matter change in visual-motion and parietal regions.
sources.supports: 24名年轻成人中，学习三球杂耍的组在3个月后出现双侧hMT/V5和左后顶内沟灰质暂时增加，停止练习后的第三次扫描显示部分回落。
sources.safeUse: 可作为感知运动学习引起成人脑结构可塑性的经典背景证据，帮助解释训练剂量、持续练习和停止练习后的变化。
sources.boundary: 杂耍不是九项功能中的标准认知范式，也不是儿童学习训练；只能作为广义可塑性背景，不能证明推理、速度或表象能力会自动迁移。

sources.title: Do brain-training programs work?
sources.citation: Simons DJ, Boot WR, Charness N, et al. Psychological Science in the Public Interest. 2016;17(3):103-186.
sources.useFor: Comprehensive methods-and-transfer review of task/game-based brain-training evidence and the study-design standards needed for credible efficacy claims.
sources.supports: 综合评估认为，训练任务本身的改善证据很多，接近任务的迁移证据较少，远距离任务和日常认知表现的改善证据很少；许多研究还存在控制、盲法、样本和分析问题。
sources.safeUse: 可作为九项功能共同的证据边界：先讲训练内容、样本、剂量和直接结果，再单独证明是否迁移到真实学习。
sources.boundary: 它评估的是外部脑训练研究，不证明本项目无效或有效；具体训练仍需自己的对照、随访、真实任务和产品级验证。

sources.title: Playing Super Mario induces structural brain plasticity: gray matter changes resulting from training with a commercial video game
sources.citation: Kuhn S, Gleich T, Lorenz RC, Lindenberger U, Gallinat J. Molecular Psychiatry. 2014;19(2):265-271.
sources.useFor: Training/neuroplasticity background for explaining why complex 3D spatial-action tasks may engage spatial navigation, strategic planning, working memory, and motor coordination systems. Local PDF is archived; keep out of coordinate overlays, diagnosis, and product-efficacy promises.
sources.supports: 2个月、每天至少30分钟的商业3D平台游戏训练组，在结构MRI中观察到右海马结构、右背外侧前额叶和双侧小脑灰质增加；论文把这些区域解释为与空间导航、策略规划、工作记忆和动作表现相关。
sources.safeUse: 可用于资料库、训练设计和家长讲解中的“复杂任务练习可能打到多个脑功能系统，并且大脑具有可塑性”的背景说明。适合连接表象/空间操作、执行功能、短时/工作记忆和动作协调，不作为某个具体范式的点位来源。
sources.boundary: 样本是成人纵向训练研究，任务是 Super Mario 类3D平台游戏；不能据此承诺本项目训练会让儿童脑区灰质增长，不能作为疗效、诊断、个体预测或生产3D点位证据。

paradigms.label: 空间展开/折叠
paradigms.upgradeQuestion: Can spatial folding/unfolding be grounded in mental imagery/spatial transformation studies?
paradigms.riskNote: Glass 2013 是 VLSM 病灶映射，不是 task-fMRI 激活；Neubauer 2017 S2 是 direct PFT task-fMRI candidate，但样本小且来自 tACS 设计，正激活、deactivation 和 stimulation-modulation rows 必须分开。当前可以讲 direct fMRI parcel-reviewed candidate，不能讲 production reviewed、训练效果或个体靶点。

sources.title: Neuroimaging studies of mental rotation: A meta-analysis and review
sources.citation: Zacks JM. Journal of Cognitive Neuroscience. 2008;20(1):1-19.
sources.useFor: Mental rotation and spatial imagery operation evidence.
sources.supports: 心理旋转元分析与综述证据，支持顶内沟及邻近顶叶区域作为心理旋转/空间变换的高优先级主线，并提示部分任务条件下可见前运动/运动模拟相关参与。
sources.safeUse: 优先用于心理旋转，把表象操作讲成视觉形态输入后进入顶叶空间变换，再由额顶系统完成比较判断。
sources.boundary: 视觉表象、空间注意、动作模拟和心理旋转不能混讲；前运动参与要按任务材料和策略单独核验，不能把它做成所有心理旋转范式的固定核心。

sources.title: Neural foundations of imagery
sources.citation: Kosslyn SM, Ganis G, Thompson WL. Nature Reviews Neuroscience. 2001;2(9):635-642.
sources.useFor: Visual imagery task identity, perception-imagery overlap, and caution around internal imagery claims.
sources.supports: 候选用于视觉表象的综述级神经基础，尤其是视觉表象与视觉感知的部分重叠和差异。
sources.safeUse: 可用于说明视觉表象不是单纯看见外界，而是在没有外部图像时调用视觉和控制系统生成内部图像。
sources.boundary: 不能说大脑里真的出现可被观看的图像，也不能把视觉表象等同于心理旋转或训练效果证据。

sources.title: Brain areas underlying visual mental imagery and visual perception: an fMRI study
sources.citation: Ganis G, Thompson WL, Kosslyn SM. Cognitive Brain Research. 2004;20(2):226-241.
sources.useFor: Visual mental imagery and visual perception overlap/difference evidence.
sources.supports: fMRI 研究用于比较视觉心理表象和视觉感知涉及的脑区重叠与差异；用户补入 PDF 后，Tables 3-4 已抽取并转为 MNI/Schaefer200 坐标候选。
sources.safeUse: 可作为视觉表象任务的神经影像入口，帮助解释内部图像生成会牵动视觉、顶叶和额叶控制支架；当前适合做 70% 坐标候选展示。
sources.boundary: 坐标已完成候选映射，但尚未人工裁剪 production overlay；common imagery-perception 与 perception-only ventral temporal 边界要分开讲，不能声称 imagery-only 精确点位已终审。

sources.title: Non-identical neural mechanisms for two types of mental transformation: event-related potentials during mental rotation and mental paper folding
sources.citation: Milivojevic B, Johnson BW, Hamm JP, Corballis MC. Neuropsychologia. 2003;41(10):1345-1356.
sources.useFor: Mental paper folding task identity, ERP parietal-lateralization boundary, and caution against substituting mental-rotation coordinates.
sources.supports: ERP/行为层面区分心理旋转和心理折叠两类空间变换，可用于空间折叠范式身份和边界说明。
sources.safeUse: 可用于说明空间折叠不是心理旋转的简单重复，训练讲解中应把折叠、展开和空间变换边界分开。
sources.boundary: 该来源不是 fMRI 坐标表，不能用于 Schaefer200 点位级激活声称。

sources.title: Spatial transformation abilities and their relation to later academic achievement
sources.citation: Frick A. Psychological Research. 2019;83(7):1465-1484.
sources.useFor: Developmental behavioral evidence linking spatial transformation abilities to arithmetic, numeric-logical, spatial, and geometry performance.
sources.supports: 发展/行为层面支持空间变换能力与学习成就关系，可用于空间折叠和表象操作的训练意义边界。
sources.safeUse: 可用于解释为什么空间变换能力值得作为表象操作能力的训练入口之一。
sources.boundary: 该来源不提供任务态 fMRI 坐标，不能单独支撑 3D 点位。

sources.title: Mental Paper Folding Performance Following Penetrating Traumatic Brain Injury in Combat Veterans: A Lesion Mapping Study
sources.citation: Glass L, Krueger F, Solomon J, Raymont V, Grafman J. Cerebral Cortex. 2013;23(7):1663-1672.
sources.useFor: Task-specific VLSM lesion-deficit Talairach peaks for AFQT-7 boxes / mental paper folding; use as causal lesion boundary, not fMRI activation.
sources.supports: VLSM 病灶-缺损研究提供 AFQT boxes / mental paper folding 的 Talairach 坐标边界，稳定主线是右 IPL/BA40 和左海马旁/枕颞区域。
sources.safeUse: 可用于说明空间折叠/展开表现对右顶叶空间变换和左海马旁/枕颞构型支持很敏感，并作为 3D 候选点位复核来源。
sources.boundary: 这是病灶因果边界，不是 task-fMRI 激活；不能讲成训练时这些区域一定点亮，也不能据此宣称 reviewed parcel。

sources.title: The influence of transcranial alternating current stimulation (tACS) on fluid intelligence: An fMRI study
sources.citation: Neubauer AC, Wammerl M, Benedek M, Jauk E, Jausovec N. Personality and Individual Differences. 2017;118:50-55.
sources.useFor: Supplementary Table S2 task-specific MNI peaks for the Paper Folding Test; use as direct fMRI coordinate candidate after local parcel review, while keeping stimulation-modulation rows separate.
sources.supports: Supplementary Table S2 提供 Paper Folding Test 的 task-specific MNI 坐标候选；2026-06-22 parcel review 已把 8 个正激活行分成视觉输入、顶叶空间变换和次级任务需求/视觉形态支持，并把 5 个负向行固定为 deactivation boundary。
sources.safeUse: 可用于把空间折叠从纯病灶边界推进到 direct task-fMRI parcel-reviewed candidate：正向展示优先保留右 lingual、左 IOG、左 IPL、左 SPL 和右 SMG/IPL 五个 compact anchors。
sources.boundary: 该研究样本小且处在 tACS 设计中；S2 正激活、S2 deactivation 行和主文 Table 1 stimulation-modulation 行必须分开。当前是 reviewed coordinate-candidate terminal，不是 production reviewed、训练效果或个体靶点证据。

sources.title: Functional boundaries in the human cerebellum revealed by a multi-domain task battery
sources.citation: King M, Hernandez-Castillo CR, Poldrack RA, Ivry RB, Diedrichsen J. 2019. Nature Neuroscience.
sources.useFor: Cerebellar task-domain framing for motor, timing, working-memory, language, math, and spatial task candidates.
sources.supports: Supports cerebellar task-domain organization across motor, language, working-memory, math, and spatial task domains.
sources.safeUse: Use for cautious cerebellar candidate layer language when a task plausibly involves timing, sequencing, or practiced output.
sources.boundary: Does not by itself prove a cerebellar node for every paradigm in this library.

sources.title: Understanding spatial transformations: similarities and differences between mental rotation and mental folding
sources.citation: Harris J, Hirsh-Pasek K, Newcombe NS. Cognitive Processing. 2013;14(2):105-115.
sources.useFor: Spatial transformation conceptual boundary source for separating mental rotation from mental folding. Local PDF review confirmed DOI 10.1007/s10339-013-0544-6 and no numeric MNI/Talairach coordinate table; use it for rigid versus non-rigid transformation, strategy and development boundaries, not direct 3D point overlays.
sources.supports: Spatial transformation review supports conceptual separation between mental rotation and mental folding.
sources.safeUse: 可用于空间折叠/心理旋转的任务边界和发展/策略讲法。
sources.boundary: 综述不提供任务态 fMRI 坐标；不能用于 3D 点位主图。

sources.title: The malleability of spatial skills: a meta-analysis of training studies
sources.citation: Uttal DH, Meadow NG, Tipton E, et al. Psychological Bulletin. 2013;139(2):352-402.
sources.useFor: Meta-analysis of 217 spatial-training studies addressing effect magnitude, durability, transfer, age, and training type.
sources.supports: 空间训练总体呈中等幅度改善，效果在延迟测量中较稳定，并可迁移到未训练的空间任务；不同训练方式和年龄均可见收益。
sources.safeUse: 可用于说明空间能力不是完全固定的，训练应把练习、表征方式和真实空间任务连接起来，并分别检验近迁移与远迁移。
sources.boundary: 元分析汇总的是多种空间任务，不能据此声称每个具体范式、学业结果或个体都会得到同等改善，也没有提供统一的脑影像结论。

paradigms.label: 嵌入图形/复杂图形搜索
paradigms.englishLabel: Embedded figures and complex figure search
paradigms.upgradeQuestion: Which source-backed parcels can support embedded-figures/complex figure search as visual disembedding plus attention control?
paradigms.riskNote: 当前 reviewed_parcel 表示 Walter 2011 单项成人 EFT 足以支撑演示主线；仍不能讲成儿童训练效果、临床诊断靶点或跨所有空间表象范式的最终定位。

sources.title: Activation in a Frontoparietal Cortical Network Underlies Individual Differences in the Performance of an Embedded Figures Task
sources.citation: Walter E, Dassonville P. PLoS ONE. 2011;6(7):e20742.
sources.useFor: Primary open task-fMRI source for embedded-figures / visual disembedding. Tables 2-3 report Talairach coordinates for Search > Matching and search-speed correlations.
sources.supports: 开放 PLoS ONE 嵌入图形任务态 fMRI 来源；Table 2 支持 Search > Matching 时顶叶/楔前叶和双侧中额/前运动邻近区参与，Table 3 支持右 TPJ/楔前叶、右 IFG、右岛叶等与搜索速度相关。
sources.safeUse: 可作为嵌入图形/复杂图形搜索的当前主证据：讲成复杂背景中找目标时，顶叶负责图形分离和空间搜索，额叶/右 IFG-岛叶支路参与策略控制和抑制干扰线索。
sources.boundary: Walter 2011 是单项普通成人任务研究，坐标为 Talairach-to-MNI 本地转换后的 Schaefer200 候选；不要讲成儿童训练效果、诊断靶点或跨所有空间表象任务的最终定位。

sources.title: Evaluation of Enhanced Attention to Local Detail in Anorexia Nervosa Using the Embedded Figures Test; an fMRI Study
sources.citation: Fonville L, Giampietro V, Williams SCR, Simmons A, Tchanturia K. PLoS ONE. 2013;8(5):e63964.
sources.useFor: Clinical/boundary embedded-figures fMRI source. Use for healthy-control versus anorexia-nervosa strategy differences, not as the ordinary-student primary overlay.
sources.supports: 临床样本中嵌入图形任务的组间差异，提示健康对照更偏楔前叶，厌食症组更偏右梭状回/局部细节策略。
sources.safeUse: 只作为嵌入图形任务的边界材料：说明不同策略或临床样本可能改变所依赖的视觉/顶叶网络。
sources.boundary: 不要把 AN > HC 或 HC > AN 的组差异坐标当成普通学生的核心功能点，也不要用于 100% 生产主图。

sources.title: Individual differences in brain structure and resting brain function underlie cognitive styles: evidence from the Embedded Figures Test
sources.citation: Hao X, Wang K, Li W, et al. PLoS One. 2013;8(12):e78089.
sources.useFor: Embedded Figures Test related cognitive-style evidence. Use only as a weak task-related candidate until task-activation coordinates are found.
sources.supports: 嵌入图形测验相关的个体差异、脑结构和静息功能候选证据。
sources.safeUse: 只能作为 embedded-figures/field-independence 的弱候选背景，用于说明该任务与视觉分离、局部细节加工和认知风格有关。
sources.boundary: 这不是任务态 fMRI 激活坐标来源，不能把结构/静息结果当成 3D 点位级证据。

sources.title: Attention Response Functions
sources.citation: Culham JC, Cavanagh P, Kanwisher NG. Neuron. 2001;32(4):737-745.
sources.useFor: Multiple object tracking, attentional load, and parietal/frontal attention response language.
sources.supports: 候选用于多目标追踪中注意负荷、视觉空间注意和额顶/顶叶注意反应的任务证据。
sources.safeUse: 可作为多目标追踪的优先区域级证据入口，用于解释动态目标追踪会牵动顶叶和额叶注意系统，并区分 task-only 与 load-dependent 反应。
sources.boundary: PDF 已入库，但未发现显式峰值坐标表；尚未逐坐标映射到 Schaefer200，当前只能作为区域级候选点位依据。

sources.title: Cerebral correlates of preserved cognitive skills in autism
sources.citation: Ring HA, Baron-Cohen S, Wheelwright S, et al. Brain. 1999;122(7):1305-1315.
sources.useFor: Embedded/hidden-figures special-population boundary source. Tables 2-4 are extracted as raw Talairach and MNI-converted review rows for autism/control strategy differences; useful for preserved-skill framing, not ordinary-child production overlay.
sources.supports: Hidden-figures special-population PET/fMRI-style coordinates support clinical/strategy boundary language for embedded figures.
sources.safeUse: 可用于说明特殊人群中嵌入图形策略和视觉局部加工边界。
sources.boundary: 不能把 autism/control 差异直接讲成普通儿童嵌入图形训练靶点。

sources.title: In search of the hidden: an fMRI study with implications for the study of patients with autism and with acquired brain injury
sources.citation: Manjaly ZM, Bruning N, Neufang S, et al. NeuroImage. 2003;19(3):674-683.
sources.useFor: Hidden/embedded figures task-fMRI source. Table 1 has been extracted: Table 1B provides EFT-specific left IFG/ventral premotor and left IPS convergence candidates; Table 1A provides broad visual-search scaffold only.
sources.supports: Hidden figures fMRI coordinates support left IFG/ventral premotor and left IPS consistency candidates, with broad visual-search rows as background.
sources.safeUse: 可用于嵌入图形/复杂图形搜索生产图中补强核心 EFT-specific 点位。

paradigms.label: 数字与数量对应
paradigms.upgradeQuestion: 数字符号与点阵数量之间的对应是否应从数字大小比较中单列？
paradigms.riskNote: 不能把符号与非符号共享活动讲成所有年龄都存在同一抽象数量中心，也不能把认识数字外形等同理解数量意义。

sources.title: The Neural Development of an Abstract Concept of Number
sources.citation: Cantlon JF, Libertus ME, Pinel P, Dehaene S, Brannon EM, Pelphrey KA. Journal of Cognitive Neuroscience. 2009;21(11):2217-2229.
sources.useFor: Child and adult fMRI comparison of symbolic Arabic numerals and nonsymbolic dot arrays using matched numerical ratios.
sources.supports: 6至7岁儿童和成人都完成数字与点阵的大小比较；研究支持符号和非符号数量加工在发展中共享部分顶叶表征，同时保留年龄和形式差异。
sources.safeUse: 可用于解释孩子要把数字符号接到它所代表的数量意义，并把数字形式与点阵数量作为可以比较但不能完全等同的两种输入。
sources.boundary: 这是组水平发展研究，不证明所有年龄都使用完全相同的抽象数量编码；不能把共享顶叶活动讲成单一数量中心或个体数学能力诊断。

sources.title: Origins of Mathematical Intuitions: The Case of Arithmetic
sources.citation: Dehaene S. Annals of the New York Academy of Sciences. 2009;1156(1):232-259.
sources.useFor: Mathematical intuition, number sense, elementary arithmetic, and symbol-to-quantity mapping.
sources.supports: 综述级支持数学直觉、基础算术、数量比较和符号到数量映射与顶叶数量系统有关。
sources.safeUse: 可作为数感/数学直觉的概念框架来源，帮助销售讲解从数量直觉到符号计算的过渡。
sources.boundary: 这是综述级来源，不替代具体任务的峰值坐标；不能单独用于宣布某个 parcel 是数学直觉中心。

sources.title: Is 2 + 2 = 4? Meta-analyses of brain areas needed for numbers and calculations
sources.citation: Arsalidou M, Taylor MJ. NeuroImage. 2011;54(3):2382-2393.
sources.useFor: Number comparison, arithmetic, and calculation network evidence.
sources.supports: 计算与数量加工 fMRI 定量元分析入口；PubMed 摘要支持数字/计算任务共同包含下顶叶活动，并提示不同算术操作在前额叶区域上有分化。
sources.safeUse: 可作为心算和数字比较的计算能力优先核验来源，重点检查 IPS/SPL、下顶叶、视觉符号输入和前额叶步骤控制的分工。
sources.boundary: 当前只完成元数据、PubMed 摘要和任务适配确认；数量大小、符号识别、事实提取、多步骤运算和工作记忆负荷要拆开讲，不能用一个顶叶点代表全部计算，也不能把前额叶候选点讲成所有数字比较都固定参与。

sources.title: Short-term number sense training recapitulates long-term neurodevelopmental changes from childhood to adolescence
sources.citation: Park Y, Zhang Y, Chang H, Menon V. Developmental Science. 2024;27(5):e13524.
sources.useFor: Four-week one-to-one number-sense training in 7- to 10-year-old children with symbolic and nonsymbolic comparison tasks and pre/post fMRI pattern analysis.
sources.supports: 7至10岁儿童接受四周、一周三次、每次约60分钟的一对一数感训练；训练直接围绕点阵与阿拉伯数字的数量对应，训练后符号和非符号比较效率提高，并观察到跨形式神经表征关系变化。
sources.safeUse: 可作为数量理解三联任务中“数字代表多少”一关的直接训练和fMRI锚点，也可说明训练目标是改善跨形式数量加工，而不是机械刷同一种比较题。
sources.boundary: 训练样本、剂量和多变量影像结果不能直接外推成本项目疗效；神经表征相似性训练后下降不等于大脑变差，也不能证明整体数学成绩、数轴或计数都会同步提高。

sources.title: Comparing two cut-off based criteria while investigating the discriminatory characteristics of a tablet-based dyscalculia screening battery for 5-9 age group
sources.citation: Cangoz B, Olkun S, Altun A, Salman F. Archives of Neuropsychiatry. 2018;55(2):177-182.
sources.useFor: A three-part tablet battery combining canonic dot counting, symbolic number comparison, and mental number-line tasks in 316 primary-school children.
sources.supports: 同一测验电池把点阵识别/计数、符号数字比较和0至10或0至100数轴估计放在一起，为数量理解三联任务提供现成结构参照。
sources.safeUse: 可用于三联任务的结构来源，并说明同一个孩子可以在统一入口下分别完成数量识别、符号比较和数轴定位。

sources.supports: 同一测验电池把点阵识别/计数、符号数字比较和0至10或0至100数轴估计放在一起，为数量理解三联任务提供现成结构参照。
sources.safeUse: 可用于三联任务的结构来源，并说明同一个孩子可以在统一入口下分别完成数量识别、符号比较和数轴定位。

sourceIndex.title: Origins of the brain networks for advanced mathematics in expert mathematicians
sourceIndex.citation: Amalric M, Dehaene S. Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences. 2016;113(18):4909-4917.
sourceIndex.useFor: Advanced mathematical reasoning across algebra, analysis, geometry, and topology; use cautiously because participants were expert mathematicians.
sourceIndex.supports: 专家数学家 fMRI 研究显示代数、分析、几何、拓扑等高级数学条件动员一组双侧额叶、顶叶和下颞区域，并与经典语言区相对分离。
sourceIndex.safeUse: 可作为代数、几何和高级数学演示的候选来源，强调高级数学并非只是语言阅读，而会动员空间/数量和额顶推理系统。
sourceIndex.boundary: 研究对象是专家数学家，不等同于儿童或普通学生解题；不能把专家高级数学网络直接当作训练产品已验证靶点。

sourceIndex.title: Inhibition and the right inferior frontal cortex
sourceIndex.citation: Aron AR, Robbins TW, Poldrack RA. Trends in Cognitive Sciences. 2004;8(4):170-177.

sourceIndex.supports: 补强右额下回/额叶岛盖与反应抑制的早期综述背景，尤其适合解释 response inhibition、task-set switching 和记忆抑制可能共享右 IFC 机制的历史脉络。
sourceIndex.safeUse: 可作为 Stop-signal 说明中的 supporting reader，帮助解释为什么右 IFC 是停止控制的高优先级候选区域。
sourceIndex.boundary: 这是 2004 综述，不是 Aron 2014 one-decade-on，也不是坐标源；不能用来关闭 2014 本地全文缺口，不能直接生成 Schaefer200 点位。

sourceIndex.title: Working memory, psychiatric symptoms, and academic performance at school
sourceIndex.citation: Aronen ET, Vuontela V, Steenari MR, Salmi J, Carlson S. Neurobiology of Learning and Memory. 2005;83(1):33-42.
sourceIndex.useFor: Child school-performance association study using visual and auditory n-back tasks plus teacher ratings of academic, attentional, behavioral, and emotional functioning.
sourceIndex.supports: 55名6至13岁儿童完成视觉和听觉N-back；空间工作记忆表现较好与教师评价的学校学业表现较好相关，表现较低者被报告有更多学业和注意/行为困难。

sourceIndex.boundary: 这是横断面相关研究，学业表现来自教师报告，样本较小；不能据此判断因果方向，更不能推成练N-back一定会提高成绩。当前只核验了官方元数据与摘要，尚无合法开放全文进入本地库。

sourceIndex.title: Is 2 + 2 = 4? Meta-analyses of brain areas needed for numbers and calculations

sourceIndex.boundary: 当前只完成元数据、PubMed 摘要和任务适配确认；数量大小、符号识别、事实提取、多步骤运算和工作记忆负荷要拆开讲，不能用一个顶叶点代表全部计算，也不能把前额叶候选点讲成所有数字比较都固定参与。

sourceIndex.title: The interaction of process and domain in prefrontal cortex during inductive reasoning
sourceIndex.citation: Babcock L, Vallesi A. Neuropsychologia. 2015;67:91-99.
sourceIndex.useFor: Inductive reasoning process/domain interaction in prefrontal cortex. PMC full text and Table 2 have been extracted into coordinate intake; next step is production pruning across shared left VLPFC, spatial-domain right PFC, and atlas-boundary rows.
sourceIndex.supports: Table 2 已抽取 pattern discovery、confirmation 和言语/空间领域交互的 MNI 坐标；本项目用于归纳规则发现中左 IFG/VLPFC 和右 PFC 空间/领域策略支路。
sourceIndex.safeUse: 可用于解释归纳推理不是单一 Raven 或关系复杂度任务，而是会受发现规则的过程和材料领域影响。
sourceIndex.boundary: 不能把空间/言语领域效应讲成所有归纳推理都固定激活；尾状核、小脑和广泛颞叶/视觉行不进入当前皮层主图。

sourceIndex.citation: Bartra O, McGuire JT, Kable JW. NeuroImage. 2013;76:412-427.

sourceIndex.safeUse: 可用于解释反馈价值、奖励/惩罚和策略更新如何影响学习任务表现。

sourceIndex.supports: Hippocampal-entorhinal sequence-memory review supports MTL/entorhinal mechanism language for episodic order and temporal sequence memory.
sourceIndex.safeUse: 可用于事件顺序/情景顺序记忆的 MTL/海马-内嗅机制边界。

sourceIndex.title: Training-induced changes in inhibitory control network activity
sourceIndex.citation: Berkman ET, Kahn LE, Merchant JS. Journal of Neuroscience. 2014;34(1):149-157.

sourceIndex.title: Early Intervention for Reading Disabilities: Teaching the Alphabetic Principle in a Connectionist Framework
sourceIndex.citation: Berninger VW, Abbott RD, Zook D, Ogier S, Lemos-Britton Z, Brooksher R. Journal of Learning Disabilities. 1999;32(6):491-503.
sourceIndex.useFor: Randomized early-reading intervention comparing whole-word, subword, and combined instruction in 48 end-of-first-grade children with reading difficulty. Use as near-component evidence for lexical and word-reading instruction.
sourceIndex.supports: 48名一年级末有阅读困难的儿童被随机分配到整词、字词内部单元或两者结合的教学，共8次、每次30分钟；各组在所教词和标准化阅读测验上均有进步，字词内部单元教学在标准化真实词阅读上呈现优势。
sourceIndex.safeUse: 可作为字词识别、拼写声音单元与早期阅读教学的近成分证据，帮助把训练形式写成整词识别、字词拆分和新词迁移三层。
sourceIndex.boundary: 样本小、训练只有8次，且结局不是标准词汇判断任务；不能由此承诺长期篇章理解、学科成绩或普通儿童的统一剂量。

sourceIndex.supports: Go/No-Go训练后抑制速度提高，并伴随双侧额下回功能活动下降、右侧额下回局部灰质和白质指标变化；工作记忆控制任务未见同样改变。
sourceIndex.safeUse: 可用于说明在高剂量、任务高度一致的成人训练中，Go/No-Go表现和额下回功能/结构指标可能同步变化。
sourceIndex.boundary: 样本只有18人且没有独立无训练对照组；每天1小时、连续14天的剂量不能直接迁移到儿童或产品设计，也不能把影像变化讲成越大越好。

sourceIndex.title: Brain Circuitries Involved in Semantic Interference by Demands of Emotional and Non-Emotional Distractors
sourceIndex.citation: Chechko N, Kellermann T, Zvyagintsev M, Augustin M, Schneider F, Habel U. PLoS ONE. 2012;7(5):e38155.
sourceIndex.useFor: Task-family evidence for emotional and non-emotional distractor interference. Use as emotional-interference support for attention/executive-control wording, not as a general clinical claim.
sourceIndex.supports: 情绪与非情绪 distractor interference 的任务族证据，支持情绪材料改变干扰、准确率和控制需求的讲法。
sourceIndex.safeUse: 可作为注意力/执行控制中 emotional distractor 的任务族补强。
sourceIndex.boundary: 单项任务不能泛化为临床结论或所有情绪状态；未做本项目点位终审前不升级为 point-level overlay。

sourceIndex.title: A domain-general brain network underlying emotional and cognitive interference processing: evidence from coordinate-based and functional connectivity meta-analyses
sourceIndex.citation: Chen T, Becker B, Camilleri J, Wang L, Yu S, Eickhoff SB, Feng C. Brain Structure and Function. 2018;223(8):3813-3840.
sourceIndex.useFor: Primary cross-domain emotional and cognitive interference anchor. Use for function-level emotion-cognition modulation and domain-general/domain-specific boundary language, not as direct point-level overlay evidence until source foci and contrasts are separately reviewed.
sourceIndex.supports: 情绪干扰与认知干扰的跨域元分析框架，支持把情绪-认知调制讲成共享控制、显著性和部分情绪特异成分共同作用。
sourceIndex.safeUse: 可用于注意力、执行控制和情绪-认知总框架的机制说明，尤其是 salience capture 和 control demand 两条分支。
sourceIndex.boundary: 不直接升级任一单范式点位；杏仁核、rACC、vmPFC/OFC 等情绪特异成分需要保留为 atlas-boundary 或综述边界。

sourceIndex.title: Evidence for a specific role of the anterior hippocampal region in successful associative encoding
sourceIndex.citation: Chua EF, Schacter DL, Rand-Giovannetti E, Sperling RA. Hippocampus. 2007;17(11):1071-1080.
sourceIndex.useFor: Face-name associative encoding and anterior hippocampal associative-memory support; MNI1305 anterior hippocampal and parahippocampal/perirhinal boundary coordinates have been extracted for the specialized MTL atlas route.
sourceIndex.supports: 候选支持 anterior hippocampal formation 对成功 face-name 联结编码的贡献。
sourceIndex.safeUse: 可用于增强面孔-姓名联结中海马绑定层的证据优先级。
sourceIndex.boundary: 需要全文坐标和任务细节复核，不能直接当成坐标级最终证据。

sourceIndex.title: At the core of reasoning: Dissociating deductive and non-deductive load
sourceIndex.citation: Coetzee JP, Monti MM. Human Brain Mapping. 2018;39(4):1850-1861.
sourceIndex.useFor: Reasoning complexity and memory-complexity contrast source for separating deductive reasoning load from non-deductive memory load.
sourceIndex.supports: Deductive reasoning complexity and reasoning-over-memory contrasts support left frontal rule integration, medial frontal/pre-SMA monitoring and parietal relational workspace.
sourceIndex.safeUse: 可用于演绎推理生产图的前额-顶叶-中线监控主干。
sourceIndex.boundary: Tables 2/4 是非演绎/记忆负荷边界，不应混入演绎推理核心；小脑行留作 atlas-boundary。

sourceIndex.title: Language-specific tuning of visual cortex? Functional properties of the visual word form area
sourceIndex.citation: Cohen L, Lehéricy S, Chochon F, et al. Brain. 2002;125(5):1054-1069.
sourceIndex.useFor: VWFA and ventral occipitotemporal word-form source for orthographic processing and visual word reading. Tables 1-5 have been extracted into 11 Talairach VWFA/visual-input candidate coordinates plus an MNI-converted Schaefer200 review mapping.
sourceIndex.supports: VWFA and visual word-form coordinates support ventral occipitotemporal word-form processing and visual-input boundaries.
sourceIndex.safeUse: 可用于阅读通路中 VWFA/左腹侧颞枕候选层。
sourceIndex.boundary: 不要讲成个体级 VWFA 精确定位；右侧和后部视觉点只作边界。

sourceIndex.title: Exploring the unity and diversity of the neural substrates of executive functioning
sourceIndex.citation: Collette F, Van der Linden M, Laureys S, Delfiore G, Degueldre C, Luxen A, Salmon E. Human Brain Mapping. 2005;25(4):409-423.
sourceIndex.useFor: PET comparison of updating, shifting and inhibition. PMC tables archived/extracted; use Table I/II Talairach coordinates as executive updating/common-EF candidates after MNI conversion, not as keep-track original-task proof.
sourceIndex.supports: Executive-function PET/fMRI coordinate source supports common and diverse updating, inhibition and shifting candidates; local tables have been extracted and converted for updating-family review.
sourceIndex.safeUse: Use as one updating/common-EF candidate source alongside Murty, Nee/Brown and Saylik, especially for frontoparietal and medial control boundaries.
sourceIndex.boundary: Do not treat Collette as a keep-track original task or a production-reviewed overlay by itself; Talairach-derived rows require cross-source pruning.

sourceIndex.title: Sentence complexity and input modality effects in sentence comprehension: an fMRI study
sourceIndex.citation: Constable RT, Pugh KR, Berroya E, et al. NeuroImage. 2004;22(1):11-21.
sourceIndex.useFor: Sentence complexity and input modality source for sentence comprehension and reading/listening boundary evidence. Tables 1/3 have been extracted as 25 Talairach cortical candidates plus 1 thalamus boundary row, with a companion MNI-converted intake for Schaefer200 review; Table 2 remains modality-boundary evidence only.
sourceIndex.supports: Sentence complexity and modality coordinates support sentence-comprehension temporal, frontal and modality-input boundaries.
sourceIndex.safeUse: 可用于句子理解生产图中补强复杂句法/句子整合和视觉/听觉输入边界。
sourceIndex.boundary: Table 2 是输入通道边界，不应混成句子理解核心。

sourceIndex.title: Defining the Neural Mechanisms of Probabilistic Reversal Learning Using Event-Related Functional Magnetic Resonance Imaging
sourceIndex.citation: Cools R, Clark L, Owen AM, Robbins TW. The Journal of Neuroscience. 2002;22(11):4563-4567.
sourceIndex.useFor: Probabilistic reversal learning, feedback learning, cognitive flexibility, and OFC/control-network candidate language.
sourceIndex.supports: 支持概率反转学习作为反馈学习和认知灵活性任务，并提供 OFC/控制相关神经影像入口。
sourceIndex.safeUse: 可用于讲解规则改变后大脑如何利用反馈调整选择策略。
sourceIndex.boundary: 尚未逐坐标映射；且当前 Schaefer200 不覆盖纹状体，不能讲成完整奖赏-基底节环路。

sourceIndex.title: Control of goal-directed and stimulus-driven attention in the brain
sourceIndex.citation: Corbetta M, Shulman GL. Nature Reviews Neuroscience. 2002;3(3):201-215.
sourceIndex.useFor: Attention orienting, dorsal attention, ventral attention, cueing, and reorienting language.
sourceIndex.supports: 注意定向和重定向的综述级网络框架，尤其适合解释背侧目标导向注意与腹侧刺激驱动重定向。
sourceIndex.safeUse: 可用于 Posner 线索任务和注意定向类范式的网络级讲解。
sourceIndex.boundary: 不能直接推出 Schaefer200 某个点位在某个任务中激活，也不能用于个体诊断。

sourceIndex.title: Human memory and the medial temporal region of the brain
sourceIndex.citation: Corsi PM. Doctoral thesis, McGill University. 1972.
sourceIndex.useFor: Primary source for the nine-block spatial-span procedure and its verbal versus nonverbal clinical motivation.
sourceIndex.supports: Corsi在McGill的博士论文中设计了九块黑色木块组成的敲击任务。实验者依次敲击，患者按原顺序复现；这项空间任务与数字序列任务采用相近结构，并在左右颞叶切除患者中显示材料特异性的学习差异。
sourceIndex.safeUse: 可用于说明空间广度为什么不能被数字广度替代，以及九块木块、顺序复现和空间路线的原始任务逻辑。
sourceIndex.boundary: 原论文同时研究短时广度、重复序列学习和颞叶切除，不能把某一组临床结果直接解释成普通儿童的空间广度脑定位。

sourceIndex.title: Object and Spatial Visual Working Memory Activate Separate Neural Systems in Human Cortex
sourceIndex.citation: Courtney SM, Ungerleider LG, Keil K, Haxby JV. Cerebral Cortex. 1996;6(1):39-49.
sourceIndex.useFor: Object versus spatial visual working-memory dissociation; useful for grid span and object-span boundaries.
sourceIndex.supports: 物体与空间视觉工作记忆分离的神经影像来源，可用于空间广度和物体广度的边界。
sourceIndex.safeUse: 用于解释空间广度不是所有视觉短时记忆，也不是物体形状保持；应优先核空间位置保持网络。
sourceIndex.boundary: 需要全文坐标后才能判断哪些 Schaefer200 parcel 可被显示；当前只作为候选来源。

sourceIndex.title: Mechanisms of rule acquisition and rule following in inductive reasoning
sourceIndex.citation: Crescentini C, Seyed-Allaei S, De Pisapia N, et al. Journal of Neuroscience. 2011;31(21):7763-7774.
sourceIndex.useFor: Rule acquisition, rule following, and rule-difficulty evidence for inductive reasoning. PMC full text Tables 2-4 have been extracted into coordinate intake; next step is contrast-level production pruning.
sourceIndex.supports: Tables 2-4 已抽取规则获得、规则跟随和规则难度相关 MNI 坐标；本项目裁剪后用于左额下/额中规则假设、双侧 IPS/SPL 关系工作区和内侧额叶/扣带监控层。
sourceIndex.safeUse: 可用于 `inductive-rule-discovery` 的生产级演示，说明规则发现需要观察样例、保持关系、生成假设并用反馈监控修正。
sourceIndex.boundary: rule-following、感觉运动、小脑、尾状核和广泛视觉/颞叶行不进入主图核心；不能把规则发现等同任务切换或一般执行功能。

sourceIndex.title: Probing emotional influences on cognitive control: an ALE meta-analysis of cognition emotion interactions
sourceIndex.citation: Cromheeke S, Mueller SC. Brain Structure and Function. 2014;219(3):995-1008.
sourceIndex.useFor: Optional emotion-cognition ALE cross-check for cognitive-control modulation, task relevance, and performance-direction boundary language. User-provided PDF is locally archived; Tables 2-4 are preserved as Talairach coordinate intake, not production point evidence.
sourceIndex.supports: 情绪影响认知控制的 ALE 元分析边界源；Tables 2-4 已保留 Talairach intake，可支撑情绪调制控制网络、任务无关情绪干扰和表现方向取决于任务负荷的讲法。
sourceIndex.safeUse: 可用于情绪-认知层说明同一认知任务在情绪条件下会增加额外控制需求，并区分 task-relevant 与 task-irrelevant emotion 的影响。
sourceIndex.boundary: 坐标为 Talairach 且来自跨任务 ALE；未完成 Talairach-to-MNI 转换、contrast review 和 nearest-parcel audit 前，不能进入生产点位或 Schaefer200 parcel 声明；subgenual ACC、amygdala、basal ganglia 等结构保留 atlas-boundary。

sourceIndex.title: Attention Response Functions
sourceIndex.citation: Culham JC, Cavanagh P, Kanwisher NG. Neuron. 2001;32(4):737-745.
sourceIndex.useFor: Multiple object tracking, attentional load, and parietal/frontal attention response language.
sourceIndex.supports: 候选用于多目标追踪中注意负荷、视觉空间注意和额顶/顶叶注意反应的任务证据。
sourceIndex.safeUse: 可作为多目标追踪的优先区域级证据入口，用于解释动态目标追踪会牵动顶叶和额叶注意系统，并区分 task-only 与 load-dependent 反应。
sourceIndex.boundary: PDF 已入库，但未发现显式峰值坐标表；尚未逐坐标映射到 Schaefer200，当前只能作为区域级候选点位依据。

sourceIndex.title: Revealing the mechanisms behind novel auditory stimuli discrimination: An evaluation of silent functional MRI using looping star
sourceIndex.citation: Damestani NL, O'Daly O, Solana AB, Wiesinger F, Lythgoe DJ, Hill S, de Lara Rubio A, Makovac E, Williams SCR, Zelaya F. Human Brain Mapping. 2021;42(9):2833-2850.
sourceIndex.useFor: Open PMC auditory oddball / tone-discrimination fMRI source. Table 2 MNI peaks support an auditory-specific candidate branch for perceptual-discrimination RT: bilateral auditory/STG input, frontal-opercular/anterior-insula salience support, SMA/medial-frontal response preparation, and limited parietal support. Do not use as generic simple RT, ordinary choice RT, SDMT, symbol-search, or classroom processing-speed production evidence.
sourceIndex.supports: Auditory oddball / tone-discrimination task-fMRI coordinates support an auditory-specific candidate branch for perceptual-discrimination RT, including bilateral auditory/STG input, frontal-opercular/anterior-insula salience marking, medial frontal/SMA response preparation and limited parietal support.
sourceIndex.safeUse: 可用于补足知觉辨别反应时里的听觉输入与偏离音检测候选层，说明反应速度不只发生在视觉材料里。
sourceIndex.boundary: 这是 Looping Star versus GRE-EPI auditory oddball 方法学论文中的任务坐标，不是普通 simple RT、ordinary choice RT、SDMT、符号搜索或课堂加工速度 production overlay；采集序列差异不能讲成认知网络差异，小脑/后颅窝行只走专门图谱边界。

sourceIndex.title: Multiple routes to memory: Distinct medial temporal lobe processes build item and source memories
sourceIndex.citation: Davachi L, Mitchell JP, Wagner AD. Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences. 2003;100(4):2157-2162.
sourceIndex.useFor: Task fMRI source separating item recognition from source recollection during encoding. Use for associative-memory and source-memory atlas-boundary language; MTL peaks remain outside the current cortical Schaefer200 display.
sourceIndex.supports: PNAS task fMRI 来源，区分 item recognition 与 source recollection 的编码机制，并指出海马/后海马旁等 MTL 对来源回忆更关键。
sourceIndex.safeUse: 可用于联想记忆和来源记忆的任务身份、MTL 边界和海马不能硬塞进 Schaefer200 的说明。
sourceIndex.boundary: PDF 已入库，但主要关键结构在内侧颞叶；当前皮层模型只能显示语义线索、下顶叶提取和前额叶监控代理层。

sourceIndex.title: Temporal Order Judgments Activate Temporal Parietal Junction
sourceIndex.citation: Davis B, Christie J, Rorden C. The Journal of Neuroscience. 2009;29(10):3182-3188.
sourceIndex.useFor: Temporal order judgment, event timing, and TPJ/IPS/FEF/IFG/SMA candidate mapping boundaries. Tables 1 and 2 have been extracted into a coordinate-intake file; Table 2 thalamus is retained as atlas-boundary evidence.
sourceIndex.supports: 支持时间顺序判断任务和 TPJ 参与事件先后排序的候选证据。
sourceIndex.safeUse: 可用于反应速度/判断速度中“先后顺序判断”的范式身份和 TPJ 候选讲法。
sourceIndex.boundary: 当前显示的 TPJ 是 Schaefer200 代理分区，不能等同论文坐标。

sourceIndex.title: Sources of Mathematical Thinking: Behavioral and Brain-Imaging Evidence
sourceIndex.citation: Dehaene S, Spelke E, Pinel P, Stanescu R, Tsivkin S. Science. 1999;284(5416):970-974.
sourceIndex.useFor: Exact versus approximate arithmetic, language-dependent arithmetic facts, and bilateral parietal magnitude evidence.
sourceIndex.supports: 行为和脑成像证据区分 exact arithmetic 与 approximate arithmetic：精确算术更依赖语言/事实提取，近似算术更依赖双侧顶叶数量和视空间表征。
sourceIndex.safeUse: 可用于把计算能力拆成数学直觉/近似数量、熟练算术事实和在线计算三层，并解释为什么数学直觉和精确答案不是同一套机制。
sourceIndex.boundary: 不能直接把 1999 研究中的条件差异转成当前 Schaefer200 最终点位；题目材料、语言、训练和个体年龄需要另行核验。

sourceIndex.title: Origins of Mathematical Intuitions: The Case of Arithmetic
sourceIndex.citation: Dehaene S. Annals of the New York Academy of Sciences. 2009;1156(1):232-259.
sourceIndex.useFor: Mathematical intuition, number sense, elementary arithmetic, and symbol-to-quantity mapping.
sourceIndex.supports: 综述级支持数学直觉、基础算术、数量比较和符号到数量映射与顶叶数量系统有关。
sourceIndex.safeUse: 可作为数感/数学直觉的概念框架来源，帮助销售讲解从数量直觉到符号计算的过渡。
sourceIndex.boundary: 这是综述级来源，不替代具体任务的峰值坐标；不能单独用于宣布某个 parcel 是数学直觉中心。

sourceIndex.title: Spelling and reading development: The effect of teaching children multiple levels of representation in their orthography
sourceIndex.citation: Devonshire V, Morris P, Fluck M. Learning and Instruction. 2013;25:85-94.
sourceIndex.useFor: Randomized cross-over classroom evidence comparing multi-level orthographic instruction with phonics in 120 English-speaking children aged 5 to 7.
sourceIndex.supports: 120名5至7岁英语儿童参加随机交叉设计；明确联结词形、音韵、词素和词源规则的教学，相比传统自然拼读阶段提高了字词阅读和拼写。
sourceIndex.safeUse: 可用于正字法训练中的多层次比较：孩子既看字母位置和词形，也解释声音、词素与词源为何这样组合。
sourceIndex.boundary: 干预同时包含多个成分，不能把全部效果单独归因于视觉字形加工；英语结果不能直接外推到汉字结构，也没有提供脑成像训练结论。

sourceIndex.title: Diedrichsen Lab cerebellar atlases repository
sourceIndex.citation: Diedrichsen Lab. cerebellar_atlases repository, accessed 2026-06-14.
sourceIndex.useFor: SUIT/MNI cerebellar anatomical lobules and Buckner 7-network labels imported into the specialized atlas registry.
sourceIndex.supports: Provides imported cerebellar anatomical and Buckner 7-network label tables.
sourceIndex.safeUse: Use as atlas provenance for cerebellum labels and physical structure rendering.
sourceIndex.boundary: Atlas labels are spatial references, not task-activation evidence.

sourceIndex.title: Collaborative Activity between Parietal and Dorso-Lateral Prefrontal Cortex in Dynamic Spatial Working Memory Revealed by fMRI
sourceIndex.citation: Diwadkar VA, Carpenter PA, Just MA. NeuroImage. 2000;12(1):85-99.
sourceIndex.useFor: Dynamic spatial working-memory fMRI source for parietal and dorsolateral-prefrontal collaboration.
sourceIndex.supports: 动态空间工作记忆 fMRI 来源，支持顶叶与背外侧前额叶在空间工作记忆中的协作候选。
sourceIndex.safeUse: 用于空间广度中顶叶空间保持和 DLPFC 序列/策略控制的候选连接。
sourceIndex.boundary: 任务是动态空间工作记忆，不等同所有方格广度；坐标映射前不能标为最终点位。

sourceIndex.title: Linking Brain Biology to Intellectual Endowment: A Review on the Associations of Human Intelligence With Neuroimaging Data
sourceIndex.citation: Dizaji AS, Hebling Vieira B, Khodaei MR, Ashrafi M, Parham E, Hossein-Zadeh GA, et al. Basic and Clinical Neuroscience. 2021;12(1):1-28.
sourceIndex.useFor: Reasoning/Raven/WAIS/P-FIT interpretation boundaries; use to avoid diagnostic IQ or single intelligence-node claims, not as coordinate evidence.
sourceIndex.supports: 综述层支持把 WAIS/Raven/P-FIT、工作记忆、加工速度和神经影像预测结果分开解释，避免把智力讲成一个单一点位或单一网络。
sourceIndex.safeUse: 可作为 Raven-like 推理、加工速度和智力相关销售话术的边界护栏。
sourceIndex.boundary: 这是综述，不提供任务 fMRI 峰值坐标；不能用于生成 3D 点位、个体 IQ 诊断或训练效果证明。

sourceIndex.title: Executive control during episodic retrieval: multiple prefrontal processes subserve source memory
sourceIndex.citation: Dobbins IG, Foley H, Schacter DL, Wagner AD. Neuron. 2002;35(5):989-996.
sourceIndex.useFor: Task fMRI source for prefrontal control during episodic/source retrieval. Use for source-monitoring and retrieval-control claims; full text still needs institution access.
sourceIndex.supports: 候选用于来源记忆中前额叶控制、提取策略和来源监控的任务 fMRI 证据。
sourceIndex.safeUse: 可用于说明 source-memory 不只是再认，还需要前额叶参与来源判断和控制检索。
sourceIndex.boundary: 当前只完成元数据核验，Neuron 全文仍需机构权限；不能把 DLPFC 点位讲成已由该文坐标复核。

sourceIndex.title: Neuroplasticity: changes in grey matter induced by training
sourceIndex.citation: Draganski B, Gaser C, Busch V, Schuierer G, Bogdahn U, May A. Nature. 2004;427:311-312.
sourceIndex.useFor: Three-month juggling acquisition with repeated structural MRI in 24 young adults, showing transient grey-matter change in visual-motion and parietal regions.
sourceIndex.supports: 24名年轻成人中，学习三球杂耍的组在3个月后出现双侧hMT/V5和左后顶内沟灰质暂时增加，停止练习后的第三次扫描显示部分回落。
sourceIndex.safeUse: 可作为感知运动学习引起成人脑结构可塑性的经典背景证据，帮助解释训练剂量、持续练习和停止练习后的变化。
sourceIndex.boundary: 杂耍不是九项功能中的标准认知范式，也不是儿童学习训练；只能作为广义可塑性背景，不能证明推理、速度或表象能力会自动迁移。

sourceIndex.title: Isolation of a Central Bottleneck of Information Processing with Time-Resolved fMRI
sourceIndex.citation: Dux PE, Ivanoff J, Asplund CL, Marois R. Neuron. 2006;52(6):1109-1120.
sourceIndex.useFor: Dual-task central-bottleneck source for information-processing limits and response-selection delay. Table 1 has been extracted as review-level ROI mean Talairach coordinates plus an MNI-converted Schaefer200 trial mapping; use left pLPFC and SMFC cautiously as bottleneck candidates, not as ordinary whole-brain peak evidence.
sourceIndex.supports: Dual-task central bottleneck ROI coordinates support pLPFC and SMFC bottleneck candidates for dual-task and response-selection limits.
sourceIndex.safeUse: 可用于双任务/反应选择瓶颈边界，解释并行任务时的中心处理限制。
sourceIndex.boundary: ROI mean 不是普通 whole-brain peak；不能替代 ordinary choice RT 或 simple RT。

sourceIndex.title: Training improves multitasking performance by increasing the speed of information processing in human prefrontal cortex
sourceIndex.citation: Dux PE, Tombu MN, Harrison S, Rogers BP, Tong F, Marois R. Neuron. 2009;63(1):127-138.
sourceIndex.useFor: Two-week dual-task practice with three fMRI sessions, testing how multitasking costs and prefrontal information-processing dynamics change with training.
sourceIndex.supports: 7名成人在约2周、8次双任务练习后，双任务反应时成本由约400 ms降到约40 ms；fMRI结果支持左侧额下交界的信息处理时序加快。
sourceIndex.safeUse: 可用于说明双任务干扰可以在高度相似的任务条件下通过重复练习明显降低，并为并行任务训练中的反应选择、节奏和自动化设计提供机制依据。
sourceIndex.boundary: 样本只有7名成人，训练任务和测验高度相似，残余双任务成本仍存在；不能讲成多任务能力被彻底消除、可远迁移到学习成绩或适用于儿童。

sourceIndex.title: Neural Correlates of Verbal Working Memory: An fMRI Meta-Analysis
sourceIndex.citation: Emch M, von Bastian CC, Koch K. Frontiers in Human Neuroscience. 2019;13:180.
sourceIndex.useFor: Verbal working-memory meta-analysis for phonological store, rehearsal, frontoparietal control, and digit-span/PASAT/n-back boundaries.
sourceIndex.supports: 语音/言语工作记忆 fMRI 元分析入口，可用于核验数字广度、PASAT、言语 n-back 等任务中语音保持、复述和额顶控制的共同成分。
sourceIndex.safeUse: 优先用于数字广度的语音工作记忆来源补强，并帮助区分言语短时记忆和通用工作记忆核心。
sourceIndex.boundary: 主表坐标和补充材料已进入抽取/溯源层，但任务分类与 Schaefer200 最近点仍需逐条复核；不能把当前数字广度点位标为坐标已核。

sourceIndex.title: Effects of memory training on cortical thickness in the elderly
sourceIndex.citation: Engvig A, Fjell AM, Westlye LT, et al. NeuroImage. 2010;52(4):1667-1676.
sourceIndex.useFor: Eight-week Method-of-Loci training in middle-aged and older adults with pre/post memory testing and structural MRI cortical-thickness analysis.
sourceIndex.supports: 42名完成者中，训练组接受8周地点法记忆训练；来源记忆表现提高，并相较被动控制组出现局部皮层厚度增加，厚度变化与记忆改善相关。
sourceIndex.safeUse: 可用于说明在中老年样本中，结构化记忆策略训练可能同时伴随来源记忆改善和局部结构MRI变化。
sourceIndex.boundary: 样本为42至77岁的健康中老年人，控制组是被动控制；不能外推到儿童、一般学习成绩或所有长期记忆训练。MRI形态变化也不是个体诊断指标。

sourceIndex.title: Effector-dependent neural representations of perceptual decisions independent of motor actions and sensory modalities
sourceIndex.citation: Esmeyer J, Schmidt TT, Blankenburg F. Imaging Neuroscience. 2025;3:IMAG.a.11.
sourceIndex.useFor: Visual delayed match-to-comparison fMRI plus cross-modal visual/vibrotactile conjunction source for perceptual-decision representations in IPS and PMd. PMC peak coordinates are extracted and NeuroVault WILTPYNG stat-map zip has passed map-level integrity review; threshold/cluster/parcel review remains optional if a production map is needed. Use as candidate evidence for cross-modal perceptual-discrimination RT; do not use as generic simple RT, SDMT, ordinary choice RT, or auditory RT evidence.
sourceIndex.supports: Visual delayed match-to-comparison fMRI and a visual/vibrotactile conjunction support IPS and PMd candidate coordinates for perceptual-decision representations that are not tied to one sensory modality or one final motor action.
sourceIndex.safeUse: 可用于知觉辨别反应时中说明“差异判断”不只是视觉输入，还可能经过顶叶抽象决策和前运动效应器准备路线。
sourceIndex.boundary: 跨模态 conjunction 是候选层，不能升成普通 reaction-speed production map；它也不能替代 SDMT、ordinary choice RT、simple RT 或听觉专门反应时来源。

sourceIndex.title: Emotional processing in anterior cingulate and medial prefrontal cortex
sourceIndex.citation: Etkin A, Egner T, Kalisch R. Trends in Cognitive Sciences. 2011;15(2):85-93.
sourceIndex.useFor: ACC/mPFC appraisal-expression versus regulation boundary source for emotion-cognition mechanism language. User-provided PDF is locally archived; use as review/boundary evidence, not point-level overlay, diagnosis, or training-efficacy evidence.
sourceIndex.supports: ACC/mPFC 情绪加工综述边界，支持把内侧额叶讲成情绪评价/表达与情绪调节共同参与的系统，而不是简单 dorsal cognitive / ventral affective 二分。
sourceIndex.safeUse: 可用于情绪-认知调制层中解释情绪压力、恐惧/焦虑线索、评价、反应表达和调节需求如何改变注意与执行控制负荷。
sourceIndex.boundary: 综述级边界源，不提供本项目可直接投影的单任务点位；不能用于临床诊断、个体情绪调节评估、训练疗效或新的 3D overlay 升级。

sourceIndex.title: Toward defining deep brain stimulation targets in MNI space: A subcortical atlas based on multimodal MRI, histology and structural connectivity
sourceIndex.citation: Ewert S, Plettig P, Chakravarty MM, Kuhn AA, Horn A. NeuroImage. 2018;170:271-282.
sourceIndex.useFor: Subcortical atlas methodology source for DISTAL / Lead-DBS targets in MNI 152 NLIN 2009b space. Use for STN, GPi/GPe, VIM and DBS-target atlas-boundary language; not for task activation or behavioral training effects.
sourceIndex.safeUse: Use only as a metadata/source-reading entry until a review contract is added.
sourceIndex.boundary: Do not promote this source beyond the current evidence tier without review.

sourceIndex.title: Similarity Breeds Proximity: Pattern Similarity within and across Contexts Is Related to Later Mnemonic Judgments of Temporal Proximity
sourceIndex.citation: Ezzyat Y, Davachi L. Neuron. 2014;81(5):1179-1189.
sourceIndex.useFor: Temporal-proximity and context-boundary fMRI source. Supplemental Table S2 reports MNI coordinates now extracted for episodic-order-memory candidate mapping; thalamus, striatum, cerebellum and parahippocampal rows remain atlas boundaries.
sourceIndex.supports: Temporal-proximity pattern-similarity source provides Supplemental Table S2 MNI cortical peaks for context-boundary and temporal-proximity candidate review, plus subcortical/cerebellar/MTL atlas-boundary rows.
sourceIndex.safeUse: Use as a candidate temporal-proximity / context-boundary layer for episodic-order memory, especially medial frontal, parietal, IFG/insula and visual/context-boundary nodes.
sourceIndex.boundary: Do not mix Supplemental Table S1 source-memory context rows into the temporal-proximity overlay; do not treat this candidate layer as full autobiographical or story event-order memory.

sourceIndex.title: Testing the Efficiency and Independence of Attentional Networks
sourceIndex.citation: Fan J, McCandliss BD, Sommer T, Raz A, Posner MI. Journal of Cognitive Neuroscience. 2002;14(3):340-347.
sourceIndex.useFor: ANT task identity, behavioral efficiency scores for alerting, orienting, and executive attention.
sourceIndex.supports: ANT 的行为范式身份：用同一个反应时任务估计 alerting、orienting 和 executive attention 三类注意网络效率。
sourceIndex.safeUse: 可用于说明 ANT 为什么是注意力的核心基础范式，以及为什么它比单一反应时任务更适合拆解注意力成分。
sourceIndex.boundary: 这是行为任务和效率指标来源，不直接提供 Schaefer200 点位定位。

sourceIndex.title: The activation of attentional networks
sourceIndex.citation: Fan J, McCandliss BD, Fossella J, Flombaum JI, Posner MI. NeuroImage. 2005;26(2):471-479.
sourceIndex.useFor: ANT fMRI evidence for regional alerting, orienting and executive-control associations. The 26 table coordinates were reported in Talairach after Brett conversion; legacy intake mislabeled them MNI. Current display anchors are not validated published-peak placements.
sourceIndex.supports: 事件相关 fMRI ANT 研究支持警觉、定向和执行冲突的区域/网络关联。Tables 3–5 的 26 组数字已对照原表；原文报告的是经 Brett 转换的 Talairach，旧记录误标为 MNI，可另作明确标注的教学近似对照，尚不能支持当前模型的精确逐峰定位。
sourceIndex.safeUse: 可用于讲解 ANT 的警觉准备、空间定向与冲突控制。网页位置为区域教学锚点，不代表 Fan 2005 原始峰值或已验证的峰值到分区映射。
sourceIndex.boundary: 当前小脑、丘脑等节点为结构示意。原文坐标系已在修复记录中更正，逐行来源已建立；历史变换到当前模板的适用性仍待验证；不以最近 parcel 代替配准，也不作为训练靶点或个体诊断。

sourceIndex.title: Quantitative Characterization of Functional Anatomical Contributions to Cognitive Control under Uncertainty
sourceIndex.citation: Fan J, Gu X, Liu X, Guise KG, Park Y, Martin L, de Marchena A, Tang CY, Minzenberg MJ, Hof PR. Journal of Cognitive Neuroscience. 2014;26(7):1490-1506.
sourceIndex.useFor: Visual majority-function fMRI source for information-entropy, uncertainty and control-load effects. Figure 4 ROI coordinates are extracted as a bridge for perceptual-decision RT explanation, but this does not replace Wu 2018 ordinary choice-RT / Hick-Hyman supplementary tables.
sourceIndex.supports: Visual majority-function fMRI supports information-entropy/control-load candidate coordinates for ACC, anterior insula, FEF, IPC/IPS and visual regions, with thalamus and cerebellar vermis retained as specialized-atlas boundaries.
sourceIndex.safeUse: 可用于知觉辨别反应时中解释“刺激信息不确定性越高，反应越慢，额顶扣带/前岛控制系统越需要介入”的桥接讲法。
sourceIndex.boundary: 这不是 ordinary Hick-Hyman response-alternative choice RT；response selection 在任务里是二选一且恒定，不能替代 Wu 2018 supplement；丘脑和小脑不能硬映射成 Schaefer200 皮层点。

sourceIndex.title: Cortical network modulations associated with prolonged training of the multiple object-tracking task
sourceIndex.citation: Felssberg AM, Schonemann N, Hopf JM, Schoenfeld MA, Merkel C. Imaging Neuroscience. 2025;3:imag_a_00577.
sourceIndex.useFor: Five-session multiple-object-tracking training over two weeks with pre/post task fMRI in 33 adults.
sourceIndex.supports: 训练后MOT表现提高，目标位置表征更多在视觉皮层巩固，额叶控制网络中的对象式表征作用相对变化；论文同时强调向其他任务的迁移有限。
sourceIndex.safeUse: 可用于多目标追踪训练的直接证据，并帮助设计目标数量、速度、干扰密度和追踪持续时间的渐进负荷。
sourceIndex.boundary: 成人任务特异训练、没有独立未训练对照组，且研究本身指出迁移有限；不能把MOT收益讲成一般注意力或运动表现提升。

sourceIndex.title: Exploring Neural Efficiency in Multiple Sclerosis Patients during the Symbol Digit Modalities Test: A Functional Magnetic Resonance Imaging Study
sourceIndex.citation: Fittipaldi-Marquez MS, et al. Neurodegenerative Diseases. 2017;17(6):292-300.
sourceIndex.useFor: Supplementary SDMT task-fMRI coordinate source. Figshare S1-S2 provide MNI activation tables for MS patients and healthy controls across SDMT ISI conditions and task-load contrasts; use as SDMT/coding-speed cross-check and load boundary, not as the primary healthy-student overlay.
sourceIndex.supports: SDMT fMRI 补充表来源，S1/S2 报告 MS 患者和健康对照在不同 ISI 条件下执行 SDMT 的 MNI 激活坐标，以及 1.5s ISI 相比 2s/2.5s 的负荷增强坐标。
sourceIndex.safeUse: 可用于补强符号搜索/编码速度的跨源一致性检查，特别是视觉输入、额顶扫描/控制、MTL/皮层外和小脑边界，以及任务负荷变高时激活增强的候选说明。
sourceIndex.boundary: 这是 MS/HC 样本和任务负荷研究，不替代 Forn 2009 的健康成人主 overlay；没有主文终审前，不讲成学生加工速度、普通反应时、个体诊断或训练效果证据。

sourceIndex.title: Evaluation of Enhanced Attention to Local Detail in Anorexia Nervosa Using the Embedded Figures Test; an fMRI Study
sourceIndex.citation: Fonville L, Giampietro V, Williams SCR, Simmons A, Tchanturia K. PLoS ONE. 2013;8(5):e63964.
sourceIndex.useFor: Clinical/boundary embedded-figures fMRI source. Use for healthy-control versus anorexia-nervosa strategy differences, not as the ordinary-student primary overlay.
sourceIndex.supports: 临床样本中嵌入图形任务的组间差异，提示健康对照更偏楔前叶，厌食症组更偏右梭状回/局部细节策略。
sourceIndex.safeUse: 只作为嵌入图形任务的边界材料：说明不同策略或临床样本可能改变所依赖的视觉/顶叶网络。
sourceIndex.boundary: 不要把 AN > HC 或 HC > AN 的组差异坐标当成普通学生的核心功能点，也不要用于 100% 生产主图。

sourceIndex.title: A Symbol Digit Modalities Test version suitable for functional MRI studies
sourceIndex.citation: Forn C, Belloch V, Bustamante JC, Garbin G, Parcet-Ibars MA, Sanjuan A, Ventura N, Avila C. Neuroscience Letters. 2009;456(1):11-14.
sourceIndex.useFor: Primary SDMT task-fMRI coordinate source for symbol digit / coding-speed visual scanning, frontoparietal attention-working-memory and response-selection candidates; caudate and cerebellum remain atlas-boundary evidence.
sourceIndex.supports: SDMT 直接任务 fMRI 来源，Table 1 报告健康成人执行 SDMT 时的 Talairach 峰值，覆盖枕叶/枕颞视觉输入、顶叶/楔前叶扫描注意、额叶规则/反应支持，并报告尾状核和小脑边界点。
sourceIndex.safeUse: 可用于把符号搜索/编码速度从区域级说明推进到 SDMT 专门坐标候选层；适合讲视觉符号输入、顶叶扫描/匹配、额叶反应准备和皮层外边界共同支撑加工速度。
sourceIndex.boundary: Forn 2009 不是普通反应时或所有课堂加工速度的坐标源；尾状核和小脑点不能强行映射到 Schaefer200，视觉峰值也需要生产裁剪后再演示。

sourceIndex.title: Spatial transformation abilities and their relation to later academic achievement
sourceIndex.citation: Frick A. Psychological Research. 2019;83(7):1465-1484.
sourceIndex.useFor: Developmental behavioral evidence linking spatial transformation abilities to arithmetic, numeric-logical, spatial, and geometry performance.
sourceIndex.supports: 发展/行为层面支持空间变换能力与学习成就关系，可用于空间折叠和表象操作的训练意义边界。
sourceIndex.safeUse: 可用于解释为什么空间变换能力值得作为表象操作能力的训练入口之一。
sourceIndex.boundary: 该来源不提供任务态 fMRI 坐标，不能单独支撑 3D 点位。

sourceIndex.title: Brain areas underlying visual mental imagery and visual perception: an fMRI study
sourceIndex.citation: Ganis G, Thompson WL, Kosslyn SM. Cognitive Brain Research. 2004;20(2):226-241.
sourceIndex.useFor: Visual mental imagery and visual perception overlap/difference evidence.
sourceIndex.supports: fMRI 研究用于比较视觉心理表象和视觉感知涉及的脑区重叠与差异；用户补入 PDF 后，Tables 3-4 已抽取并转为 MNI/Schaefer200 坐标候选。
sourceIndex.safeUse: 可作为视觉表象任务的神经影像入口，帮助解释内部图像生成会牵动视觉、顶叶和额叶控制支架；当前适合做 70% 坐标候选展示。
sourceIndex.boundary: 坐标已完成候选映射，但尚未人工裁剪 production overlay；common imagery-perception 与 perception-only ventral temporal 边界要分开讲，不能声称 imagery-only 精确点位已终审。

sourceIndex.title: Change Detection: Training and Transfer
sourceIndex.citation: Gaspar JG, Neider MB, Simons DJ, McCarley JS, Kramer AF. PLoS ONE. 2013;8(6):e67781.
sourceIndex.useFor: Direct adaptive object-change training source with active controls and explicit near- and broader-transfer tests.
sourceIndex.supports: 40名年轻成人和40名老年成人分别进入变化检测训练或电脑纸牌主动对照。训练组完成16次、每次一小时的自适应练习，在三或五个汽车、标志、形状、字母物体中找变化。训练后的编码速度提高，但更换为彩条的一次性变化检测和真实驾驶场景闪烁变化检测都没有优于对照组。
sourceIndex.safeUse: 可用于说明物体变化检测练习能够提高训练材料上的速度和准确性，同时提醒读者把原任务进步、换材料迁移和真实情境迁移分开检验。
sourceIndex.boundary: 样本是成人，训练剂量很高，且自适应变量主要是编码时间。不能把结果外推为儿童物体广度训练处方，也不能把熟悉训练材料后的进步写成视觉工作记忆容量普遍提升。

sourceIndex.title: Probabilistic and deductive reasoning in the human brain
sourceIndex.citation: Gazzo Castañeda LE, Sklarek B, Dal Mas DE, et al. NeuroImage. 2023;275:120180.
sourceIndex.useFor: Modern fMRI source contrasting probabilistic and deductive reasoning. Tables 1-3 have been extracted into coordinate intake: cortical deductive/probabilistic peaks are Schaefer200 candidates, while hippocampal ROI/SVC rows stay as MTL atlas-boundary evidence.
sourceIndex.supports: Modern probabilistic versus deductive reasoning fMRI supports right IFC, dACC/mCC and parietal/precuneus deductive candidates plus vmPFC/insula/MTL probability candidates.
sourceIndex.safeUse: 可用于演绎推理生产图的右额/中线补强，并为概率判断保留候选边界。
sourceIndex.boundary: 概率分支不能直接讲成课堂概率统计；hippocampal ROI/SVC 行必须走 MTL 专门图谱。

sourceIndex.title: A Large-Scale Distributed Network for Covert Spatial Attention
sourceIndex.citation: Gitelman DR, Nobre AC, Parrish TB, et al. Brain. 1999;122(6):1093-1106.
sourceIndex.useFor: Covert spatial attention and spatial cueing source with Table 1 ICBM-Talairach cortical peaks extracted and converted to MNI; thalamus and basal-ganglia rows are kept as specialized-atlas boundary evidence.
sourceIndex.supports: Covert spatial attention task-fMRI coordinates support dorsal/ventral attention orienting candidates, with thalamus and basal-ganglia rows kept as atlas-boundary evidence.
sourceIndex.safeUse: 可用于 Posner/cueing 和空间注意讲法中补强 TPJ、FEF/顶叶、丘脑/基底节边界。
sourceIndex.boundary: 这是 covert spatial attention 来源，不替代 ANT 全部 alerting/orienting/executive 分解；皮层外结构不能硬映射成 Schaefer200。

sourceIndex.title: Mental Paper Folding Performance Following Penetrating Traumatic Brain Injury in Combat Veterans: A Lesion Mapping Study
sourceIndex.citation: Glass L, Krueger F, Solomon J, Raymont V, Grafman J. Cerebral Cortex. 2013;23(7):1663-1672.
sourceIndex.useFor: Task-specific VLSM lesion-deficit Talairach peaks for AFQT-7 boxes / mental paper folding; use as causal lesion boundary, not fMRI activation.
sourceIndex.supports: VLSM 病灶-缺损研究提供 AFQT boxes / mental paper folding 的 Talairach 坐标边界，稳定主线是右 IPL/BA40 和左海马旁/枕颞区域。
sourceIndex.safeUse: 可用于说明空间折叠/展开表现对右顶叶空间变换和左海马旁/枕颞构型支持很敏感，并作为 3D 候选点位复核来源。
sourceIndex.boundary: 这是病灶因果边界，不是 task-fMRI 激活；不能讲成训练时这些区域一定点亮，也不能据此宣称 reviewed parcel。

sourceIndex.title: Fractionating human intelligence
sourceIndex.citation: Hampshire A, Highfield RR, Parkin BL, Owen AM. Neuron. 2012;76(6):1225-1237.
sourceIndex.useFor: Reasoning, short-term memory, verbal reasoning, and task-family decomposition.
sourceIndex.supports: 候选用于把推理、短时记忆和语言推理等成分拆分的任务研究。
sourceIndex.safeUse: 可用于推理和短时记忆演示中的任务成分拆分。
sourceIndex.boundary: 它不是九项脑功能训练系统本身的验证研究，不能直接替代产品效果证据。

sourceIndex.title: Activation and effective connectivity changes following explicit-memory training for face-name pairs in patients with mild cognitive impairment: a pilot study
sourceIndex.citation: Hampstead BM, Stringer AY, Stilla RF, et al. Neurorehabilitation and Neural Repair. 2011;25(3):210-222.
sourceIndex.useFor: Pilot explicit-memory training study with three face-name mnemonic sessions and pre/post fMRI in six patients with amnestic multidomain MCI.
sourceIndex.supports: 训练项目在行为上改善，并伴随训练项目特异的分布式激活和连接增加；助记策略将面部特征、语言线索与心理表象结合。
sourceIndex.safeUse: 可用于面孔-姓名联结和联想记忆训练的策略机制：把难记的配对转成显著视觉特征、语言钩子和可回想图像。
sourceIndex.boundary: 只有6名MCI患者、无独立对照组，属于先导研究；不能外推到健康儿童、所有情景记忆或海马结构变化。

sourceIndex.title: Individual differences in brain structure and resting brain function underlie cognitive styles: evidence from the Embedded Figures Test
sourceIndex.citation: Hao X, Wang K, Li W, et al. PLoS One. 2013;8(12):e78089.
sourceIndex.useFor: Embedded Figures Test related cognitive-style evidence. Use only as a weak task-related candidate until task-activation coordinates are found.
sourceIndex.supports: 嵌入图形测验相关的个体差异、脑结构和静息功能候选证据。
sourceIndex.safeUse: 只能作为 embedded-figures/field-independence 的弱候选背景，用于说明该任务与视觉分离、局部细节加工和认知风格有关。
sourceIndex.boundary: 这不是任务态 fMRI 激活坐标来源，不能把结构/静息结果当成 3D 点位级证据。

sourceIndex.title: Understanding spatial transformations: similarities and differences between mental rotation and mental folding
sourceIndex.citation: Harris J, Hirsh-Pasek K, Newcombe NS. Cognitive Processing. 2013;14(2):105-115.
sourceIndex.useFor: Spatial transformation conceptual boundary source for separating mental rotation from mental folding. Local PDF review confirmed DOI 10.1007/s10339-013-0544-6 and no numeric MNI/Talairach coordinate table; use it for rigid versus non-rigid transformation, strategy and development boundaries, not direct 3D point overlays.
sourceIndex.supports: Spatial transformation review supports conceptual separation between mental rotation and mental folding.
sourceIndex.safeUse: 可用于空间折叠/心理旋转的任务边界和发展/策略讲法。
sourceIndex.boundary: 综述不提供任务态 fMRI 坐标；不能用于 3D 点位主图。

sourceIndex.title: A general mechanism for perceptual decision-making in the human brain
sourceIndex.citation: Heekeren HR, Marrett S, Bandettini PA, Ungerleider LG. Nature. 2004;431(7010):859-862.
sourceIndex.useFor: Visual perceptual-decision fMRI source for noisy face/house categorization. Figure 4 provides two MNI left posterior DLPFC/SFS decision-integration candidate coordinates; Figure 3 attention-demand regions are qualitative boundaries only.
sourceIndex.supports: Visual perceptual-decision fMRI supports left posterior DLPFC / superior frontal sulcus candidate coordinates for integrating sensory evidence from face- and house-selective visual regions.
sourceIndex.safeUse: 可用于知觉辨别反应时中“感觉证据比较清楚以后进入决策整合”的候选讲法。
sourceIndex.boundary: 不是普通 simple RT、symbol search 或听觉 Tone 辨别坐标；Figure 3 的 FEF/SEF/IPS/INS 只有图示标签，不能直接变成 Schaefer200 点位。

sourceIndex.title: The neural mechanisms of top-down attentional control
sourceIndex.citation: Hopfinger JB, Buonocore MH, Mangun GR. Nature Neuroscience. 2000;3(3):284-291.
sourceIndex.useFor: Symbolic cue task fMRI evidence for top-down spatial attention preparation. Table 1 has been extracted into a coordinate-intake file; use for Posner/cueing candidate points while preserving target-response and insula/putamen boundaries.
sourceIndex.supports: 事件相关 fMRI 空间线索研究报告 cue 阶段的额顶、后扣带、STS 和 lateral occipital 激活；Table 1 已抽取为 Posner/cueing 的 MNI 坐标候选。
sourceIndex.safeUse: 可用于把 Posner/空间线索任务从纯网络级说明推进到坐标候选层，表达线索出现后大脑先准备空间注意，再进入目标处理。
sourceIndex.boundary: Hopfinger 2000 不是完整 Posner/ANT 分类；SPL cue > target 行需保留显著性边界，insula/putamen 混合标签不能硬映射到皮层，target-response 行未纳入 cue-preparation overlay。

sourceIndex.title: Neural foundations of logical and mathematical cognition
sourceIndex.citation: Houde O, Tzourio-Mazoyer N. Nature Reviews Neuroscience. 2003;4(6):507-514.
sourceIndex.useFor: Logical and mathematical cognition, inhibition of intuitive errors, and shifting from perceptual/intuitive response to logical reasoning.
sourceIndex.supports: 综述级连接逻辑和数学认知，并把抑制直觉/知觉错误、从直觉反应切换到逻辑推理作为关键机制之一。
sourceIndex.safeUse: 适合支撑应用题逻辑建模和概率统计中“先有冲动答案，再由冲突/控制系统切回规则和逻辑”的讲解框架。
sourceIndex.boundary: 综述不能直接提供单一应用题或统计题的坐标；使用时必须说明这是跨任务合成框架。

sourceIndex.title: Reaction time and movement time as measures of stimulus evaluation and response processes
sourceIndex.citation: Houlihan M, Campbell K, Stelmack RM. Intelligence. 1994;18(3):289-307.
sourceIndex.useFor: Simple and choice reaction-time decomposition into stimulus evaluation, response selection, and movement/output timing.
sourceIndex.supports: 候选用于把反应时和运动时分解为刺激评价、反应选择和动作输出过程的行为来源。
sourceIndex.safeUse: 可用于把简单反应时作为行为基线，讲刺激评估和动作输出速度。
sourceIndex.boundary: 这是行为过程来源，不支持具体脑区激活或复杂网络声称。

sourceIndex.title: Hippocampal Activity Patterns Carry Information about Objects in Temporal Context
sourceIndex.citation: Hsieh LT, Gruber MJ, Jenkins LJ, Ranganath C. Neuron. 2014;81(5):1165-1178.
sourceIndex.useFor: Hippocampal/MTL ROI and MVPA mechanism source for temporal-context sequence memory. Local article and supplement were reviewed: use as MTL boundary/mechanism evidence, not as a Schaefer200 coordinate table.
sourceIndex.supports: Object-in-temporal-context MVPA source supports hippocampus, PRc, PHc and anterior/posterior hippocampal ROI mechanism boundaries for sequence and temporal-context memory.
sourceIndex.safeUse: Use for MTL/hippocampal temporal-context mechanism narration and specialized-atlas boundary language in episodic-order memory.
sourceIndex.boundary: The reviewed article and supplement do not provide a numeric MNI/Talairach peak table; do not create Schaefer200 cortical overlay points from this source alone.

sourceIndex.title: Dissociations of cognitive inhibition, response inhibition, and emotional interference: Voxelwise ALE meta-analyses of fMRI studies
sourceIndex.citation: Hung Y, Gaillard SL, Yarmak P, Arsalidou M. Human Brain Mapping. 2018;39:4065-4082.
sourceIndex.useFor: Coordinate-based ALE meta-analysis separating cognitive inhibition, response inhibition, and emotional interference; Table II Talairach clusters are preserved as intake candidates only.
sourceIndex.supports: 认知抑制、反应抑制和情绪干扰三类抑制系统的 ALE 元分析边界；Table II 已保留 Talairach 坐标 intake，可支撑情绪-认知调制和执行控制拆分讲法。
sourceIndex.safeUse: 可用于说明情绪干扰不是普通认知冲突的简单变体，并用于区分 Stroop/Flanker、Go/No-Go/Stop-signal、emotional distractor 类任务的机制边界。
sourceIndex.boundary: Table II 坐标为 Talairach 且来自跨任务元分析；未完成 Talairach-to-MNI 转换、contrast review 和 nearest-parcel audit 前，不能进入生产点位或 Schaefer200 parcel 声明；amygdala/basal ganglia/thalamus/midbrain 行只能作 atlas-boundary。

sourceIndex.title: Cognitive tutoring induces widespread neuroplasticity and remediates brain function in children with mathematical learning disabilities
sourceIndex.citation: Iuculano T, Rosenberg-Lee M, Richardson J, Tenison C, Fuchs L, Supekar K, Menon V. Nature Communications. 2015;6:8453.
sourceIndex.useFor: Eight-week one-to-one math tutoring in children with mathematical learning disabilities, with behavioral improvement and pre/post task-fMRI normalization evidence.
sourceIndex.supports: 8周一对一数学辅导后，数学学习困难儿童的算术表现改善，算术任务中的分布式脑反应也出现训练前后变化，可作为计算训练行为与fMRI共同变化的强锚点。
sourceIndex.safeUse: 可用于说明在明确样本、训练剂量和算术任务条件下，针对性辅导可能同时伴随行为改善与任务脑反应变化。
sourceIndex.boundary: 样本是数学学习困难儿童，不能外推到所有儿童、所有数学能力或本项目疗效；未经过坐标复核前不得加入生产3D点位。

sourceIndex.title: Experiments on "Prehension"
sourceIndex.useFor: Historical origin of the gradually lengthened immediate digit and letter recall procedure that became digit span.
sourceIndex.supports: Jacobs在1887年把数字和字母按逐渐增加的长度呈现，要求参与者当场复述或写出，并用能够稳定正确复现的最长序列描述即时记忆广度。
sourceIndex.safeUse: 可用于交代数字广度的早期实验逻辑，以及为什么测验要逐级增加长度并区分长度错误与顺序错误。
sourceIndex.boundary: 当前只核验了OUP元数据和公开历史摘要；第三方全文下载触发访问保护，未把挑战页当作论文。不要据此加入超出元数据与公认任务史的细节。

sourceIndex.title: Evaluation of the dual route theory of reading: a metanalysis of 35 neuroimaging studies
sourceIndex.citation: Jobard G, Crivello F, Tzourio-Mazoyer N. NeuroImage. 2003;20(2):693-712.
sourceIndex.useFor: Reading dual-route meta-analysis source for orthographic, phonological and lexical-semantic pathway boundaries. Tables 2-12 have been extracted into 10 MNI cluster-mean candidate coordinates plus 1 low-confidence visual-input boundary row.
sourceIndex.supports: Dual-route reading meta-analysis clusters support visual word-form, phonological, lexical-semantic and left IFG reading-route boundaries.
sourceIndex.safeUse: 可用于阅读能力中词汇判断、字词/伪词、音韵解码和正字法加工的通路支架。
sourceIndex.boundary: Cluster mean 不是个体诊断或完整语言 atlas；语义系统仍需专门语义来源。

sourceIndex.title: Exploring N-Back Cognitive Training for Children With ADHD
sourceIndex.citation: Jones MR, Katz B, Buschkuehl M, Jaeggi SM, Shah P. Journal of Attention Disorders. 2020;24(5):704-719.
sourceIndex.useFor: Active-control child n-back training study with immediate and three-month tests of near transfer, inhibition, working memory, school-related tasks, and matrix reasoning.
sourceIndex.supports: 80名7至14岁ADHD儿童进入分析：41人接受空间N-back训练，39人接受时长和奖励相近的知识/词汇主动对照。约5周20次、每次约15分钟后，未训练N-back和CPT抑制控制出现小幅近迁移；阅读理解、阅读流畅、数学应用题组成的学校任务没有可靠组间提升。
sourceIndex.safeUse: 可作为儿童N-back训练形式、剂量、自适应调难和主动对照的直接证据，也可用于解释为什么训练任务进步、相似任务迁移和学科成绩迁移必须分开看。
sourceIndex.boundary: 样本仅为ADHD儿童，入组后还有训练依从性排除；即时效应主要贴近N-back和CPT，三个月结果在多重比较校正后减弱，学校任务和矩阵推理没有可靠组间提升。不能外推到普通儿童或宣传为提高阅读、数学和一般智力。

sourceIndex.title: The academic outcomes of working memory and metacognitive strategy training in children: A double-blind randomized controlled trial
sourceIndex.citation: Jones JS, Milton F, Mostazir M, Adlam AR. Developmental Science. 2020;23(4):e12870.
sourceIndex.useFor: Typical-child randomized trial that measures the full transfer chain from trained working-memory tasks to untrained working memory, mathematical reasoning, reading comprehension, and three-month maintenance.
sourceIndex.supports: 95名9至14岁普通儿童被随机分到Cogmed、Cogmed加元认知策略或自适应视觉搜索主动对照组。训练持续6至7周，共20至25次，每次约45分钟；研究在训练前、训练后和三个月后测量四项工作记忆任务、数学推理和阅读理解。工作记忆近迁移保持到三个月；数学推理只在训练后立即出现改善，三个月后不再显著；阅读理解没有可靠改善。
sourceIndex.safeUse: 可作为儿童工作记忆训练中较完整的训练、近迁移、学业远迁移和保持时间证据，也能说明主动对照和延迟测量为何重要。
sourceIndex.boundary: 训练是包含11类言语与视空间任务的Cogmed，不是N-back直接训练。数学效应短暂且未保持，阅读没有改善；元认知策略增加了部分近迁移，但没有额外带来数学或阅读收益。不能把结果写成工作记忆训练稳定提高学业成绩。

sourceIndex.title: Spatial working memory in humans as revealed by PET
sourceIndex.citation: Jonides J, Smith EE, Koeppe RA, Awh E, Minoshima S, Mintun MA. Nature. 1993;363(6430):623-625.
sourceIndex.useFor: Spatial working-memory PET source for spatial/grid-span parietal and frontal candidate nodes.
sourceIndex.supports: 空间工作记忆 PET 来源，可用于空间广度中顶叶空间保持和前额叶控制的候选核验。
sourceIndex.safeUse: 用于空间广度/方格广度的材料特异证据补强，尤其检查 IPS/SPL 与 DLPFC 是否应作为核心点。
sourceIndex.boundary: 早期 PET 坐标需要确认空间和任务条件；不能直接把通用工作记忆点位替换为空间广度专属点。

sourceIndex.title: Brain Areas Specific for Attentional Load in a Motion-Tracking Task
sourceIndex.citation: Jovicich J, Peters RJ, Koch C, Braun J, Chang L, Ernst T. Journal of Cognitive Neuroscience. 2001;13(8):1048-1058.
sourceIndex.useFor: Multiple-object tracking and attentional-load fMRI coordinates, especially IPS/SPL, FEF/PMA, SEF/SMA, visual-motion regions, plus cerebellum/basal-ganglia atlas-boundary evidence.
sourceIndex.supports: 多目标追踪负荷研究提供动态视觉输入、SPL/IPS 追踪负荷、FEF/PMA 注意集合和 ACC/内侧额叶需求坐标，可用于 MOT 的生产级分层演示。
sourceIndex.safeUse: 可用于把 MOT 讲成运动视觉输入进入顶叶追踪负荷系统，并由 FEF/前运动准备和内侧额叶任务需求辅助。
sourceIndex.boundary: Jovicich 表格支持当前 MOT 演示，但视觉输入、追踪负荷、FEF/PMA 和 ACC/内侧额叶必须分层；小脑和基底节仍留在图谱边界，Merkel 2015 只作为未来策略分型精修。
