sourceIndex.title: The Parieto-Frontal Integration Theory (P-FIT) of intelligence: converging neuroimaging evidence
sourceIndex.citation: Jung RE, Haier RJ. Behavioral and Brain Sciences. 2007;30(2):135-154.
sourceIndex.useFor: Reasoning, Raven-like tasks, and parieto-frontal explanatory caution.
sourceIndex.supports: 候选用于 P-FIT 视角下的推理和智力相关宽网络框架。
sourceIndex.safeUse: 可作为瑞文矩阵和类比推理的宽网络讲法边界。
sourceIndex.boundary: 不能用于诊断性 IQ 声称，也不能把训练效果说成智力提升证明。

sourceIndex.title: A shared neural network for simple reaction time
sourceIndex.citation: Kansaku K, Hanakawa T, Wu T, Hallett M. NeuroImage. 2004;22(2):904-911.
sourceIndex.useFor: Simple reaction-time source separating sensory cue detection, SMA/premotor response preparation, opercular/parietal and cerebellar response-output candidates.
sourceIndex.supports: Simple reaction-time coordinates support sensory cue detection, medial frontal/SMA preparation, premotor response preparation, opercular salience/integration and cerebellar boundary evidence.
sourceIndex.safeUse: 可用于把 simple RT 讲成从线索输入到反应准备和输出的快速通路。
sourceIndex.boundary: 不等同 choice RT、符号搜索或复杂决策速度；小脑只作专门图谱边界。

sourceIndex.title: Altering cortical connectivity: remediation-induced changes in the white matter of poor readers
sourceIndex.citation: Keller TA, Just MA. Neuron. 2009;64(5):624-631.
sourceIndex.useFor: Randomized reading-remediation study with about 100 hours of instruction over six months and pre/post DTI in 8-12-year-old poor readers.
sourceIndex.supports: 强化解码训练后，非词阅读改善，并在左侧前部半卵圆中心观察到FA增加和径向弥散下降；未干预组没有同样变化。
sourceIndex.safeUse: 可用于说明阅读训练需要瞄准具体瓶颈；在阅读困难儿童中，足量音韵解码训练可能同时伴随行为和白质指标变化。
sourceIndex.boundary: 样本是阅读困难儿童，四种干预被合并分析；影像指标不能直接解释为髓鞘增加，篇章理解也未出现可靠改善，不能宣传为全面阅读能力提升。

sourceIndex.title: Neural activity that predicts subsequent memory and forgetting: A meta-analysis of 74 fMRI studies
sourceIndex.useFor: Long-term encoding and subsequent-memory regional evidence. Four legacy boundary conversions have arithmetic-only corrections with original values retained; exact transform variant and current FSL compatibility remain unverified.
sourceIndex.supports: 候选用于后续记忆和遗忘相关的长时编码元分析。
sourceIndex.safeUse: 可作为词表学习的编码环节核验入口。
sourceIndex.boundary: 海马和内侧颞叶不能由皮层分区完整表达。旧换算的4条边界结果已按声明算式修正，原值及差异保留；原文转换变体未明确，仍不能用于精确 FSL 峰值定位。

sourceIndex.title: Differential Contributions of Prefrontal, Medial Temporal, and Sensory-Perceptual Regions to True and False Memory Formation
sourceIndex.citation: Kim H, Cabeza R. Cerebral Cortex. 2007;17(9):2143-2150.
sourceIndex.useFor: True/false memory formation source separating PFC, MTL and sensory-perceptual contributions.
sourceIndex.supports: True/false memory formation coordinates support PFC, MTL and sensory-perceptual boundary refinement for false-memory formation.
sourceIndex.safeUse: 可用于 DRM/假记忆形成阶段解释 PFC、感觉再激活和 MTL 边界。
sourceIndex.boundary: 不是单一 DRM primary task；MTL、丘脑和小脑仍需专门图谱。

sourceIndex.title: Functional boundaries in the human cerebellum revealed by a multi-domain task battery
sourceIndex.citation: King M, Hernandez-Castillo CR, Poldrack RA, Ivry RB, Diedrichsen J. 2019. Nature Neuroscience.
sourceIndex.useFor: Cerebellar task-domain framing for motor, timing, working-memory, language, math, and spatial task candidates.
sourceIndex.supports: Supports cerebellar task-domain organization across motor, language, working-memory, math, and spatial task domains.
sourceIndex.safeUse: Use for cautious cerebellar candidate layer language when a task plausibly involves timing, sequencing, or practiced output.
sourceIndex.boundary: Does not by itself prove a cerebellar node for every paradigm in this library.

sourceIndex.title: Age differences in short-term retention of rapidly changing information
sourceIndex.citation: Kirchner WK. J Exp Psychol. 1958;55(4):352-358.
sourceIndex.useFor: Historical origin, apparatus, task logic, and original age-group result of the continuously paced N-back procedure.
sourceIndex.supports: Kirchner用12盏灯和对应按键比较年轻人与老年人对连续变化位置信息的短时保持。老年组更早跟不上节奏，漏答和无规律反应更多；论文把差异解释为快速组织输入与输出信息的困难。
sourceIndex.safeUse: 可用于交代N-back最初为何被设计、灯光与按键装置怎样运行，以及原始年龄组比较发现了什么。
sourceIndex.boundary: 当前核验到PubMed官方元数据和出版社索引的摘要级结果，尚无合法开放全文进入本地库。研究比较年轻人与老年成人，不能直接外推为儿童训练效果或脑定位证据。

sourceIndex.title: Medial temporal lobe activation during encoding and retrieval of novel face-name pairs
sourceIndex.citation: Kirwan CB, Stark CEL. Hippocampus. 2004;14(7):919-930.
sourceIndex.useFor: Face-name associative encoding/retrieval MTL coordinates and ROI-AL boundary evidence.
sourceIndex.supports: 配对联想/face-name 任务提供 MTL/海马相关坐标入口，可用于面孔-姓名绑定的专门图谱层。
sourceIndex.safeUse: 可用于说明 face-name 联结不仅是视觉识别，还需要 MTL/海马绑定候选层。
sourceIndex.boundary: MTL/海马不能用 Schaefer200 皮层 parcel 硬替代；需要专门图谱投影后再精细呈现。

sourceIndex.title: Computerized training of working memory in children with ADHD: a randomized, controlled trial
sourceIndex.citation: Klingberg T, Fernell E, Olesen PJ, et al. J Am Acad Child Adolesc Psychiatry. 2005;44(2):177-186.
sourceIndex.useFor: Multicenter randomized double-blind comparison of adaptive versus low-dose working-memory practice in 53 children aged 7-12 with ADHD, with post-training and three-month follow-up outcomes.
sourceIndex.supports: 53名7至12岁ADHD儿童被随机分配到自适应工作记忆训练或低剂量比较训练；完成训练者在未训练的视空间广度任务上改善，并报告了部分抑制、推理和症状指标变化。
sourceIndex.safeUse: 可作为儿童工作记忆训练的随机对照行为证据，说明在特定临床样本、训练剂量和近任务条件下，工作记忆表现可能改善。
sourceIndex.boundary: 样本是未用兴奋剂的ADHD儿童，完成者只有44人；没有训练前后MRI终点，远迁移、日常功能和一般儿童效果不能据此确定。

sourceIndex.title: Neural correlates of recency judgment
sourceIndex.citation: Konishi S, Uchida I, Okuaki T, Machida T, Shirouzu I, Miyashita Y. The Journal of Neuroscience. 2002;22(21):9549-9555.
sourceIndex.useFor: Recency judgment / temporal-order retrieval fMRI source with PMC full text. Table 1 reports HIGH minus LOW demand peaks for temporal-order retrieval; use for episodic-order-memory as sequence/recency retrieval evidence, not for millisecond perceptual temporal-order judgment.
sourceIndex.supports: 支持词序列近因判断和 temporal-order retrieval 的任务 fMRI 证据。Table 1 报告 HIGH minus LOW 检索需求的皮层峰值，并保留双侧内侧颞叶、丘脑/尾状、脑干和小脑边界。
sourceIndex.safeUse: 可用于把事件/情景顺序记忆中的“顺序检索、上下文排序、前额叶监控”推进到坐标候选层，尤其是 DLPFC/IFG、内侧额叶、顶叶和视觉/运动输出链路。
sourceIndex.boundary: 这不是故事情景顺序或真实生活事件排序的完整证据，也不是毫秒级时间顺序判断；坐标空间需继续复核，因为方法段写 MNI template，而图注使用 Talairach 切片语言。

sourceIndex.title: Neural foundations of imagery
sourceIndex.citation: Kosslyn SM, Ganis G, Thompson WL. Nature Reviews Neuroscience. 2001;2(9):635-642.
sourceIndex.useFor: Visual imagery task identity, perception-imagery overlap, and caution around internal imagery claims.
sourceIndex.supports: 候选用于视觉表象的综述级神经基础，尤其是视觉表象与视觉感知的部分重叠和差异。
sourceIndex.safeUse: 可用于说明视觉表象不是单纯看见外界，而是在没有外部图像时调用视觉和控制系统生成内部图像。
sourceIndex.boundary: 不能说大脑里真的出现可被观看的图像，也不能把视觉表象等同于心理旋转或训练效果证据。

sourceIndex.title: Recruitment of Anterior Dorsolateral Prefrontal Cortex in Human Reasoning: a Parametric Study of Relational Complexity
sourceIndex.citation: Kroger JK et al. 2002. Cerebral Cortex.
sourceIndex.useFor: Relational reasoning and relational complexity; supports anterior DLPFC candidate language.
sourceIndex.supports: Supports anterior DLPFC recruitment as relational complexity increases.
sourceIndex.safeUse: Use for relational reasoning DLPFC/frontoparietal candidate claims.
sourceIndex.boundary: Needs full coordinate extraction before marking parcels reviewed.

sourceIndex.title: The dynamics of change in striatal activity following updating training
sourceIndex.citation: Kühn S, Schmiedek F, Noack H, et al. Human Brain Mapping. 2013;34(7):1530-1541.
sourceIndex.useFor: Randomized intensive updating and spatial n-back training with active control, about 54 sessions, and three fMRI measurements.
sourceIndex.supports: 高强度组练习数字更新和空间n-back，纹状体活动随训练呈先升后降的动态变化，显示影像变化不是简单的单向增强。
sourceIndex.safeUse: 可用于解释工作记忆更新训练需要看训练进程、难度和时点，脑活动上升或下降都可能反映学习阶段变化。
sourceIndex.boundary: 成人高剂量训练、主动对照剂量不等价，且局部BOLD变化不是能力高低刻度；不能把纹状体变化转成个体诊断或儿童训练靶点。

sourceIndex.title: Playing Super Mario induces structural brain plasticity: gray matter changes resulting from training with a commercial video game
sourceIndex.citation: Kuhn S, Gleich T, Lorenz RC, Lindenberger U, Gallinat J. Molecular Psychiatry. 2014;19(2):265-271.
sourceIndex.useFor: Training/neuroplasticity background for explaining why complex 3D spatial-action tasks may engage spatial navigation, strategic planning, working memory, and motor coordination systems. Local PDF is archived; keep out of coordinate overlays, diagnosis, and product-efficacy promises.
sourceIndex.supports: 2个月、每天至少30分钟的商业3D平台游戏训练组，在结构MRI中观察到右海马结构、右背外侧前额叶和双侧小脑灰质增加；论文把这些区域解释为与空间导航、策略规划、工作记忆和动作表现相关。
sourceIndex.safeUse: 可用于资料库、训练设计和家长讲解中的“复杂任务练习可能打到多个脑功能系统，并且大脑具有可塑性”的背景说明。适合连接表象/空间操作、执行功能、短时/工作记忆和动作协调，不作为某个具体范式的点位来源。
sourceIndex.boundary: 样本是成人纵向训练研究，任务是 Super Mario 类3D平台游戏；不能据此承诺本项目训练会让儿童脑区灰质增长，不能作为疗效、诊断、个体预测或生产3D点位证据。

sourceIndex.title: An Unexpected Sequence of Events: Mismatch Detection in the Human Hippocampus
sourceIndex.citation: Kumaran D, Maguire EA. PLoS Biology. 2006;4(12):e424.
sourceIndex.useFor: Unexpected event-sequence / mismatch-detection fMRI source. PLOS Table S1 was downloaded and extracted into MNI coordinate intake: use cortical rows as episodic-order candidates and MTL rows as specialized-atlas boundary evidence.
sourceIndex.supports: Unexpected-sequence event fMRI source supports mismatch/sequence-memory candidates and MTL boundary rows for episodic-order memory.
sourceIndex.safeUse: Use for cautious event/sequence memory narration, especially unexpected sequence mismatch and MTL boundary language.
sourceIndex.boundary: Do not equate this with full autobiographical or story event-order memory; MTL rows require specialized atlas handling.

sourceIndex.title: Sustaining attention to simple tasks: A meta-analytic review of the neural mechanisms of vigilant attention
sourceIndex.citation: Langner R, Eickhoff SB. Psychological Bulletin. 2013;139(4):870-900.
sourceIndex.useFor: Sustained attention, vigilance, CPT/TOVA-style continuous monitoring, and attention-control boundaries.
sourceIndex.supports: 候选用于持续注意和警觉维持的元分析证据。
sourceIndex.safeUse: 可作为 CPT/TOVA 持续注意范式的核验入口。
sourceIndex.boundary: 不同 CPT/TOVA 版本差异较大，未复核全文前不做精确点位或单一通路声称。

sourceIndex.title: The capacity of visual working memory for features and conjunctions
sourceIndex.citation: Luck SJ, Vogel EK. Nature. 1997;390:279-281.
sourceIndex.useFor: Primary behavioral source for visual working-memory capacity and integrated-object rather than independent-feature storage.
sourceIndex.supports: 参与者短暂观看由颜色、方向等特征构成的阵列，经过空屏后判断是否变化。研究显示，大约四个整合物体可以被短暂保持；同一物体包含多个特征时，表现没有按特征总数成比例下降。
sourceIndex.safeUse: 可用于解释物体广度测量的是有限数量的整合视觉对象，以及颜色、方向、大小等特征为什么会以物体为单位绑定。
sourceIndex.boundary: 四个是该组成人实验和材料下的容量估计，不是所有年龄、材料和个体的固定上限，也不能直接换算成儿童学习能力等级。

sourceIndex.title: Dissociating the Role of the Dorsolateral Prefrontal and Anterior Cingulate Cortex in Cognitive Control
sourceIndex.citation: MacDonald AW, Cohen JD, Stenger VA, Carter CS. Science. 2000;288(5472):1835-1838.
sourceIndex.useFor: Stroop task preparation, DLPFC implementation of control, and ACC performance monitoring.
sourceIndex.supports: 事件相关 fMRI Stroop 任务显示左 DLPFC 更偏任务准备/控制实施，ACC 更偏不一致刺激下的表现监控。
sourceIndex.safeUse: 可用于把 Stroop 拆成前额叶规则保持和前扣带冲突监控两层，而不是只讲一个笼统注意网络。
sourceIndex.boundary: 该文支持控制实施与监控分工，不支持把所有额叶 parcel 解释为同一种抑制机制。

sourceIndex.title: Differential effects of reasoning and speed training in children
sourceIndex.citation: Mackey AP, Hill SS, Stone SI, Bunge SA. Developmental Science. 2011;14(3):582-590.
sourceIndex.useFor: Eight-week randomized comparison of reasoning games versus processing-speed games in 28 children aged 7-9 from low socioeconomic backgrounds.
sourceIndex.supports: 28名7至9岁儿童分别接受8周推理训练或加工速度训练；推理组主要改善非言语推理测验，速度组主要改善编码速度，显示训练收益与所练任务成分有选择性。
sourceIndex.safeUse: 可用于说明儿童的推理和加工速度表现具有可训练性，而且训练效果更可能先出现在与训练内容接近的任务上。
sourceIndex.boundary: 样本小、没有无训练控制组、部分评估未完全盲法，也没有MRI终点；论文中的大效应不能当作一般儿童、智商或学业提升的稳定估计。

sourceIndex.title: In search of the hidden: an fMRI study with implications for the study of patients with autism and with acquired brain injury
sourceIndex.citation: Manjaly ZM, Bruning N, Neufang S, et al. NeuroImage. 2003;19(3):674-683.
sourceIndex.useFor: Hidden/embedded figures task-fMRI source. Table 1 has been extracted: Table 1B provides EFT-specific left IFG/ventral premotor and left IPS convergence candidates; Table 1A provides broad visual-search scaffold only.
sourceIndex.supports: Hidden figures fMRI coordinates support left IFG/ventral premotor and left IPS consistency candidates, with broad visual-search rows as background.
sourceIndex.safeUse: 可用于嵌入图形/复杂图形搜索生产图中补强核心 EFT-specific 点位。
sourceIndex.boundary: Table 1A 的一般视觉搜索底座不能被讲成嵌入图形特异核心。

sourceIndex.title: The Effects of Instruction Using Semantic Mapping on Vocabulary and Comprehension
sourceIndex.citation: Margosein CM, Pascarella ET, Pflaum SW. The Journal of Early Adolescence. 1982;2(2):185-194.
sourceIndex.useFor: Randomized junior-high vocabulary study comparing semantic mapping with context-rich definition instruction. Use for vocabulary and semantic-relation learning, not broad comprehension transfer.
sourceIndex.supports: 44名初中生被随机分到丰富语境释义或语义映射教学；把新词与已知相关词比较异同的语义映射组，在周测、后测和标准化一般词汇测验上表现更好。
sourceIndex.safeUse: 可用于语义训练的具体形式：把新概念放进类别、特征、相似点和区别组成的关系网，再用新语境检索。
sourceIndex.boundary: 可核验结果主要是词汇学习，不能把题名中的 comprehension 直接扩写成篇章理解、学科成绩或长期保持；当前没有脑成像结论。

sourceIndex.title: Orchestrating Proactive and Reactive Mechanisms for Filtering Distracting Information: Brain-Behavior Relationships Revealed by a Mixed-Design fMRI Study
sourceIndex.citation: Marini F, Demeter E, Roberts KC, Chelazzi L, Woldorff MG. Journal of Neuroscience. 2016;36(3):988-1000.
sourceIndex.useFor: Flanker/distractor-filtering fMRI sample with behavior, proactive Mixed > Pure activations, and reactive incongruent > congruent coordinates. Use as a coordinate-reviewed Flanker sample, not a full Flanker meta-analysis.
sourceIndex.supports: 箭头 Flanker/旁侧干扰过滤的混合设计 fMRI 样本，包含 proactive Mixed > Pure 和 reactive incongruent > congruent 两类坐标。
sourceIndex.safeUse: 可用于 Flanker 的任务样本级坐标复核，表达视觉输入、顶叶目标选择、额顶抗干扰控制、冲突监控、前岛叶/岛盖控制需求和反应输出。
sourceIndex.boundary: 这不是 Flanker 全元分析；ROI 锚点不能被讲成所有 Flanker 研究的一致峰值。

sourceIndex.title: The visual word form area: expertise for reading in the fusiform gyrus
sourceIndex.citation: McCandliss BD, Cohen L, Dehaene S. 2003. Trends in Cognitive Sciences.
sourceIndex.useFor: VWFA/left fusiform reading expertise boundary for orthographic processing and word-form claims.
sourceIndex.supports: Supports the conceptual VWFA/left fusiform reading-expertise framing.
sourceIndex.safeUse: Use for explaining why orthographic processing needs a ventral occipitotemporal word-form layer.
sourceIndex.boundary: Review-level source, not a coordinate table for this app; exact points need coordinate extraction from primary studies or meta-analysis.

sourceIndex.title: Working memory training does not improve performance on measures of intelligence or other measures of far transfer
sourceIndex.citation: Melby-Lervag M, Redick TS, Hulme C. Perspectives on Psychological Science. 2016;11(4):512-534.
sourceIndex.useFor: Meta-analytic boundary source covering 87 publications and 145 experimental comparisons of working-memory training and transfer.
sourceIndex.supports: 元分析发现工作记忆训练对相似的言语和视空间工作记忆任务存在较稳定的近迁移，但与处理过的控制组相比，对智力、阅读和算术等远迁移结果没有令人信服的稳定证据。
sourceIndex.safeUse: 可用于解释为什么训练设计应锁定具体瓶颈、把练习接到真实任务，并分别验证近迁移和远迁移。
sourceIndex.boundary: 这篇综述反对把简单重复练习宣传为一般智力或现实能力提升，但不等于任何针对性教育干预都无效。

sourceIndex.title: Neural correlates of multiple object tracking strategies
sourceIndex.citation: Merkel C, Hopf JM, Schoenfeld MA. NeuroImage. 2015;118:63-73.
sourceIndex.useFor: Multiple-object tracking strategy source for attention-tracking and strategy-specific visual/dorsal attention candidates. Table 1 MNI ROI seed coordinates have been extracted as 21 review-level candidates; use for strategy refinement with Jovicich 2001.
sourceIndex.supports: MOT strategy ROI seeds support strategy-specific refinement for multiple-object tracking.
sourceIndex.safeUse: 可用于 MOT 未来策略分型，不替代 Jovicich 生产主干。
sourceIndex.boundary: ROI seed 坐标不能直接全部上主图；当前生产主干仍以 Jovicich 为准。

sourceIndex.title: Facilitation in recognizing pairs of words: Evidence of a dependence between retrieval operations
sourceIndex.citation: Meyer DE, Schvaneveldt RW. Journal of Experimental Psychology. 1971;90(2):227-234.
sourceIndex.useFor: Historical lexical-decision and semantic-priming source; use for task origin and related-versus-unrelated word-pair effects, not as a complete reading-comprehension model.
sourceIndex.supports: 经典词汇判断研究显示，在判断字符串是否为真词时，意义相关的词对通常比无关词对反应更快，为语义启动和词汇提取相互依赖提供了早期行为证据。
sourceIndex.safeUse: 可用于交代词汇判断的任务规则、反应时指标和语义启动研究史，也能说明一个词的识别会受到刚刚激活的意义背景影响。
sourceIndex.boundary: 研究是成人实验室反应时研究，不等于儿童阅读理解、课堂成绩或训练效果；相关词优势也不能被讲成一个固定语义脑区的直接证据。

sourceIndex.title: Non-identical neural mechanisms for two types of mental transformation: event-related potentials during mental rotation and mental paper folding
sourceIndex.citation: Milivojevic B, Johnson BW, Hamm JP, Corballis MC. Neuropsychologia. 2003;41(10):1345-1356.
sourceIndex.useFor: Mental paper folding task identity, ERP parietal-lateralization boundary, and caution against substituting mental-rotation coordinates.
sourceIndex.supports: ERP/行为层面区分心理旋转和心理折叠两类空间变换，可用于空间折叠范式身份和边界说明。
sourceIndex.safeUse: 可用于说明空间折叠不是心理旋转的简单重复，训练讲解中应把折叠、展开和空间变换边界分开。
sourceIndex.boundary: 该来源不是 fMRI 坐标表，不能用于 Schaefer200 点位级激活声称。

sourceIndex.title: The unity and diversity of executive functions and their contributions to complex frontal lobe tasks
sourceIndex.citation: Miyake A, Friedman NP, Emerson MJ, Witzki AH, Howerter A, Wager TD. Cognitive Psychology. 2000;41(1):49-100.
sourceIndex.useFor: Executive-function task taxonomy, updating, inhibition, shifting, and keep-track boundaries.
sourceIndex.supports: 候选用于执行功能中更新、抑制、切换等任务分类边界。
sourceIndex.safeUse: 适合帮助区分 keep-track、双任务、切换和抑制任务的功能归属。
sourceIndex.boundary: 这是行为/认知结构来源，不是脑区定位来源；不能直接支持点位级脑区声称。

sourceIndex.title: Selective updating of working memory content modulates meso-cortico-striatal activity
sourceIndex.citation: Murty VP, Sambataro F, Radulescu E, Altamura M, Iudicello J, Zoltick B, Weinberger DR, Goldberg TE, Mattay VS. NeuroImage. 2011;57(3):1264-1272.
sourceIndex.useFor: Selective working-memory updating source. PMC Table 2 MNI coordinates support updating > maintenance and updating > overwriting candidates; caudate/SN-VTA/cerebellum remain atlas-boundary evidence.
sourceIndex.supports: Flexible-updating task fMRI source supports updating and rule/context reconfiguration candidates in frontal, parietal and control regions.
sourceIndex.safeUse: Use for executive updating and working-memory updating candidate review with Collette and Nee/Brown.
sourceIndex.boundary: Do not equate flexible updating with all keep-track tasks or all short-term memory capacity tests.

sourceIndex.title: Functional topography of the human entorhinal cortex
sourceIndex.citation: Navarro Schroder T, Haak KV, Zaragoza Jimenez NI, Beckmann CF, Doeller CF. eLife. 2015;4:e06738.
sourceIndex.useFor: High-field 7T fMRI and connectivity-gradient source for human entorhinal functional topography. Use for anterior-lateral versus posterior-medial entorhinal cortex, anterior-temporal/posterior-medial memory-system, and object/content versus scene/spatial-context mechanism language; not for Schaefer200 cortical task-activation points.
sourceIndex.safeUse: Use only as a metadata/source-reading entry until a review contract is added.
sourceIndex.boundary: Do not promote this source beyond the current evidence tier without review.

sourceIndex.title: Dissociable Frontal-Striatal and Frontal-Parietal Networks Involved in Updating Hierarchical Contexts in Working Memory
sourceIndex.citation: Nee DE, Brown JW. Cerebral Cortex. 2013;23(9):2146-2158.
sourceIndex.useFor: Hierarchical context-updating fMRI source. PMC Tables 1-2 MNI coordinates support frontal-cingulate, frontal-parietal and frontostriatal updating boundaries, not keep-track original-task localization.
sourceIndex.supports: Hierarchical-context updating source supports nested context/rule updating candidates across frontal and parietal control systems.
sourceIndex.safeUse: Use to explain that updating can involve higher-order context/rule revision rather than only refreshing item contents.
sourceIndex.boundary: Do not present this as the definitive keep-track neural map; it is a context-updating candidate source.

sourceIndex.title: The influence of transcranial alternating current stimulation (tACS) on fluid intelligence: An fMRI study
sourceIndex.citation: Neubauer AC, Wammerl M, Benedek M, Jauk E, Jausovec N. Personality and Individual Differences. 2017;118:50-55.
sourceIndex.useFor: Supplementary Table S2 task-specific MNI peaks for the Paper Folding Test; use as direct fMRI coordinate candidate after local parcel review, while keeping stimulation-modulation rows separate.
sourceIndex.supports: Supplementary Table S2 提供 Paper Folding Test 的 task-specific MNI 坐标候选；2026-06-22 parcel review 已把 8 个正激活行分成视觉输入、顶叶空间变换和次级任务需求/视觉形态支持，并把 5 个负向行固定为 deactivation boundary。
sourceIndex.safeUse: 可用于把空间折叠从纯病灶边界推进到 direct task-fMRI parcel-reviewed candidate：正向展示优先保留右 lingual、左 IOG、左 IPL、左 SPL 和右 SMG/IPL 五个 compact anchors。
sourceIndex.boundary: 该研究样本小且处在 tACS 设计中；S2 正激活、S2 deactivation 行和主文 Table 1 stimulation-modulation 行必须分开。当前是 reviewed coordinate-candidate terminal，不是 production reviewed、训练效果或个体靶点证据。

sourceIndex.title: Operation-Specific Lexical Consistency Effect in Fronto-Insular-Parietal Network During Word Problem Solving
sourceIndex.citation: Ng CT, Lung TC, Chang TT. Frontiers in Human Neuroscience. 2021;15:631438.
sourceIndex.useFor: Arithmetic word-problem solving, operation-specific lexical consistency, and fronto-insular-parietal network evidence. PMC full text and Table 2 have been extracted into coordinate intake; keep adult-sample and caudate atlas-boundary cautions.
sourceIndex.supports: 数学应用题中词汇一致性、运算选择和额叶-岛叶-顶叶网络候选证据。
sourceIndex.safeUse: 优先作为 `math-word-problem` 的开放全文抽取入口，用于核验限定词/操作词如何影响解题网络。
sourceIndex.boundary: 尚未抽取和复核坐标；不能在坐标表审阅前把它讲成数学应用题 100% 点位。

sourceIndex.title: Distinct Behavioural and Brain Response Profiles Between Arithmetic Word Problem Solving and Sentence Comprehension in Third and Fourth Graders
sourceIndex.citation: Ng CT, Chen XY, Chang TT. European Journal of Neuroscience. 2025;61(2):e70003.
sourceIndex.useFor: Child arithmetic word-problem versus sentence-comprehension evidence for the math-intuition/logical-language demonstration.
sourceIndex.supports: 小学生数学应用题与句子理解的行为和脑反应差异候选证据。
sourceIndex.safeUse: 可作为产品演示中“应用题不是单纯阅读，也不是单纯计算”的高贴合候选来源。
sourceIndex.boundary: 本地还没有全文/坐标表；拿到材料前只能保留为元数据级候选。

sourceIndex.title: Meta-analytic evidence for a superordinate cognitive control network subserving diverse executive functions
sourceIndex.citation: Niendam TA, Laird AR, Ray KL, Dean YM, Glahn DC, Carter CS. Cognitive, Affective, & Behavioral Neuroscience. 2012;12(2):241-268.
sourceIndex.useFor: Cross-task executive control, inhibition, switching, working-memory control, and frontoparietal claims.
sourceIndex.supports: 候选用于执行控制、冲突监控、抑制、切换和工作记忆控制的跨任务网络框架。
sourceIndex.safeUse: 可作为 Stroop、Flanker、任务切换和 Go/No-Go 的候选核验入口。
sourceIndex.boundary: 全文和任务清单未逐条复核前，不把它说成某个单一范式的专属证据。

sourceIndex.title: A Meta-analysis on the neural basis of planning: Activation likelihood estimation of functional brain imaging results in the Tower of London task
sourceIndex.citation: Nitschke K, Köstering L, Finkel L, Weiller C, Kaller CP. Human Brain Mapping. 2017;38(1):396-413.
sourceIndex.useFor: Tower of London planning and planning-complexity ALE clusters. Table 2 has been extracted into a coordinate-intake file and mapped to Schaefer200 cortical candidate parcels; caudate rows remain atlas-boundary evidence.
sourceIndex.supports: Tower of London 规划任务的坐标级 ALE 元分析证据；Table 2 报告 overall planning 和 planning complexity 的 MNI weighted centroids。
sourceIndex.safeUse: 可用于把伦敦塔规划任务展示为双侧 mid-DLPFC、FEF、SMA/pre-SMA、IPL/楔前叶、前岛叶和 RLPFC 共同参与的规划网络。
sourceIndex.boundary: 尾状核等皮层外结构不在当前 Schaefer200 皮层模型内；Table 2 是群体 ALE centroid，不是个体训练靶点，也不能替代 Stop-signal 或 Keep-track 专门证据。

sourceIndex.title: Functional imaging studies of emotion regulation: A synthetic review and evolving model of the cognitive control of emotion
sourceIndex.citation: Ochsner KN, Silvers JA, Buhle JT. Annals of the New York Academy of Sciences. 2012;1251:E1-E24.
sourceIndex.useFor: Synthetic review for cognitive control of emotion and emotion regulation. Use as explanatory boundary for reappraisal/control-demand mechanisms, not as point-level task evidence.
sourceIndex.supports: 情绪调节的综合模型，支持控制系统、意义系统和情绪反应系统交互的解释。
sourceIndex.safeUse: 可用于情绪-认知框架、故事文案和训练设计的机制边界说明。
sourceIndex.boundary: 综述模型不是训练疗效证据，也不能用于诊断或个体评估。

sourceIndex.title: N-back working memory paradigm: A meta-analysis of normative functional neuroimaging studies
sourceIndex.citation: Owen AM, McMillan KM, Laird AR, Bullmore E. Human Brain Mapping. 2005;25(1):46-59.
sourceIndex.useFor: N-back and working-memory update evidence.
sourceIndex.supports: N-back 神经影像元分析报告跨研究稳定的额顶、前运动/内侧额叶和后顶叶激活，可用于 N-back 更新、匹配判断和工作记忆负荷的候选证据。
sourceIndex.safeUse: 优先用于核验 N-back 的更新、保持、匹配判断和额顶控制表述，并作为短时记忆中“更新任务强于简单广度任务”的边界依据。
sourceIndex.boundary: Owen 2005 使用 Talairach 坐标汇总，投到 Schaefer200 前需要坐标空间转换；不能自动外推到数字广度、空间广度或所有短时容量测验。

sourceIndex.title: The anterior cingulate cortex mediates processing selection in the Stroop attentional conflict paradigm
sourceIndex.citation: Pardo JV, Pardo PJ, Janer KW, Raichle ME. Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences. 1990;87(1):256-259.
sourceIndex.useFor: Stroop conflict, anterior cingulate conflict monitoring, and distributed task-execution network caution.
sourceIndex.supports: PET Stroop 色词冲突研究报告 incongruent 相比 congruent 条件下以前扣带皮层反应最突出，并伴随前运动、SMA、视觉等分布式区域。
sourceIndex.safeUse: 可用于说明 Stroop 的冲突监控/反应选择不能只画成视觉和注意，还应显式放入前扣带/内侧额叶监控节点。
sourceIndex.boundary: 这是一项早期 PET 研究，不等同于 Schaefer200 点位级精确坐标；不能说这些点就是训练靶点。

sourceIndex.title: Short-term number sense training recapitulates long-term neurodevelopmental changes from childhood to adolescence
sourceIndex.citation: Park Y, Zhang Y, Chang H, Menon V. Developmental Science. 2024;27(5):e13524.
sourceIndex.useFor: Four-week one-to-one number-sense training in 7- to 10-year-old children with symbolic and nonsymbolic comparison tasks and pre/post fMRI pattern analysis.
sourceIndex.supports: 7至10岁儿童接受四周、一周三次、每次约60分钟的一对一数感训练；训练直接围绕点阵与阿拉伯数字的数量对应，训练后符号和非符号比较效率提高，并观察到跨形式神经表征关系变化。
sourceIndex.safeUse: 可作为数量理解三联任务中“数字代表多少”一关的直接训练和fMRI锚点，也可说明训练目标是改善跨形式数量加工，而不是机械刷同一种比较题。
sourceIndex.boundary: 训练样本、剂量和多变量影像结果不能直接外推成本项目疗效；神经表征相似性训练后下降不等于大脑变差，也不能证明整体数学成绩、数轴或计数都会同步提高。

sourceIndex.title: Training the Approximate Number System Improves Math Proficiency
sourceIndex.citation: Park J, Brannon EM. Psychological Science. 2013;24(10):2013-2019.
sourceIndex.useFor: Two behavioral experiments testing whether six to ten sessions of nonsymbolic approximate arithmetic training transfer to symbolic arithmetic.
sourceIndex.supports: 近似加减训练组的符号加减收益高于被动控制、知识训练和数字顺序训练，支持数感与符号运算之间存在可训练联系。
sourceIndex.safeUse: 可用于数感训练的任务设计依据，并强调训练应包含近似运算、反馈和逐步调难，而不是只反复比大小。
sourceIndex.boundary: 研究对象是成人、没有影像终点，且后续领域存在复制和元分析争议；不能据此承诺儿童数学成绩或把ANS当成唯一数学瓶颈。

sourceIndex.title: New Evidence for Distinct Right and Left Brain Systems for Deductive versus Probabilistic Reasoning
sourceIndex.citation: Parsons LM, Osherson DN. Cerebral Cortex. 2001;11(10):954-965.
sourceIndex.useFor: Deductive versus probabilistic reasoning PET source with Talairach Table 1 coordinates. Use as candidate evidence for differentiating right-hemisphere deductive-rule processing from left IFG/posterior-cingulate/MTL probabilistic-world-knowledge evaluation; requires modern task-fMRI cross-source review before production overlay.
sourceIndex.supports: 演绎与概率推理 PET 坐标候选，可用于推理能力中 deductive versus probabilistic reasoning 的任务边界。
sourceIndex.safeUse: 可用于补强推理演示中的演绎/概率判断差异，并与 Kroger、Bunge、Rodriguez、Hampshire 交叉裁剪。
sourceIndex.boundary: 早期 PET 坐标需要转换和人工复核；不能单独升为所有推理范式的 reviewed parcel。

sourceIndex.title: The neural correlates of the verbal component of working memory
sourceIndex.citation: Paulesu E, Frith CD, Frackowiak RSJ. Nature. 1993;362(6418):342-345.
sourceIndex.useFor: Verbal working-memory and phonological-loop evidence for digit-span storage/rehearsal boundaries.
sourceIndex.supports: 经典语音工作记忆/语音环路神经影像来源，可作为数字广度中语音短时存储和复述控制的候选依据。
sourceIndex.safeUse: 用于解释数字序列不是纯粹视觉或一般注意任务，而需要语音短时保持和主动复述。
sourceIndex.boundary: 早期 PET 研究不能直接等同 Schaefer200 点位；需要全文坐标、坐标空间和任务条件复核。

sourceIndex.title: The Attention System of the Human Brain: 20 Years After
sourceIndex.citation: Petersen SE, Posner MI. Annual Review of Neuroscience. 2012;35:73-89.
sourceIndex.useFor: Attention-system overview, orienting, executive attention, and network-level boundary language.
sourceIndex.supports: 注意系统的综述级框架，支持将注意力拆成定向、执行控制等系统，并强调这些系统会与发展、个体差异和干预研究相连。
sourceIndex.safeUse: 可用于九项脑功能中注意力的总框架说明，帮助连接 ANT、Posner 和冲突控制任务。
sourceIndex.boundary: 综述级证据不能替代单个范式的坐标级激活，也不能证明训练产品效果。

sourceIndex.title: Single-trial classification of parallel pre-attentive and serial attentive processes using functional magnetic resonance imaging
sourceIndex.citation: Piazza M, Giacomini E, Le Bihan D, Dehaene S. Proceedings of the Royal Society B. 2003;270(1521):1237-1241.
sourceIndex.useFor: Visual enumeration fMRI separating rapid small-set subitizing from serial counting as set size increases.
sourceIndex.supports: 视觉量化任务中，1至3个项目主要表现为快速并行识别；从4个项目左右开始，后顶叶和额叶注意相关活动明显增加，更符合逐项搜索和计数。
sourceIndex.safeUse: 可用于把小数量快速识别与较大数量逐项计数分成两个加工阶段，并说明计数会额外调用空间注意和搜索。
sourceIndex.boundary: 成人小样本和特定视觉阵列不能用于儿童诊断，也不能把某个转折点固定成所有人的绝对容量；本轮只使用网络级显示，不生成新生产坐标。

sourceIndex.title: Neural Substrates of Fluid Reasoning: An fMRI Study of Neocortical Activation during Performance of the Raven's Progressive Matrices Test
sourceIndex.citation: Prabhakaran V, Smith JAL, Desmond JE, Glover GH, Gabrieli JDE. Cognitive Psychology. 1997;33(1):43-63.
sourceIndex.useFor: Raven/APM fluid-reasoning task identity, analytic versus figural reasoning boundaries, and broad region-level frontoparietal/visual reasoning explanation.
sourceIndex.supports: Raven/APM task fMRI source supports broad frontal, parietal, temporal and occipital region-level fluid-reasoning boundaries, but the main PDF lacks the numeric RavensTable/source-foci table.
sourceIndex.safeUse: Use for Raven-specific task identity and region-level reasoning narrative until a source-foci table or replacement peak-coordinate source is obtained.
sourceIndex.boundary: Do not create Schaefer200 point labels from the main article alone; do not treat Raven, analogy, deduction and probability reasoning as one identical coordinate map.

sourceIndex.title: A review and synthesis of the first 20 years of PET and fMRI studies of heard speech, spoken language and reading
sourceIndex.citation: Price CJ. NeuroImage. 2012;62(2):816-847.
sourceIndex.useFor: Reading and sentence comprehension language-system caution.
sourceIndex.supports: 候选用于语言、阅读和听说加工的综述级系统框架。
sourceIndex.safeUse: 可作为阅读和句子理解需要语言专门层的边界说明。
sourceIndex.boundary: Yeo7 没有独立语言网络，当前图只能显示粗略支架，不能替代语言图谱。

sourceIndex.title: The change of the brain activation patterns as children learn algebra equation solving
sourceIndex.citation: Qin Y, Carter CS, Silk EM, et al. Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences. 2004;101(15):5686-5691.
sourceIndex.useFor: Five-day algebra equation-solving practice in ten 12-15-year-old students with fMRI on the first and fifth days.
sourceIndex.supports: 儿童方程求解速度随练习提高，左前额叶和左顶叶活动下降、左壳核活动增加，说明初学符号变换时多个成分会共同重组。
sourceIndex.safeUse: 可用于说明代数训练应拆成问题表征、符号变换、规则提取和答案执行，并通过练习降低不必要的检索和变换成本。
sourceIndex.boundary: 只有10名学生、5天练习且没有独立对照组；不能把活动下降简单解释为能力更强，也不能外推到所有数学学习。

sourceIndex.title: Selection and stopping in voluntary action: A meta-analysis and combined fMRI study
sourceIndex.citation: Rae CL, Hughes LE, Weaver C, Anderson MC, Rowe JB. NeuroImage. 2014;86:381-391.
sourceIndex.useFor: Action selection, Stop-signal stopping, and shared selection/stopping preSMA and frontoparietal-control candidate coordinates.
sourceIndex.supports: selection 与 stopping 的补充表坐标可用于反应选择、Stop-signal 和 shared preSMA/控制网络候选层。
sourceIndex.safeUse: 可用于区分选择反应、停止控制和共享控制节点，尤其是 preSMA/IFG/insula/parietal 候选。
sourceIndex.boundary: 补充表点位数量较大，生产 overlay 必须裁剪 conjunction、SVC 或核心行，不能直接显示全部峰值。

sourceIndex.title: Context-specific activations are a hallmark of the neural basis of individual differences in common executive function
sourceIndex.citation: Reineberg AE, Banich MT, Wager TD, Friedman NP. NeuroImage. 2022;249:118845.
sourceIndex.useFor: Executive-function task battery and keep-track/common-EF context; local PDF/HTML/supplement review supports network/context evidence but not Schaefer200 point overlay.
sourceIndex.supports: 支持 Keep-track 作为扫描版执行功能更新任务，并提供大样本 common executive function / updating 背景。
sourceIndex.safeUse: 可用于说明 Keep-track 的任务结构：在 remember trials 中持续更新目标类别的最新项目，并与 read trials / fixation 形成 fMRI 对比。
sourceIndex.boundary: PMC 全文已入库，但正文未提供可直接抽取的群体峰值坐标表；NeuroVault 或原始 maps 未定位前，不能把它用于 Schaefer200 点位级 reviewed overlay。

sourceIndex.title: Cerebral correlates of preserved cognitive skills in autism
sourceIndex.citation: Ring HA, Baron-Cohen S, Wheelwright S, et al. Brain. 1999;122(7):1305-1315.
sourceIndex.useFor: Embedded/hidden-figures special-population boundary source. Tables 2-4 are extracted as raw Talairach and MNI-converted review rows for autism/control strategy differences; useful for preserved-skill framing, not ordinary-child production overlay.
sourceIndex.supports: Hidden-figures special-population PET/fMRI-style coordinates support clinical/strategy boundary language for embedded figures.
sourceIndex.safeUse: 可用于说明特殊人群中嵌入图形策略和视觉局部加工边界。
sourceIndex.boundary: 不能把 autism/control 差异直接讲成普通儿童嵌入图形训练靶点。

sourceIndex.title: Academic Outcomes 2 Years After Working Memory Training for Children With Low Working Memory: A Randomized Clinical Trial
sourceIndex.citation: Roberts G, Quach J, Spencer-Smith M, et al. JAMA Pediatrics. 2016;170(5):e154568.
sourceIndex.useFor: Large school-based randomized trial that follows low-working-memory children for two years and measures working memory, reading, mathematics, spelling, behavior, quality of life, and intervention cost.
sourceIndex.supports: 研究先筛查44所学校的1723名一年级儿童，再将452名低工作记忆儿童随机分组。训练组在学校完成20至25次、每次45分钟的Cogmed训练；研究在6、12和24个月追踪工作记忆，并在12和24个月直接测量阅读、数学和拼写，同时收集行为、社会情绪、生活质量与成本。视空间短时记忆在6和12个月出现改善，但24个月消失；其他结局没有获益，学业成绩没有持续提高。
sourceIndex.safeUse: 可作为训练迁移链和长期随访做得较完整的大样本边界研究，尤其适合说明为什么不能用短期任务进步代替长期学业结果。
sourceIndex.boundary: 对照条件是常规课堂教学，而不是等时主动认知训练；样本是筛查出的低工作记忆儿童，且训练占用了课堂时间。当前只核验官方摘要和大学元数据，尚未获得可合法归档的开放全文，因此只能使用摘要明确报告的结果。

sourceIndex.title: The dynamics of deductive reasoning: An fMRI investigation
sourceIndex.citation: Rodriguez-Moreno D, Hirsch J. Neuropsychologia. 2009;47(4):949-961.
sourceIndex.useFor: Deductive reasoning, premise processing, rule inference, and frontoparietal/language-control candidate mapping.
sourceIndex.supports: 支持演绎推理 fMRI 任务作为规则推导和前提处理的候选神经影像来源；用户补入 PDF 后，Table 2 已抽取 Talairach 峰值、转 MNI 并完成 Schaefer200 最近点候选映射。
sourceIndex.safeUse: 可用于推理能力中“根据前提推出结论”的演示入口，先作为 70% 坐标候选展示额顶控制、顶叶关系工作区和规则/结论检查。
sourceIndex.boundary: 演绎推理材料差异较大；premise integration、conclusion validation 和尾状核/丘脑边界还要人工裁剪，不能直接讲成所有逻辑推理的 100% 点位。

sourceIndex.title: Creating false memories: Remembering words not presented in lists
sourceIndex.citation: Roediger HL, McDermott KB. Journal of Experimental Psychology: Learning, Memory, and Cognition. 1995;21(4):803-814.
sourceIndex.useFor: DRM false-memory task identity, semantic gist, false recognition, and source-monitoring caution.
sourceIndex.supports: 支持 DRM 作为语义相关词表诱发假记忆的经典行为范式。
sourceIndex.safeUse: 可用于讲解长时记忆会受到语义 gist 和来源监控影响。
sourceIndex.boundary: 这是行为范式来源，不直接支持脑区点位，需要另配神经影像文献。

sourceIndex.title: The hippocampus, ventromedial prefrontal cortex, and episodic and semantic memory
sourceIndex.citation: Rolls ET. Progress in Neurobiology. 2022;217:102334.
sourceIndex.useFor: Hippocampus/vmPFC episodic and semantic memory framework; use for event-order/schema/context boundary language, not coordinates.
sourceIndex.supports: 综述级支持海马、vmPFC、情景记忆、语义记忆和 schema/context 的框架语言。
sourceIndex.safeUse: 可用于事件/情景顺序记忆的框架说明和边界提示。
sourceIndex.boundary: 综述不能替代具体事件顺序任务 fMRI 坐标。

sourceIndex.title: Modelling neural correlates of working memory: A coordinate-based meta-analysis
sourceIndex.citation: Rottschy C, Langner R, Dogan I, et al. NeuroImage. 2012;60(1):830-846.
sourceIndex.useFor: Working-memory maintenance, manipulation, and short-term capacity claims.
sourceIndex.supports: 坐标元分析入口，用于工作记忆保持、操作、负荷和材料类型相关任务的候选脑区核验。
sourceIndex.safeUse: 可作为 N-back、数字广度、空间广度和物体广度的工作记忆复核入口，尤其用于拆分保持、操作和容量负荷。
sourceIndex.boundary: Rottschy 核心表已可作通用工作记忆候选背景，但不能替代材料专门证据；语言复述、空间位置保持、物体保持和容量瓶颈必须分开映射。

sourceIndex.title: Progressive increase of frontostriatal brain activation from childhood to adulthood during event-related tasks of cognitive control
sourceIndex.citation: Rubia K, Smith AB, Woolley J, et al. Human Brain Mapping. 2006;27(12):973-993.
sourceIndex.useFor: Go/No-Go, Simon interference, and task-switching cognitive-control fMRI source with PMC HTML obtained and Table II Talairach peaks extracted.
sourceIndex.supports: 开放 PMC 任务 fMRI 来源，Table II 支持成人组 Go/No-Go 和任务切换 raw Talairach 坐标入库，并提示同一研究还含 Simon 干扰任务坐标。
sourceIndex.safeUse: 可作为执行功能中 Go/No-Go 抑制和任务切换的坐标来源；当前已经完成 Talairach 转 MNI 和 Schaefer200 复核。
sourceIndex.boundary: 这是发展比较研究，不等同 Swick 2011 的 Go/No-Go vs Stop-signal 元分析；Simon 坐标需新增专门范式后再导入。

sourceIndex.title: Training, maturation, and genetic influences on the development of executive attention
sourceIndex.citation: Rueda MR, Rothbart MK, McCandliss BD, Saccomanno L, Posner MI. PNAS. 2005;102(41):14931-14936.
sourceIndex.useFor: Five-session executive-attention training in 4- and 6-year-old children, with trained/control comparisons, Child ANT behavior, and ERP outcomes.
sourceIndex.supports: 4岁和6岁儿童接受5次执行注意训练，与控制组比较后在Child ANT行为指标和头皮ERP上呈现更成熟的表现，可支撑注意控制训练设计。
sourceIndex.safeUse: 可用于说明短期、逐级加难的注意控制练习能改变近任务表现和ERP指标，并为ANT、Flanker和冲突控制训练提供设计依据。
sourceIndex.boundary: 训练时间短、单组样本较小且没有MRI终点；不能据此承诺广泛智力、长期学业或所有注意力问题都会改善。

sourceIndex.title: Characterising the unity and diversity of executive functions in a within-subject fMRI study
sourceIndex.citation: Saylik R, Williams AL, Murphy RA, Szameitat AJ. Scientific Reports. 2022;12:8182.
sourceIndex.useFor: Within-subject fMRI comparison of updating, inhibition, switching and dual-tasking; Table 1 MNI conjunction peaks support common executive-function / updating boundaries, not keep-track original-task localization.
sourceIndex.supports: Within-subject executive-function source provides common-EF conjunction peaks and diversity/task-family framing.
sourceIndex.safeUse: Use as a compact common-EF candidate scaffold for updating/inhibition/shifting discussion.
sourceIndex.boundary: It is not a keep-track original paradigm source and should not replace task-specific updating, inhibition or switching coordinates.

sourceIndex.title: Local-Global Parcellation of the Human Cerebral Cortex from Intrinsic Functional Connectivity MRI
sourceIndex.citation: Schaefer A, Kong R, Gordon EM, et al. Cerebral Cortex, 2018.
sourceIndex.safeUse: Use only as a metadata/source-reading entry until a review contract is added.
sourceIndex.boundary: Do not promote this source beyond the current evidence tier without review.

sourceIndex.title: Do brain-training programs work?
sourceIndex.citation: Simons DJ, Boot WR, Charness N, et al. Psychological Science in the Public Interest. 2016;17(3):103-186.
sourceIndex.useFor: Comprehensive methods-and-transfer review of task/game-based brain-training evidence and the study-design standards needed for credible efficacy claims.
sourceIndex.supports: 综合评估认为，训练任务本身的改善证据很多，接近任务的迁移证据较少，远距离任务和日常认知表现的改善证据很少；许多研究还存在控制、盲法、样本和分析问题。
sourceIndex.safeUse: 可作为九项功能共同的证据边界：先讲训练内容、样本、剂量和直接结果，再单独证明是否迁移到真实学习。
sourceIndex.boundary: 它评估的是外部脑训练研究，不证明本项目无效或有效；具体训练仍需自己的对照、随访、真实任务和产品级验证。

sourceIndex.title: A sensory signature that distinguishes true from false memories
sourceIndex.citation: Slotnick SD, Schacter DL. Nature Neuroscience. 2004;7(6):664-672.
sourceIndex.useFor: True versus false recognition evidence for sensory-perceptual reactivation and false-memory boundaries. Tables 1-3 have been extracted into Talairach and MNI-converted coordinate intake with 73 cortical review candidates and caudate/thalamus/hippocampus boundary rows.
sourceIndex.supports: True versus false recognition coordinates support sensory reactivation and caudate/thalamus/hippocampus boundary evidence for false-memory refinement.
sourceIndex.safeUse: 可用于 DRM/假记忆精修中说明 true-vs-false recognition 的感觉再激活差异。
sourceIndex.boundary: 不是 DRM primary-task 坐标；海马、丘脑和尾状核需要专门图谱，不能直接塞入 Schaefer200 主图。

sourceIndex.title: Dissociating Verbal and Spatial Working Memory Using PET
sourceIndex.citation: Smith EE, Jonides J, Koeppe RA. Cerebral Cortex. 1996;6(1):11-20.
sourceIndex.useFor: Verbal versus spatial working-memory dissociation; boundary source for digit-span versus spatial/grid-span overlays.
sourceIndex.supports: 言语工作记忆和空间工作记忆分离的 PET 研究入口，可用于数字广度与空间广度的边界对照。
sourceIndex.safeUse: 用于说明数字广度和空间广度不能共享同一套点位；一个偏语音序列，一个偏空间位置保持。
sourceIndex.boundary: 全文坐标未映射前，只能作为任务族边界来源，不把左右顶叶或额叶点位讲成最终定位。

sourceIndex.title: Event-related fMRI studies of episodic encoding and retrieval: Meta-analyses using activation likelihood estimation
sourceIndex.citation: Spaniol J, Davidson PSR, Kim ASN, Han H, Moscovitch M, Grady CL. Neuropsychologia. 2009;47(8-9):1765-1779.
sourceIndex.useFor: Recognition memory, episodic retrieval, and memory-system caution.
sourceIndex.supports: 候选用于情景记忆编码和提取的 ALE 元分析。
sourceIndex.safeUse: 可作为再认记忆和词表学习提取环节的核验入口。
sourceIndex.boundary: 熟悉性、回忆性和内侧颞叶贡献需要进一步细分。

sourceIndex.title: Putting names to faces:
sourceIndex.citation: Sperling R, Chua E, Cocchiarella A, et al. NeuroImage. 2003;20(2):1400-1410.
sourceIndex.useFor: Face-name associative encoding fMRI; candidate for hippocampal/MTL binding, face visual input, and prefrontal strategy language.
sourceIndex.supports: 候选支持 face-name associative encoding 中面孔、姓名与海马/内侧颞叶联结绑定的任务身份和 fMRI 入口。
sourceIndex.safeUse: 可用于说明面孔-姓名联结需要把视觉人脸和语义姓名绑定成长期关联。
sourceIndex.boundary: 全文坐标未抽取前，不讲具体 Schaefer 点位；海马必须保持为物理辅助层。

sourceIndex.title: Proportional Reasoning
sourceIndex.citation: Stavy R, Babai R, Kallai AY. Zeitschrift fuer Psychologie. 2016;224(4):266-276.
sourceIndex.useFor: Full-PDF-reviewed fMRI Talairach coordinate evidence for proportional reasoning with congruity and salience manipulations. Use for candidate proportional-reasoning / math-intuition-conflict mapping after Talairach-to-MNI conversion; keep boundaries narrow to this task family.
sourceIndex.supports: Proportional-reasoning fMRI source supports salience/congruency conflict, parietal quantity relations, frontal control and thalamic/cerebellar boundary candidates from user-provided Semantic Scholar figures/tables.
sourceIndex.safeUse: Use for proportional-reasoning and math-intuition conflict candidate review after Talairach-to-MNI mapping.
sourceIndex.boundary: The full PDF now verifies the screenshot-derived table numbers, contrast definitions and fMRI methods. Keep the source at candidate task-family level and do not overgeneralize to all probability/statistics reasoning.

sourceIndex.title: The hippocampal formation participates in novel picture encoding: evidence from functional magnetic resonance imaging
sourceIndex.citation: Stern CE, Corkin S, Gonzalez RG, et al. Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences. 1996;93(16):8660-8665.
sourceIndex.useFor: Novel picture encoding and visual long-term memory candidate source; supports hippocampal formation plus ventral visual areas, pending coordinate extraction.
sourceIndex.supports: 候选支持新图片编码中海马结构、海马旁回、舌回/梭状回的视觉-记忆互动。
sourceIndex.safeUse: 可用于视觉延迟记忆的种子说明，特别是视觉输入与 MTL 编码的关系。
sourceIndex.boundary: 早期 fMRI 研究需核坐标空间和表格；当前不做精确 parcel 声称。

sourceIndex.title: Neural predictors of individual differences in response to math tutoring in primary-grade school children
sourceIndex.citation: Supekar K, Swigart AG, Tenison C, Jolles DD, Rosenberg-Lee M, Fuchs L, Menon V. PNAS. 2013;110(20):8230-8235.
sourceIndex.useFor: Eight-week one-to-one arithmetic tutoring in 24 third-grade children, with behavioral gains and pretutoring hippocampal morphometry/connectivity predictors of response.
sourceIndex.supports: 24名三年级儿童接受8周一对一数学辅导后，算术速度、正确率和事实提取策略均改善；训练前海马体积及其与前额叶、基底节的连接与改善幅度相关。
sourceIndex.safeUse: 可用于解释数学辅导反应存在个体差异，学习记忆系统的训练前状态可能与后续收益相关。
sourceIndex.boundary: 论文没有证明训练导致海马体积或静息连接改变，也不能把组水平预测转成对单个孩子的诊断、分型或疗效承诺。

sourceIndex.title: Are the neural correlates of stopping and not going identical? Quantitative meta-analysis of two response inhibition tasks
sourceIndex.citation: Swick D, Ashley V, Turken AU. NeuroImage. 2011;56(3):1655-1665.
sourceIndex.useFor: Go/No-Go and Stop-signal response inhibition comparison; local PDF Tables 2-4 have been extracted into Talairach and MNI-converted coordinate candidate files for separate overlay review.
sourceIndex.supports: Go/No-Go、Stop-signal 及 GNG-SST 差异的 ALE 元分析坐标已抽取并转为 MNI 候选映射，可用于区分两类反应抑制任务的候选网络。

sourceIndex.title: Hick-Hyman Law is Mediated by the Cognitive Control Network in the Brain
sourceIndex.citation: Wu T, Dufford AJ, Egan LJ, Mackie MA, Chen C, Yuan C, Chen C, Li X, Liu X, Hof PR, Fan J. Cerebral Cortex. 2018;28(7):2267-2282.
sourceIndex.useFor: Ordinary choice reaction-time / Hick-Hyman candidate source.
